00141: static bool isScheduledQPUKernel(mlir::vc4::FuncOp func) {
00142:   if (func.isExternal())
00143:     return false;
00144: 
00145:   std::optional<mlir::vc4::ExecutionDomain> domain = func.getDomain();
00146:   std::optional<mlir::vc4::FunctionForm> form = func.getForm();
00147:   if (!domain || *domain != mlir::vc4::ExecutionDomain::qpu || !form ||
00148:       *form != mlir::vc4::FunctionForm::scheduled)
00149:     return false;
00150: 
00151:   return func->hasAttr("kernel");
00152: }

00154: static bool isCIdentifierHead(char value) {
00155:   return (value >= 'A' && value <= 'Z') || (value >= 'a' && value <= 'z') ||
00156:          value == '_';
00157: }
00158: 
00159: static bool isCIdentifierTail(char value) {
00160:   return isCIdentifierHead(value) || (value >= '0' && value <= '9');
00161: }
00162: 
00163: static bool isCIdentifier(llvm::StringRef value) {
00164:   if (value.empty() || !isCIdentifierHead(value.front()))
00165:     return false;
00166:   for (char c : value.drop_front()) {
00167:     if (!isCIdentifierTail(c))
00168:       return false;
00169:   }
00170:   return true;
00171: }

00251: static LogicalResult parseLaunchABIArgument(mlir::vc4::FuncOp func,
00252:                                             mlir::DictionaryAttr argDict,
00253:                                             LaunchABIModel &launchABI) {
00254:   auto nameAttr = getDictionaryStringAttr(argDict, "name");
00255:   if (!nameAttr || nameAttr.getValue().empty())
00256:     return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00257:         func, "argument entry requires a non-empty string 'name'");
00258: 
00259:   llvm::StringRef name = nameAttr.getValue();
00260:   if (!isCIdentifier(name)) {
00261:     return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00262:         func, llvm::Twine("argument '") + name +
00263:                   "' requires a C identifier name for generated launcher API");
00264:   }
00265:   if (name == "rt" || name == "qpu_id" || name == "num_qpus") {
00266:     return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00267:         func, llvm::Twine("argument '") + name +
00268:                   "' uses a reserved launcher/runtime or builtin name");
00269:   }
00270:   if (hasLaunchABIArgumentName(launchABI, name)) {
00271:     return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00272:         func, llvm::Twine("argument '") + name +
00273:                   "' duplicates a generated public API parameter name");
00274:   }
00275: 
00276:   auto kindAttr = getDictionaryStringAttr(argDict, "kind");
00277:   auto directionAttr = getDictionaryStringAttr(argDict, "direction");
00278:   if (!kindAttr || !directionAttr) {
00279:     return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00280:         func, llvm::Twine("argument '") + name +
00281:                   "' requires string 'kind' and 'direction' metadata");
00282:   }
00283: 
00284:   std::optional<int64_t> uniformIndex =
00285:       getDictionaryIntegerAttrValue(argDict, "uniform_index");
00286:   if (!uniformIndex) {
00287:     return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00288:         func, llvm::Twine("argument '") + name +
00289:                   "' requires signless i32 'uniform_index'");
00290:   }
00291: 
00292:   LaunchABIArgumentModel parsed;
00293:   parsed.name = name.str();
00294:   parsed.direction = directionAttr.getValue().str();
00295:   parsed.uniformIndex = *uniformIndex;
00296: 
00297:   llvm::StringRef kind = kindAttr.getValue();
00298:   if (kind == "scalar") {
00299:     if (directionAttr.getValue() != "by_value") {
00300:       return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00301:           func, llvm::Twine("scalar argument '") + name +
00302:                     "' requires direction = \"by_value\"");
00303:     }
00304:     auto typeAttr = getDictionaryStringAttr(argDict, "type");
00305:     if (!typeAttr) {
00306:       return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00307:           func, llvm::Twine("scalar argument '") + name +
00308:                     "' requires string 'type'");
00309:     }
00310:     std::optional<std::string> cType = getScalarCType(typeAttr.getValue());
00311:     if (!cType) {
00312:       return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00313:           func, llvm::Twine("scalar argument '") + name +
00314:                     "' has unsupported type for generated launcher API");
00315:     }
00316:     parsed.kind = LaunchABIArgumentKind::Scalar;
00317:     parsed.scalarType = typeAttr.getValue().str();
00318:     parsed.cType = *cType;
00319:     launchABI.arguments.push_back(std::move(parsed));
00320:     return success();
00321:   }
00322: 
00323:   if (kind == "buffer") {
00324:     auto elemTypeAttr = getDictionaryStringAttr(argDict, "elem_type");
00325:     if (!elemTypeAttr) {
00326:       return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00327:           func, llvm::Twine("buffer argument '") + name +
00328:                     "' requires string 'elem_type'");
00329:     }
00330:     std::optional<std::string> cType =
00331:         getBufferCType(directionAttr.getValue(), elemTypeAttr.getValue());
00332:     if (!cType) {
00333:       return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00334:           func, llvm::Twine("buffer argument '") + name +
00335:                     "' has unsupported direction or elem_type for generated "
00336:                     "launcher API");
00337:     }
00338:     parsed.kind = LaunchABIArgumentKind::Buffer;
00339:     parsed.elementType = elemTypeAttr.getValue().str();
00340:     parsed.cType = *cType;
00341:     launchABI.arguments.push_back(std::move(parsed));
00342:     return success();
00343:   }
00344: 
00345:   return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00346:       func, llvm::Twine("argument '") + name +
00347:                 "' requires kind = \"scalar\" or \"buffer\"");
00348: }

00386: static std::string canonicalizeKernelPublicName(llvm::StringRef rawName) {
00387:   // vc4.launch_abi.public_name names the public kernel.  Historically many
00388:   // fixtures used a *_launch spelling because the only public API was the
00389:   // generated launch stub.  Canonical M2 program artifacts name the kernel,
00390:   // QASM artifact, manifest entry, layout regions, and default code symbol
00391:   // without that launcher suffix; the generated C API adds *_launch at the
00392:   // function boundary.
00393:   constexpr const char *launchSuffix = "_launch";
00394:   constexpr size_t launchSuffixLen = 7;
00395:   std::string name = rawName.str();
00396:   if (name.size() > launchSuffixLen &&
00397:       name.compare(name.size() - launchSuffixLen, launchSuffixLen,
00398:                    launchSuffix) == 0)
00399:     name.resize(name.size() - launchSuffixLen);
00400:   return name;
00401: }

00403: static LogicalResult parseLaunchABIModel(mlir::vc4::FuncOp func,
00404:                                          mlir::DictionaryAttr launchABIDict,
00405:                                          LaunchABIModel &launchABI) {
00406:   auto publicName = getDictionaryStringAttr(launchABIDict, "public_name");
00407:   if (!publicName || publicName.getValue().empty()) {
00408:     return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00409:         func, "requires non-empty string 'public_name'");
00410:   }
00411:   if (!isCIdentifier(publicName.getValue())) {
00412:     return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00413:         func, "public_name must be a C identifier for generated launcher API");
00414:   }
00415: 
00416:   auto codeSymbol = getDictionaryStringAttr(launchABIDict, "code_symbol");
00417:   if (codeSymbol) {
00418:     if (codeSymbol.getValue().empty()) {
00419:       return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00420:           func, "code_symbol must be a non-empty C identifier when present");
00421:     }
00422:     if (!isCIdentifier(codeSymbol.getValue())) {
00423:       return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00424:           func, "code_symbol must be a C identifier for generated code arrays");
00425:     }
00426:   }
00427: 
00428:   auto tailPolicy = getDictionaryStringAttr(launchABIDict, "tail_policy");
00429:   if (!tailPolicy || tailPolicy.getValue().empty()) {
00430:     return emitLaunchABIModelError(func,
00431:                                    "requires string 'tail_policy' metadata");
00432:   }
00433: 
00434:   std::optional<int64_t> uniformWords =
00435:       getDictionaryIntegerAttrValue(launchABIDict, "uniform_words_per_qpu");
00436:   if (!uniformWords || *uniformWords <= 0) {
00437:     return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00438:         func, "requires positive signless i32 'uniform_words_per_qpu'");
00439:   }
00440: 
00441:   auto args = llvm::dyn_cast_or_null<mlir::ArrayAttr>(launchABIDict.get("args"));
00442:   auto builtins =
00443:       llvm::dyn_cast_or_null<mlir::ArrayAttr>(launchABIDict.get("builtins"));
00444:   if (!args || !builtins) {
00445:     return emitLaunchABIModelError(func,
00446:                                    "requires array 'args' and 'builtins'");
00447:   }
00448: 
00449:   LaunchABIModel parsed;
00450:   parsed.publicName = canonicalizeKernelPublicName(publicName.getValue());
00451:   parsed.codeSymbol = codeSymbol ? codeSymbol.getValue().str()
00452:                                  : parsed.publicName + "_shader";
00453:   parsed.tailPolicy = tailPolicy.getValue().str();
00454:   parsed.uniformWordsPerQPU = *uniformWords;
00455: 
00456:   for (mlir::Attribute argAttr : args) {
00457:     auto argDict = llvm::dyn_cast<mlir::DictionaryAttr>(argAttr);
00458:     if (!argDict) {
00459:       return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00460:           func, "argument entries must be dictionary attributes");
00461:     }
00462:     if (failed(parseLaunchABIArgument(func, argDict, parsed)))
00463:       return failure();
00464:   }
00465: 
00466:   for (mlir::Attribute builtinAttr : builtins) {
00467:     auto builtinDict = llvm::dyn_cast<mlir::DictionaryAttr>(builtinAttr);
00468:     if (!builtinDict) {
00469:       return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00470:           func, "builtin entries must be dictionary attributes");
00471:     }
00472:     if (failed(parseLaunchABIBuiltin(func, builtinDict, parsed)))
00473:       return failure();
00474:   }
00475: 
00476:   launchABI = std::move(parsed);
00477:   return success();
00478: }
00479: 
00480: static LogicalResult markLaunchABIUniformIndex(
00481:     mlir::vc4::FuncOp func, const llvm::Twine &ownerName,
00482:     int64_t uniformIndex, llvm::SmallVectorImpl<char> &seenUniformIndices) {
00483:   if (uniformIndex < 0 ||
00484:       uniformIndex >= static_cast<int64_t>(seenUniformIndices.size())) {
00485:     return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00486:         func, ownerName +
00487:                   " uniform_index is outside [0, uniform_words_per_qpu)");
00488:   }
00489: 
00490:   if (seenUniformIndices[uniformIndex]) {
00491:     return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00492:         func, ownerName + " duplicates another physical uniform_index");
00493:   }
00494: 
00495:   seenUniformIndices[uniformIndex] = 1;
00496:   return success();
00497: }
00498: 
00499: static LogicalResult validateLaunchABIUniformPacking(
00500:     mlir::vc4::FuncOp func, const LaunchABIModel &launchABI) {
00501:   llvm::SmallVector<char, 16> seenUniformIndices;
00502:   seenUniformIndices.resize(
00503:       static_cast<size_t>(launchABI.uniformWordsPerQPU));
00504:   for (char &seen : seenUniformIndices)
00505:     seen = 0;
00506: 
00507:   for (const LaunchABIArgumentModel &arg : launchABI.arguments) {
00508:     if (failed(markLaunchABIUniformIndex(
00509:             func, llvm::Twine("argument '") + arg.name + "'",
00510:             arg.uniformIndex, seenUniformIndices)))
00511:       return failure();
00512:   }
00513: 
00514:   for (const LaunchABIBuiltinModel &builtin : launchABI.builtins) {
00515:     if (builtin.materialization != "uniform_suffix") {
00516:       if (builtin.uniformIndex) {
00517:         return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00518:             func, llvm::Twine("non-uniform builtin '") + builtin.name +
00519:                       "' must not carry a uniform_index for launcher packing");
00520:       }
00521:       continue;
00522:     }
00523: 
00524:     if (!builtin.uniformIndex) {
00525:       return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00526:           func, llvm::Twine("uniform_suffix builtin '") + builtin.name +
00527:                     "' requires a uniform_index for launcher packing");
00528:     }
00529: 
00530:     if (failed(markLaunchABIUniformIndex(
00531:             func, llvm::Twine("builtin '") + builtin.name + "'",
00532:             *builtin.uniformIndex, seenUniformIndices)))
00533:       return failure();
00534:   }
00535: 
00536:   for (size_t index = 0; index != seenUniformIndices.size(); ++index) {
00537:     if (seenUniformIndices[index])
00538:       continue;
00539:     return emitLaunchABIModelError(
00540:         func, llvm::Twine("launcher packing requires dense physical "
00541:                           "uniform_index coverage; missing index ") +
00542:                   llvm::Twine(static_cast<unsigned>(index)));
00543:   }
00544: 
00545:   return success();
00546: }
00547: 
00548: static constexpr int64_t kVC4TargetActiveQPUs = 12;
00549: static constexpr int64_t kVC4TargetVPMBytes = 4096;
00550: static constexpr int64_t kVC4TargetSemaphores = 16;
00551: static constexpr int64_t kVC4VPMRowBytes = 64;
00552: 
00553: static int64_t ceilDivPositive(int64_t value, int64_t divisor) {
00554:   if (value <= 0)
00555:     return 0;
00556:   return 1 + (value - 1) / divisor;
00557: }
00558: 
00559: static int64_t resourceLimitFor(int64_t total, int64_t perBlock) {
00560:   if (perBlock <= 0)
00561:     return total;
00562:   return total / perBlock;
00563: }
00564: 
00565: static int64_t min3(int64_t a, int64_t b, int64_t c) {
00566:   return std::min(a, std::min(b, c));
00567: }
00568: 
00569: static LogicalResult parseResourceModel(mlir::vc4::FuncOp func,
00570:                                         mlir::DictionaryAttr resourceDict,
00571:                                         KernelResourceModel &resources) {
00572:   KernelResourceModel parsed;
00573:   if (!resourceDict) {
00574:     resources = std::move(parsed);
00575:     return success();
00576:   }
00577: 
00578:   if (auto scheduleMode = getDictionaryStringAttr(resourceDict, "schedule_mode"))
00579:     parsed.scheduleMode = scheduleMode.getValue().str();
00580: 
00581:   if (parsed.scheduleMode != "independent_vector" &&
00582:       parsed.scheduleMode != "cooperative_block") {
00583:     return emitResourceModelError(func,
00584:         "requires schedule_mode = \"independent_vector\" or \"cooperative_block\"");
00585:   }
00586: 
00587:   parsed.usesBarrier = getDictionaryBoolAttrValue(resourceDict, "uses_barrier").value_or(false);
00588:   parsed.usesSharedVPM = getDictionaryBoolAttrValue(resourceDict, "uses_shared_vpm").value_or(false);
00589:   parsed.requireFullBlockResidency = getDictionaryBoolAttrValue(resourceDict, "require_full_block_residency")
00590:       .value_or(parsed.usesBarrier || parsed.usesSharedVPM || parsed.scheduleMode == "cooperative_block");
00591: 
00592:   if (std::optional<int64_t> warps = getDictionaryIntegerAttrValue(resourceDict, "warps_per_block_max"))
00593:     parsed.warpsPerBlockMax = *warps;
00594:   else if (parsed.scheduleMode == "cooperative_block")
00595:     parsed.warpsPerBlockMax = kVC4TargetActiveQPUs;
00596: 
00597:   if (std::optional<int64_t> semaphores = getDictionaryIntegerAttrValue(resourceDict, "semaphores_per_block"))
00598:     parsed.semaphoresPerBlock = *semaphores;
00599:   else if (parsed.usesBarrier)
00600:     parsed.semaphoresPerBlock = 4;
00601: 
00602:   if (std::optional<int64_t> vpmBytes = getDictionaryIntegerAttrValue(resourceDict, "vpm_bytes_per_block"))
00603:     parsed.vpmBytesPerBlock = *vpmBytes;
00604:   if (std::optional<int64_t> sharedVPMBytes = getDictionaryIntegerAttrValue(resourceDict, "shared_vpm_bytes"))
00605:     parsed.vpmBytesPerBlock = *sharedVPMBytes;
00606:   if (std::optional<int64_t> vpmRows = getDictionaryIntegerAttrValue(resourceDict, "vpm_rows_per_block"))
00607:     parsed.vpmRowsPerBlock = *vpmRows;
00608:   else
00609:     parsed.vpmRowsPerBlock = ceilDivPositive(parsed.vpmBytesPerBlock, kVC4VPMRowBytes);
00610: 
00611:   if (parsed.warpsPerBlockMax <= 0)
00612:     return emitResourceModelError(func, "warps_per_block_max must be greater than zero");
00613:   if (parsed.semaphoresPerBlock < 0)
00614:     return emitResourceModelError(func, "semaphores_per_block must be non-negative");
00615:   if (parsed.vpmBytesPerBlock < 0 || parsed.vpmRowsPerBlock < 0)
00616:     return emitResourceModelError(func, "vpm_bytes_per_block/shared_vpm_bytes must be non-negative");
00617: 
00618:   if (parsed.scheduleMode == "independent_vector") {
00619:     if (parsed.usesBarrier || parsed.usesSharedVPM || parsed.requireFullBlockResidency ||
00620:         parsed.semaphoresPerBlock != 0 || parsed.vpmBytesPerBlock != 0)
00621:       return emitResourceModelError(func, "independent_vector kernels must not request barrier/shared cooperative resources");
00622:     parsed.warpsPerBlockMax = 1;
00623:     parsed.maxResidentBlocks = kVC4TargetActiveQPUs;
00624:     resources = std::move(parsed);
00625:     return success();
00626:   }
00627: 
00628:   if ((parsed.usesBarrier || parsed.usesSharedVPM) && !parsed.requireFullBlockResidency)
00629:     return emitResourceModelError(func, "cooperative barrier/shared kernels require require_full_block_residency = true");
00630:   if (parsed.warpsPerBlockMax > kVC4TargetActiveQPUs)
00631:     return emitResourceModelError(func, llvm::Twine("warps_per_block_max must fit the target active QPU limit 12; got ") + llvm::Twine(parsed.warpsPerBlockMax));
00632:   if (parsed.semaphoresPerBlock > kVC4TargetSemaphores)
00633:     return emitResourceModelError(func, llvm::Twine("semaphores_per_block must fit the target hardware semaphore limit 16; got ") + llvm::Twine(parsed.semaphoresPerBlock));
00634:   if (parsed.usesBarrier && parsed.semaphoresPerBlock <= 0)
00635:     return emitResourceModelError(func, "barrier cooperative kernels require semaphores_per_block > 0");
00636:   if (parsed.vpmBytesPerBlock > kVC4TargetVPMBytes)
00637:     return emitResourceModelError(func, llvm::Twine("vpm_bytes_per_block/shared_vpm_bytes must fit the 4096 byte user-visible VPM window; got ") + llvm::Twine(parsed.vpmBytesPerBlock));
00638: 
00639:   int64_t byQPU = resourceLimitFor(kVC4TargetActiveQPUs, parsed.warpsPerBlockMax);
00640:   int64_t bySem = resourceLimitFor(kVC4TargetSemaphores, parsed.semaphoresPerBlock);
00641:   int64_t byVPM = resourceLimitFor(kVC4TargetVPMBytes, parsed.vpmBytesPerBlock);
00642:   parsed.maxResidentBlocks = min3(byQPU, bySem, byVPM);
00643:   if (parsed.maxResidentBlocks <= 0)
00644:     return emitResourceModelError(func, "cooperative_block resource request leaves zero resident_blocks; check warps_per_block_max, vpm_bytes_per_block, and semaphores_per_block");
00645: 
00646:   resources = std::move(parsed);
00647:   return success();
00648: }
00649: 
00650: static LogicalResult populateResourceInfo(KernelRecord &kernel) {
00651:   auto resource = kernel.func->getAttrOfType<mlir::DictionaryAttr>("vc4.resource");
00652:   return parseResourceModel(kernel.func, resource, kernel.resources);
00653: }

00655: static const char *getScheduleModeMacro(const KernelResourceModel &resources) {
00656:   if (resources.scheduleMode == "cooperative_block")
00657:     return "VC4_KERNEL_SCHEDULE_COOPERATIVE_BLOCK";
00658:   return "VC4_KERNEL_SCHEDULE_INDEPENDENT_VECTOR";
00659: }

00661: static std::string getKernelResourceFlagsExpression(const KernelResourceModel &resources) {
00662:   std::string flags = "0u";
00663:   auto addFlag = [&](const char *flag) {
00664:     if (flags == "0u")
00665:       flags = flag;
00666:     else
00667:       flags += std::string(" | ") + flag;
00668:   };
00669:   if (resources.scheduleMode == "cooperative_block") addFlag("VC4_KERNEL_FLAG_COOPERATIVE_BLOCK");
00670:   if (resources.requireFullBlockResidency) addFlag("VC4_KERNEL_FLAG_REQUIRE_FULL_BLOCK_RESIDENCY");
00671:   if (resources.usesBarrier) addFlag("VC4_KERNEL_FLAG_USES_BARRIER");
00672:   if (resources.usesSharedVPM) addFlag("VC4_KERNEL_FLAG_USES_SHARED_VPM");
00673:   return flags;
00674: }

00676: static void appendJSONEscapedString(llvm::raw_ostream &os,
00677:                                     llvm::StringRef value) {
00678:   static constexpr char hex[] = "0123456789abcdef";
00679:   os << '"';
00680:   for (unsigned char c : value) {
00681:     switch (c) {
00682:     case '"':
00683:       os << "\\\"";
00684:       break;
00685:     case '\\':
00686:       os << "\\\\";
00687:       break;
00688:     case '\b':
00689:       os << "\\b";
00690:       break;
00691:     case '\f':
00692:       os << "\\f";
00693:       break;
00694:     case '\n':
00695:       os << "\\n";
00696:       break;
00697:     case '\r':
00698:       os << "\\r";
00699:       break;
00700:     case '\t':
00701:       os << "\\t";
00702:       break;
00703:     default:
00704:       if (c < 0x20) {
00705:         os << "\\u00" << hex[c >> 4] << hex[c & 0xf];
00706:       } else {
00707:         os << c;
00708:       }
00709:       break;
00710:     }
00711:   }
00712:   os << '"';
00713: }

00715: static LogicalResult appendScheduledSinkOp(
00716:     mlir::Operation *op, llvm::SmallVectorImpl<mlir::Operation *> &stream);
00717: 
00718: static bool isThreadEndScheduledOp(mlir::Operation *op) {
00719:   auto bundle = llvm::dyn_cast<mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp>(op);
00720:   return bundle && bundle.getSig() == mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::thrend;
00721: }
00722: 
00723: static bool isNonBranchScheduledDelaySlotOpWithoutThreadEnd(
00724:     mlir::Operation *op) {
00725:   if (auto bundle = llvm::dyn_cast<mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp>(op))
00726:     return bundle.getSig() != mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::thrend;
00727:   return llvm::isa<mlir::vc4::QPULDIOp, mlir::vc4::QPUSemaOp>(op);
00728: }
00729: 
00730: static mlir::InFlightDiagnostic emitInvalidQASMEpilogueDiag(
00731:     mlir::vc4::FuncOp func) {
00732:   return func.emitOpError(
00733:       "is not directly emittable: qasm input requires an explicit thrend plus "
00734:       "two delay-slot instructions at the end of the flattened scheduled "
00735:       "instruction stream");
00736: }
00737: 
00738: static LogicalResult appendBranchDelaySlotSinkOps(
00739:     mlir::vc4::QPUBranchOp branch,
00740:     llvm::SmallVectorImpl<mlir::Operation *> &stream) {
00741:   if (!branch.getDelaySlots().hasOneBlock()) {
00742:     return branch.emitOpError()
00743:            << "requires exactly one delay-slot block for artifact emission";
00744:   }
00745: 
00746:   for (mlir::Operation &delaySlotOp : branch.getDelaySlots().front()) {
00747:     if (mlir::failed(appendScheduledSinkOp(&delaySlotOp, stream)))
00748:       return failure();
00749:   }
00750:   return success();
00751: }
00752: 
00753: static LogicalResult appendScheduledSinkOp(
00754:     mlir::Operation *op, llvm::SmallVectorImpl<mlir::Operation *> &stream) {
00755:   if (llvm::isa<mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp, mlir::vc4::QPULDIOp,
00756:                 mlir::vc4::QPUSemaOp>(op)) {
00757:     stream.push_back(op);
00758:     return success();
00759:   }
00760: 
00761:   if (auto branch = llvm::dyn_cast<mlir::vc4::QPUBranchOp>(op)) {
00762:     stream.push_back(op);
00763:     return appendBranchDelaySlotSinkOps(branch, stream);
00764:   }
00765: 
00766:   return op->emitOpError()
00767:          << "is not a supported final scheduled VC4 QPU sink op for "
00768:             "artifact emission";
00769: }
00770: 
00771: static LogicalResult verifyThreadEndEpilogue(
00772:     mlir::vc4::FuncOp func, llvm::ArrayRef<mlir::Operation *> stream) {
00773:   if (stream.size() < 3) {
00774:     auto diag = emitInvalidQASMEpilogueDiag(func);
00775:     diag << "; found only " << static_cast<unsigned>(stream.size())
00776:          << " scheduled instruction slot(s)";
00777:     return failure();
00778:   }
00779: 
00780:   const size_t threadEndIndex = stream.size() - 3;
00781:   auto threadEndBundle =
00782:       llvm::dyn_cast<mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp>(stream[threadEndIndex]);
00783:   if (!threadEndBundle ||
00784:       threadEndBundle.getSig() != mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::thrend) {
00785:     auto diag = emitInvalidQASMEpilogueDiag(func);
00786:     diag << "; slot N-3 must be a vc4.qpu.bundle with sig = "
00787:             "#vc4.qpu_signal<thrend>";
00788:     return failure();
00789:   }
00790: 
00791:   for (size_t i = 0; i != threadEndIndex; ++i) {
00792:     if (!isThreadEndScheduledOp(stream[i]))
00793:       continue;
00794:     auto diag = emitInvalidQASMEpilogueDiag(func);
00795:     diag << "; found an earlier vc4.qpu.bundle with sig = "
00796:             "#vc4.qpu_signal<thrend> before slot N-3";
00797:     return failure();
00798:   }
00799: 
00800:   if (!isNonBranchScheduledDelaySlotOpWithoutThreadEnd(
00801:           stream[threadEndIndex + 1]) ||
00802:       !isNonBranchScheduledDelaySlotOpWithoutThreadEnd(
00803:           stream[threadEndIndex + 2])) {
00804:     auto diag = emitInvalidQASMEpilogueDiag(func);
00805:     diag << "; only slot N-3 may carry sig = #vc4.qpu_signal<thrend>; "
00806:             "slots N-2 and N-1 must be non-branch scheduled ops without "
00807:             "another thread-end signal";
00808:     return failure();
00809:   }
00810: 
00811:   return success();
00812: }
00813: 
00814: static LogicalResult populateScheduledSinkInfo(KernelRecord &kernel) {
00815:   if (!kernel.func.getBody().hasOneBlock()) {
00816:     return kernel.func.emitOpError()
00817:            << "requires a single top-level block for artifact emission";
00818:   }
00819: 
00820:   llvm::SmallVector<mlir::Operation *, 16> stream;
00821:   for (mlir::Operation &op : kernel.func.getBody().front()) {
00822:     if (mlir::failed(appendScheduledSinkOp(&op, stream)))
00823:       return failure();
00824:   }
00825: 
00826:   if (mlir::failed(verifyThreadEndEpilogue(kernel.func, stream)))
00827:     return failure();
00828: 
00829:   kernel.info.scheduledOpCount = static_cast<unsigned>(stream.size());
00830:   kernel.scheduledStream.clear();
00831:   kernel.scheduledStream.append(stream.begin(), stream.end());
00832:   return success();
00833: }
00834: 
00835: static LogicalResult populateLaunchABIInfo(KernelRecord &kernel) {
00836:   auto launchABI =
00837:       kernel.func->getAttrOfType<mlir::DictionaryAttr>("vc4.launch_abi");
00838:   if (!launchABI) {
00839:     return kernel.func.emitOpError()
00840:            << "requires a dictionary \"vc4.launch_abi\" attribute";
00841:   }
00842: 
00843:   if (failed(parseLaunchABIModel(kernel.func, launchABI, kernel.launchABI)))
00844:     return failure();
00845:   if (failed(validateLaunchABIUniformPacking(kernel.func, kernel.launchABI)))
00846:     return failure();
00847: 
00848:   kernel.info.symbolName = kernel.func.getSymName().str();
00849:   kernel.info.publicName = kernel.launchABI.publicName;
00850:   kernel.info.uniformWordsPerQPU = kernel.launchABI.uniformWordsPerQPU;
00851:   return success();
00852: }

00859: static constexpr uint64_t kVC4ProgramLayoutAlignment = 8;
00860: static constexpr uint64_t kVC4ProgramHeaderBytes = 64;
00861: static constexpr uint64_t kVC4KernelDescriptorBytes = 32;
00862: static constexpr uint64_t kVC4MaxRequestsPerWave = 12;
00863: static constexpr uint64_t kVC4RuntimeBookkeepingBytes = 48;
00864: static constexpr uint64_t kVC4HeapAlignment = 16;
00865: static constexpr uint64_t kVC4ReservedHeapBytes = 65536;
00866: 
00867: static uint64_t alignUpTo(uint64_t value, uint64_t alignment) {
00868:   if (alignment <= 1)
00869:     return value;
00870:   return (value + alignment - 1) & ~(alignment - 1);
00871: }

00885: static void appendProgramLayoutRegion(ProgramLayoutModel &layout,
00886:                                       llvm::StringRef name,
00887:                                       llvm::StringRef kind,
00888:                                       uint64_t offset, uint64_t size,
00889:                                       std::optional<unsigned> kernelId = std::nullopt) {
00890:   ProgramLayoutRegion region;
00891:   region.name = name.str();
00892:   region.kind = kind.str();
00893:   region.offset = offset;
00894:   region.size = size;
00895:   region.alignment = kVC4ProgramLayoutAlignment;
00896:   region.kernelId = kernelId;
00897:   layout.regions.push_back(std::move(region));
00898: }
00899: 
00900: static ProgramLayoutModel
00901: buildProgramLayoutModel(llvm::ArrayRef<KernelRecord> kernels) {
00902:   ProgramLayoutModel layout;
00903:   layout.alignment = kVC4ProgramLayoutAlignment;
00904:   layout.heapBytes = kVC4ReservedHeapBytes;
00905: 
00906:   uint64_t offset = 0;
00907:   offset = alignUpTo(offset, layout.alignment);
00908:   appendProgramLayoutRegion(layout, "program_header", "program_header",
00909:                             offset, kVC4ProgramHeaderBytes);
00910:   offset += kVC4ProgramHeaderBytes;
00911: 
00912:   offset = alignUpTo(offset, layout.alignment);
00913:   uint64_t descriptorTableOffset = offset;
00914:   uint64_t descriptorTableSize = kernels.size() * kVC4KernelDescriptorBytes;
00915:   appendProgramLayoutRegion(layout, "kernel_descriptor_table",
00916:                             "kernel_descriptor_table", offset,
00917:                             descriptorTableSize);
00918:   offset += descriptorTableSize;
00919: 
00920:   for (const KernelRecord &kernel : kernels) {
00921:     KernelLayoutRecord kernelLayout;
00922:     kernelLayout.kernelId = kernel.kernelId;
00923:     kernelLayout.publicName = kernel.info.publicName;
00924:     kernelLayout.codeSymbol = kernel.launchABI.codeSymbol;
00925:     kernelLayout.descriptorOffset =
00926:         descriptorTableOffset + kernel.kernelId * kVC4KernelDescriptorBytes;
00927:     kernelLayout.descriptorSize = kVC4KernelDescriptorBytes;
00928:     kernelLayout.uniformWordsPerRequest = kernel.info.uniformWordsPerQPU;
00929:     kernelLayout.maxRequestsPerWave = kVC4MaxRequestsPerWave;
00930: 
00931:     offset = alignUpTo(offset, layout.alignment);
00932:     kernelLayout.codeOffset = offset;
00933:     kernelLayout.codeWords =
00934:         static_cast<uint64_t>(kernel.info.scheduledOpCount) * 2u;
00935:     kernelLayout.codeSize = kernelLayout.codeWords * sizeof(uint32_t);
00936:     appendProgramLayoutRegion(layout, getKernelCodeRegionName(kernel), "code",
00937:                               kernelLayout.codeOffset,
00938:                               kernelLayout.codeSize, kernel.kernelId);
00939:     offset += kernelLayout.codeSize;
00940: 
00941:     offset = alignUpTo(offset, layout.alignment);
00942:     kernelLayout.uniformsOffset = offset;
00943:     kernelLayout.uniformsSize = kVC4MaxRequestsPerWave *
00944:                                 kernelLayout.uniformWordsPerRequest *
00945:                                 sizeof(uint32_t);
00946:     appendProgramLayoutRegion(layout, getKernelUniformRegionName(kernel),
00947:                               "uniforms", kernelLayout.uniformsOffset,
00948:                               kernelLayout.uniformsSize, kernel.kernelId);
00949:     offset += kernelLayout.uniformsSize;
00950: 
00951:     offset = alignUpTo(offset, layout.alignment);
00952:     kernelLayout.unifPtrOffset = offset;
00953:     kernelLayout.unifPtrSize = kVC4MaxRequestsPerWave * sizeof(uint32_t);
00954:     appendProgramLayoutRegion(layout, getKernelUnifPtrRegionName(kernel),
00955:                               "unif_ptrs", kernelLayout.unifPtrOffset,
00956:                               kernelLayout.unifPtrSize, kernel.kernelId);
00957:     offset += kernelLayout.unifPtrSize;
00958: 
00959:     layout.kernels.push_back(std::move(kernelLayout));
00960:   }
00961: 
00962:   offset = alignUpTo(offset, layout.alignment);
00963:   appendProgramLayoutRegion(layout, "runtime_bookkeeping",
00964:                             "runtime_bookkeeping", offset,
00965:                             kVC4RuntimeBookkeepingBytes);
00966:   offset += kVC4RuntimeBookkeepingBytes;
00967: 
00968:   offset = alignUpTo(offset, kVC4HeapAlignment);
00969:   layout.heapOffset = offset;
00970:   appendProgramLayoutRegion(layout, "heap", "heap", layout.heapOffset,
00971:                             layout.heapBytes);
00972:   offset += layout.heapBytes;
00973: 
00974:   layout.staticBytes = offset;
00975:   layout.programBytes = offset;
00976:   return layout;
00977: }
00978: 
00979: static LogicalResult rejectDuplicateKernelPublicNames(
00980:     mlir::vc4::ModuleOp vc4Module, llvm::ArrayRef<KernelRecord> kernels) {
00981:   for (size_t i = 0; i != kernels.size(); ++i) {
00982:     for (size_t j = 0; j != i; ++j) {
00983:       if (kernels[i].info.publicName != kernels[j].info.publicName)
00984:         continue;
00985:       return vc4Module.emitOpError()
00986:              << "duplicate public_name '" << kernels[i].info.publicName
00987:              << "' in VC4 QPU program artifact";
00988:     }
00989:   }
00990:   return success();
00991: }
00992: 
00993: static LogicalResult rejectDuplicateKernelCodeSymbols(
00994:     mlir::vc4::ModuleOp vc4Module, llvm::ArrayRef<KernelRecord> kernels) {
00995:   for (size_t i = 0; i != kernels.size(); ++i) {
00996:     for (size_t j = 0; j != i; ++j) {
00997:       if (kernels[i].launchABI.codeSymbol != kernels[j].launchABI.codeSymbol)
00998:         continue;
00999:       return vc4Module.emitOpError()
01000:              << "duplicate code_symbol '" << kernels[i].launchABI.codeSymbol
01001:              << "' in VC4 QPU program artifact";
01002:     }
01003:   }
01004:   return success();
01005: }
01006: 
01007: static LogicalResult
01008: collectProgramKernels(mlir::vc4::ModuleOp vc4Module,
01009:                       llvm::SmallVectorImpl<KernelRecord> &kernels) {
01010:   vc4Module.walk([&](mlir::vc4::FuncOp func) {
01011:     if (isScheduledQPUKernel(func))
01012:       kernels.emplace_back(func);
01013:   });
01014: 
01015:   if (kernels.empty()) {
01016:     return vc4Module.emitOpError()
01017:            << "expected at least one eligible VC4 QPU kernel: one or more "
01018:               "kernel qpu scheduled vc4.func ops for program artifact emission";
01019:   }
01020: 
01021:   for (KernelRecord &kernel : kernels) {
01022:     if (failed(populateLaunchABIInfo(kernel)))
01023:       return failure();
01024:     if (failed(populateResourceInfo(kernel)))
01025:       return failure();
01026:   }
01027: 
01028:   if (failed(rejectDuplicateKernelPublicNames(vc4Module, kernels)))
01029:     return failure();
01030:   if (failed(rejectDuplicateKernelCodeSymbols(vc4Module, kernels)))
01031:     return failure();
01032: 
01033:   for (size_t i = 0; i != kernels.size(); ++i) {
01034:     KernelRecord &kernel = kernels[i];
01035:     kernel.kernelId = static_cast<unsigned>(i);
01036:     kernel.qasmPath = makeKernelQASMPath(kernel.info.publicName);
01037:     if (failed(populateScheduledSinkInfo(kernel)))
01038:       return failure();
01039:   }
01040: 
01041:   return success();
01042: }
01043: 
01044: static LogicalResult writeTextFile(
01045:     mlir::Operation *diagOp, llvm::StringRef path,
01046:     llvm::function_ref<void(llvm::raw_ostream &)> emit) {
01047:   std::error_code ec;
01048:   llvm::raw_fd_ostream os(path, ec, llvm::sys::fs::CD_CreateAlways,
01049:                           llvm::sys::fs::FA_Write, llvm::sys::fs::OF_Text);
01050:   if (ec) {
01051:     return diagOp->emitError()
01052:            << "failed to open artifact file '" << path << "': "
01053:            << ec.message();
01054:   }
01055: 
01056:   emit(os);
01057:   os.flush();
01058:   if (os.has_error()) {
01059:     std::error_code writeError = os.error();
01060:     os.clear_error();
01061:     return diagOp->emitError()
01062:            << "failed to write artifact file '" << path << "': "
01063:            << writeError.message();
01064:   }
01065: 
01066:   return success();
01067: }
01068: 
01069: static LogicalResult writeBundleFile(
01070:     mlir::Operation *diagOp, llvm::StringRef bundleDir, llvm::StringRef fileName,
01071:     llvm::function_ref<void(llvm::raw_ostream &)> emit) {
01072:   llvm::SmallString<256> path(bundleDir);
01073:   llvm::sys::path::append(path, fileName);
01074: 
01075:   llvm::SmallString<256> parent(path);
01076:   llvm::sys::path::remove_filename(parent);
01077:   std::error_code ec = llvm::sys::fs::create_directories(parent);
01078:   if (ec) {
01079:     return diagOp->emitError()
01080:            << "failed to create artifact directory '" << parent << "': "
01081:            << ec.message();
01082:   }
01083: 
01084:   return writeTextFile(diagOp, path, emit);
01085: }

01087: static LogicalResult ensureAdjacentVC4ASMTemplates(mlir::Operation *diagOp,
01088:                                                    llvm::StringRef bundleDir) {
01089:   llvm::SmallString<256> templateDir(bundleDir);
01090:   llvm::sys::path::remove_filename(templateDir);
01091:   llvm::sys::path::append(templateDir, "share", "vc4tmpl");
01092: 
01093:   std::error_code ec = llvm::sys::fs::create_directories(templateDir);
01094:   if (ec) {
01095:     return diagOp->emitError()
01096:            << "failed to create vc4asm template directory '" << templateDir
01097:            << "': " << ec.message();
01098:   }
01099: 
01100:   llvm::SmallString<256> templateHeader(templateDir);
01101:   llvm::sys::path::append(templateHeader, "template.h");
01102:   if (failed(writeTextFile(diagOp, templateHeader, [](llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
01103:         os << "#ifndef ___SYMBOLNAME____H\n";
01104:         os << "#define ___SYMBOLNAME____H\n\n";
01105:         os << "#include <stdint.h>\n\n";
01106:         os << "#ifdef __cplusplus\n";
01107:         os << "extern \"C\" {\n";
01108:         os << "#endif\n\n";
01109:         os << "extern uint32_t ___SYMBOLNAME___[___INSTCOUNT2___];\n";
01110:         os << "___SYMBOLDEFS___\n";
01111:         os << "#ifdef __cplusplus\n";
01112:         os << "}\n";
01113:         os << "#endif\n\n";
01114:         os << "#endif\n";
01115:       })))
01116:     return failure();
01117: 
01118:   llvm::SmallString<256> templateSource(templateDir);
01119:   llvm::sys::path::append(templateSource, "template.c");
01120:   if (failed(writeTextFile(diagOp, templateSource, [](llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
01121:         os << "#include \"___HEADERNAME___\"\n\n";
01122:         os << "#ifdef __cplusplus\n";
01123:         os << "extern \"C\" {\n";
01124:         os << "#endif\n\n";
01125:         os << "#ifdef _MSC_VER\n";
01126:         os << "__declspec(align(8))\n";
01127:         os << "#elif defined(__GNUC__)\n";
01128:         os << "__attribute__((aligned(8)))\n";
01129:         os << "#endif\n";
01130:         os << "uint32_t ___SYMBOLNAME___[___INSTCOUNT2___] = {\n";
01131:         os << "___HEXDATA___";
01132:         os << "};\n\n";
01133:         os << "#ifdef __cplusplus\n";
01134:         os << "}\n";
01135:         os << "#endif\n";
01136:       })))
01137:     return failure();
01138: 
01139:   llvm::SmallString<256> templateHeaderNoInline(templateDir);
01140:   llvm::sys::path::append(templateHeaderNoInline, "template2.h");
01141:   if (failed(writeTextFile(diagOp, templateHeaderNoInline,
01142:                            [](llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
01143:                              os << "#ifndef ___SYMBOLNAME____H\n";
01144:                              os << "#define ___SYMBOLNAME____H\n\n";
01145:                              os << "#include <stdint.h>\n\n";
01146:                              os << "struct unspecified__;\n\n";
01147:                              os << "#ifdef __cplusplus\n";
01148:                              os << "extern \"C\" {\n";
01149:                              os << "#endif\n\n";
01150:                              os << "___SYMBOLIMPORTS___\n";
01151:                              os << "#ifdef __cplusplus\n";
01152:                              os << "}\n";
01153:                              os << "#endif\n\n";
01154:                              os << "___SYMBOLPROXIES___\n";
01155:                              os << "#endif\n";
01156:                            })))
01157:     return failure();
01158: 
01159:   return success();
01160: }

01280: static std::string formatSmallImmSelector(int64_t selector) {
01281:   if (selector >= 0 && selector <= 15)
01282:     return std::to_string(selector);
01283:   if (selector >= 16 && selector <= 31)
01284:     return std::to_string(selector - 32);
01285:   if (selector >= 32 && selector <= 39) {
01286:     int64_t value = int64_t{1} << (selector - 32);
01287:     return std::to_string(value) + ".0";
01288:   }
01289:   if (selector >= 40 && selector <= 47) {
01290:     int64_t denominator = int64_t{1} << (48 - selector);
01291:     return "1./" + std::to_string(denominator);
01292:   }
01293:   return "<unsupported-vector-rotate-small-imm>";
01294: }
01295: 
01296: static bool isVectorRotateSmallImm(int64_t selector) {
01297:   return selector >= 48 && selector <= 63;
01298: }

01301:   std::string result;

01308: static VPMTransferAliasKind normalizeVPMAliasKind(VPMTransferAliasKind kind) {
01309:   return kind == VPMTransferAliasKind::Read ? VPMTransferAliasKind::Read
01310:                                             : VPMTransferAliasKind::Write;

01315:              ? std::string("vr_setup")
01316:              : std::string("vw_setup");

01322:              : std::string("vw_addr");

01327:              ? std::string("vr_wait")
01328:              : std::string("vw_wait");

01331: static std::string formatReadAddress(char regFile, int64_t address,
01332:                                      VPMTransferAliasKind vpmKind =
01333:                                          VPMTransferAliasKind::Unknown) {
01334:   // vc4asm names several read-side peripheral addresses symbolically.  Do not
01335:   // print them as ordinary regfile locations: e.g. ra32 is not a uniform read
01336:   // in the source language the hardware reference uses.
01337:   switch (address) {
01338:   case 32:
01339:     return "unif";
01340:   case 38:
01341:     return "elem_num";
01342:   case 48:
01343:     return "vpm";
01344:   case 50:
01345:     return getVPMWaitName(vpmKind);
01346:   case 51:
01347:     return "mutex_acq";
01348:   default:
01349:     return formatRegFileAddress(regFile, address);
01350:   }
01351: }
01352: 
01353: static std::string formatWriteAddress(int64_t address, bool forAddALU,
01354:                                       bool writeSwap,
01355:                                       VPMTransferAliasKind vpmKind =
01356:                                           VPMTransferAliasKind::Unknown) {
01357:   if (address >= 32 && address <= 36)
01358:     return "r" + std::to_string(address - 32);
01359:   if (address == 37)
01360:     return "r5quad";
01361:   if (address == 39)
01362:     return "-";
01363: 
01364:   // vc4asm also requires symbolic names for side-effecting peripheral writes.
01365:   // Printing these as raw raN/rbN locations assembles the wrong artifact
01366:   // boundary for DMA/VPM/TMU traffic.  The VPM DMA setup and address registers
01367:   // share numeric QPU addresses between read-side (vr_*) and write-side (vw_*)
01368:   // forms, so the emitter tracks the setup literal flow through accumulator
01369:   // temporaries and chooses the corresponding vc4asm symbolic name.
01370:   switch (address) {
01371:   case 48:
01372:     return "vpm";
01373:   case 49:
01374:     return getVPMSetupName(vpmKind);
01375:   case 50:
01376:     return getVPMAddressName(vpmKind);
01377:   case 51:
01378:     return "mutex_rel";
01379:   case 56:
01380:     return "t0s";
01381:   default:
01382:     break;
01383:   }
01384: 
01385:   char regFile = forAddALU ? (writeSwap ? 'b' : 'a')
01386:                            : (writeSwap ? 'a' : 'b');
01387:   return formatRegFileAddress(regFile, address);
01388: }

01390: static std::string printAttributeToString(mlir::Attribute attr) {
01391:   std::string result;
01392:   llvm::raw_string_ostream os(result);
01393:   attr.print(os);
01394:   return result;
01395: }

01397: static std::optional<std::string> getPackSuffix(mlir::Attribute attr) {
01398:   if (!attr)
01399:     return std::string();
01400:   std::string text = printAttributeToString(attr);
01401:   if (text.find("<none>") != std::string::npos)
01402:     return std::string();
01403:   if (text.find("<to_16a>") != std::string::npos)
01404:     return std::string(".16a");
01405:   if (text.find("<to_16b>") != std::string::npos)
01406:     return std::string(".16b");
01407:   if (text.find("<to_8888>") != std::string::npos)
01408:     return std::string(".8888");
01409:   if (text.find("<to_8a>") != std::string::npos)
01410:     return std::string(".8a");
01411:   if (text.find("<to_8b>") != std::string::npos)
01412:     return std::string(".8b");
01413:   if (text.find("<to_8c>") != std::string::npos)
01414:     return std::string(".8c");
01415:   if (text.find("<to_8d>") != std::string::npos)
01416:     return std::string(".8d");
01417:   if (text.find("<sat32>") != std::string::npos)
01418:     return std::string(".32s");
01419:   if (text.find("<sat16a>") != std::string::npos)
01420:     return std::string(".16as");
01421:   if (text.find("<sat16b>") != std::string::npos)
01422:     return std::string(".16bs");
01423:   if (text.find("<sat8888>") != std::string::npos)
01424:     return std::string(".8888s");
01425:   if (text.find("<sat8a>") != std::string::npos)
01426:     return std::string(".8as");
01427:   if (text.find("<sat8b>") != std::string::npos)
01428:     return std::string(".8bs");
01429:   if (text.find("<sat8c>") != std::string::npos)
01430:     return std::string(".8cs");
01431:   if (text.find("<sat8d>") != std::string::npos)
01432:     return std::string(".8ds");
01433:   return std::nullopt;
01434: }
01435: 
01436: static std::optional<std::string> getUnpackSuffix(mlir::Attribute attr) {
01437:   if (!attr)
01438:     return std::string();
01439:   std::string text = printAttributeToString(attr);
01440:   if (text.find("<none>") != std::string::npos)
01441:     return std::string();
01442:   if (text.find("<f16a_or_i16a>") != std::string::npos ||
01443:       text.find("<f16a>") != std::string::npos)
01444:     return std::string(".16a");
01445:   if (text.find("<f16b_or_i16b>") != std::string::npos ||
01446:       text.find("<f16b>") != std::string::npos)
01447:     return std::string(".16b");
01448:   if (text.find("<replicate_8d>") != std::string::npos)
01449:     return std::string(".8dr");
01450:   if (text.find("<color8a>") != std::string::npos)
01451:     return std::string(".8a");
01452:   if (text.find("<color8b>") != std::string::npos)
01453:     return std::string(".8b");
01454:   if (text.find("<color8c>") != std::string::npos)
01455:     return std::string(".8c");
01456:   if (text.find("<color8d>") != std::string::npos)
01457:     return std::string(".8d");
01458:   return std::nullopt;
01459: }
