01465: static LogicalResult formatMuxSource(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle,
01466:                                      mlir::vc4::QPUMux mux,
01467:                                      std::string unpackSuffix,
01468:                                      VPMTransferAliasKind vpmKind,
01469:                                      std::string &out) {
01470:   int64_t raddrA = getIntegerAttrValue(bundle.getOperation(), "raddr_a");
01471:   std::optional<int64_t> raddrB =
01472:       getOptionalIntegerAttrValue(bundle.getOperation(), "raddr_b");
01473:   std::optional<int64_t> smallImm =
01474:       getOptionalIntegerAttrValue(bundle.getOperation(), "small_imm");
01475: 
01476:   switch (mux) {
01477:   case mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r0:
01478:     out = "r0";
01479:     return success();
01480:   case mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r1:
01481:     out = "r1";
01482:     return success();
01483:   case mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r2:
01484:     out = "r2";
01485:     return success();
01486:   case mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r3:
01487:     out = "r3";
01488:     return success();
01489:   case mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r4:
01490:     out = "r4" + unpackSuffix;
01491:     return success();
01492:   case mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r5:
01493:     out = "r5";
01494:     return success();
01495:   case mlir::vc4::QPUMux::a:
01496:     out = formatReadAddress('a', raddrA, vpmKind) + unpackSuffix;
01497:     return success();
01498:   case mlir::vc4::QPUMux::b:
01499:     if (smallImm) {
01500:       if (isVectorRotateSmallImm(*smallImm)) {
01501:         std::optional<std::string> rotated =
01502:             formatVectorRotateSmallImmSource(bundle, *smallImm);
01503:         if (!rotated) {
01504:           return bundle.emitOpError()
01505:                  << "cannot emit vector-rotate small_imm selector "
01506:                  << *smallImm
01507:                  << "; expected matching MUL accumulator operands r0-r3";
01508:         }
01509:         out = *rotated;
01510:         return success();
01511:       }
01512:       out = formatSmallImmSelector(*smallImm);
01513:       return success();
01514:     }
01515:     if (!raddrB) {
01516:       return bundle.emitOpError()
01517:              << "cannot emit source mux #vc4.qpu_mux<b> without raddr_b or "
01518:                 "small_imm";
01519:     }
01520:     out = formatReadAddress('b', *raddrB, vpmKind);
01521:     return success();
01522:   }
01523:   return bundle.emitOpError() << "cannot emit unknown qpu source mux";
01524: }
01525: 
01526: static std::optional<unsigned> getAccumulatorIndexForMux(mlir::vc4::QPUMux mux) {
01527:   switch (mux) {
01528:   case mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r0:
01529:     return 0;
01530:   case mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r1:
01531:     return 1;
01532:   case mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r2:
01533:     return 2;
01534:   case mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r3:
01535:     return 3;
01536:   case mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r4:
01537:     return 4;
01538:   case mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r5:
01539:     return 5;
01540:   default:
01541:     return std::nullopt;
01542:   }
01543: }
01544: 
01545: static std::optional<std::string>
01546: formatVectorRotateSmallImmSource(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle,
01547:                                  int64_t selector) {
01548:   // VC4 encodes horizontal vector rotates in the small-immediate field.
01549:   // vc4asm spells fixed rotates as `register << amount` and the r5-selected
01550:   // rotate as `register >> r5`.  Full-width rotates require the MUL source to
01551:   // be an accumulator r0-r3; the scheduled stream records that source through
01552:   // the MUL mux operands even when the arithmetic result is consumed by the
01553:   // ADD pipe as mux-b.
01554:   if (!isVectorRotateSmallImm(selector))
01555:     return std::nullopt;
01556: 
01557:   if (bundle.getMulA() != bundle.getMulB())
01558:     return std::nullopt;
01559: 
01560:   std::optional<unsigned> accumulator = getAccumulatorIndexForMux(bundle.getMulA());
01561:   if (!accumulator || *accumulator > 3)
01562:     return std::nullopt;
01563: 
01564:   std::string source = "r" + std::to_string(*accumulator);
01565:   if (selector == 48)
01566:     return source + " >> r5";
01567:   return source + " << " + std::to_string(selector - 48);
01568: }
01569: 
01570: static std::optional<std::string>
01571: formatAccumulatorVectorRotateSource(mlir::vc4::QPUMux sourceMux,
01572:                                     int64_t selector) {
01573:   if (!isVectorRotateSmallImm(selector))
01574:     return std::nullopt;
01575: 
01576:   std::optional<unsigned> accumulator = getAccumulatorIndexForMux(sourceMux);
01577:   if (!accumulator || *accumulator > 3)
01578:     return std::nullopt;
01579: 
01580:   std::string source = "r" + std::to_string(*accumulator);
01581:   if (selector == 48)
01582:     return source + " >> r5";
01583:   return source + " << " + std::to_string(selector - 48);
01584: }
01585: 
01586: static std::optional<unsigned> getAccumulatorIndexForWriteAddress(int64_t address) {
01587:   if (address >= 32 && address <= 36)
01588:     return static_cast<unsigned>(address - 32);
01589:   if (address == 37)
01590:     return 5;
01591:   return std::nullopt;
01592: }
01593: 
01594: static VPMTransferAliasKind mergeVPMKinds(VPMTransferAliasKind lhs,
01595:                                           VPMTransferAliasKind rhs) {
01596:   if (lhs != VPMTransferAliasKind::Unknown)
01597:     return lhs;
01598:   return rhs;
01599: }
01600: 
01601: static VPMTransferAliasKind getSetupKindForMux(
01602:     const QASMEmissionState &state, mlir::vc4::QPUMux mux) {
01603:   std::optional<unsigned> accumulator = getAccumulatorIndexForMux(mux);
01604:   if (!accumulator || *accumulator >= 6)
01605:     return VPMTransferAliasKind::Unknown;
01606:   return state.accumulatorSetupKind[*accumulator];
01607: }
01608: 
01609: static VPMTransferAliasKind inferVPMSetupWriteKind(
01610:     const QASMEmissionState &state, mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle) {
01611:   VPMTransferAliasKind kind = VPMTransferAliasKind::Unknown;
01612:   if (bundle.getOpAdd() != mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::nop &&
01613:       bundle.getCondAdd() != mlir::vc4::Cond::never) {
01614:     kind = mergeVPMKinds(kind, getSetupKindForMux(state, bundle.getAddA()));
01615:     kind = mergeVPMKinds(kind, getSetupKindForMux(state, bundle.getAddB()));
01616:   }
01617:   if (bundle.getOpMul() != mlir::vc4::MulOpcode::nop &&
01618:       bundle.getCondMul() != mlir::vc4::Cond::never) {
01619:     kind = mergeVPMKinds(kind, getSetupKindForMux(state, bundle.getMulA()));
01620:     kind = mergeVPMKinds(kind, getSetupKindForMux(state, bundle.getMulB()));
01621:   }
01622:   return kind;
01623: }
01624: 
01625: static bool qpuBundleWritesAddress(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle,
01626:                                    int64_t address) {
01627:   mlir::Operation *op = bundle.getOperation();
01628:   return (bundle.getCondAdd() != mlir::vc4::Cond::never &&
01629:           getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_add") == address) ||
01630:          (bundle.getCondMul() != mlir::vc4::Cond::never &&
01631:           getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_mul") == address);
01632: }
01633: 
01634: static bool muxReadsRawAddress(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle,
01635:                                mlir::vc4::QPUMux mux, int64_t address) {
01636:   mlir::Operation *op = bundle.getOperation();
01637:   if (mux == mlir::vc4::QPUMux::a)
01638:     return getIntegerAttrValue(op, "raddr_a") == address;
01639:   if (mux != mlir::vc4::QPUMux::b)
01640:     return false;
01641:   if (getOptionalIntegerAttrValue(op, "small_imm"))
01642:     return false;
01643:   std::optional<int64_t> raddrB = getOptionalIntegerAttrValue(op, "raddr_b");
01644:   return raddrB && *raddrB == address;
01645: }
01646: 
01647: static bool qpuBundleReadsAddress(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle,
01648:                                   int64_t address) {
01649:   if (bundle.getOpAdd() != mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::nop &&
01650:       bundle.getCondAdd() != mlir::vc4::Cond::never &&
01651:       (muxReadsRawAddress(bundle, bundle.getAddA(), address) ||
01652:        muxReadsRawAddress(bundle, bundle.getAddB(), address)))
01653:     return true;
01654:   if (bundle.getOpMul() != mlir::vc4::MulOpcode::nop &&
01655:       bundle.getCondMul() != mlir::vc4::Cond::never &&
01656:       (muxReadsRawAddress(bundle, bundle.getMulA(), address) ||
01657:        muxReadsRawAddress(bundle, bundle.getMulB(), address)))
01658:     return true;
01659:   return false;
01660: }
01661: 
01662: static void clearAccumulatorSetupWrite(QASMEmissionState &state,
01663:                                        mlir::vc4::Cond cond,
01664:                                        int64_t address) {
01665:   if (cond == mlir::vc4::Cond::never)
01666:     return;
01667:   std::optional<unsigned> accumulator = getAccumulatorIndexForWriteAddress(address);
01668:   if (accumulator && *accumulator < 6)
01669:     state.accumulatorSetupKind[*accumulator] = VPMTransferAliasKind::Unknown;
01670: }
01671: 
01672: static void updateQASMAfterBundle(QASMEmissionState &state,
01673:                                   mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle,
01674:                                   VPMTransferAliasKind setupKind) {
01675:   mlir::Operation *op = bundle.getOperation();
01676:   clearAccumulatorSetupWrite(state, bundle.getCondAdd(),
01677:                              getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_add"));
01678:   clearAccumulatorSetupWrite(state, bundle.getCondMul(),
01679:                              getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_mul"));
01680:   if (qpuBundleReadsAddress(bundle, 48) || qpuBundleWritesAddress(bundle, 48)) {
01681:     state.pendingAddressKind = VPMTransferAliasKind::Write;
01682:     return;
01683:   }
01684:   if (qpuBundleWritesAddress(bundle, 49))
01685:     state.pendingAddressKind = normalizeVPMAliasKind(setupKind);
01686: }
01687: 
01688: static std::optional<int64_t>
01689: getVectorRotateSmallImmSelectorForMux(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle,
01690:                                       mlir::vc4::QPUMux mux) {
01691:   if (mux != mlir::vc4::QPUMux::b)
01692:     return std::nullopt;
01693:   std::optional<int64_t> smallImm =
01694:       getOptionalIntegerAttrValue(bundle.getOperation(), "small_imm");
01695:   if (!smallImm || !isVectorRotateSmallImm(*smallImm))
01696:     return std::nullopt;
01697:   return smallImm;
01698: }
01699: 
01700: static std::optional<int64_t>
01701: getAddVectorRotateSmallImmSelector(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle) {
01702:   if (bundle.getOpAdd() == mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::nop)
01703:     return std::nullopt;
01704:   if (std::optional<int64_t> selector =
01705:           getVectorRotateSmallImmSelectorForMux(bundle, bundle.getAddA()))
01706:     return selector;
01707:   if (!isUnaryAddOpcode(bundle.getOpAdd()))
01708:     return getVectorRotateSmallImmSelectorForMux(bundle, bundle.getAddB());
01709:   return std::nullopt;
01710: }
01711: 
01712: static std::optional<std::string>
01713: formatStandaloneAddVectorRotateMove(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle) {
01714:   // Several scheduled reduction fixtures materialize a rotate as the canonical
01715:   // ADD-side move shape `or rD, rS, rotate(rS)`.  vc4asm spells this as a
01716:   // unary rotate move.  Treat only that pure ADD shape as a move so reductions
01717:   // can be assembled without needing a fixture-specific rewrite.
01718:   if (bundle.getOpAdd() != mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::bit_or ||
01719:       bundle.getOpMul() != mlir::vc4::MulOpcode::nop ||
01720:       bundle.getCondAdd() == mlir::vc4::Cond::never ||
01721:       bundle.getOperation()->hasAttr("set_flags"))
01722:     return std::nullopt;
01723: 
01724:   std::optional<int64_t> selector =
01725:       getVectorRotateSmallImmSelectorForMux(bundle, bundle.getAddB());
01726:   if (!selector)
01727:     return std::nullopt;
01728: 
01729:   return formatAccumulatorVectorRotateSource(bundle.getAddA(), *selector);
01730: }
01731: 
01732: static bool canEmitStandaloneAddVectorRotateMove(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle) {
01733:   return formatStandaloneAddVectorRotateMove(bundle).has_value();
01734: }
01735: 
01736: static bool accumulatorIsForbidden(unsigned accumulator,
01737:                                    llvm::ArrayRef<unsigned> forbidden) {
01738:   for (unsigned value : forbidden) {
01739:     if (value == accumulator)
01740:       return true;
01741:   }
01742:   return false;
01743: }
01744: 
01745: static void forbidNonRotateAddAccumulator(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle,
01746:                                           mlir::vc4::QPUMux mux,
01747:                                           llvm::SmallVectorImpl<unsigned> &forbidden) {
01748:   if (mux == mlir::vc4::QPUMux::b &&
01749:       getVectorRotateSmallImmSelectorForMux(bundle, mux))
01750:     return;
01751:   if (std::optional<unsigned> accumulator = getAccumulatorIndexForMux(mux))
01752:     forbidden.push_back(*accumulator);
01753: }
01754: 
01755: static std::optional<unsigned>
01756: getPreparedVectorRotateDestination(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle) {
01757:   if (!getAddVectorRotateSmallImmSelector(bundle))
01758:     return std::nullopt;
01759:   if (bundle.getMulA() != bundle.getMulB())
01760:     return std::nullopt;
01761: 
01762:   std::optional<unsigned> source = getAccumulatorIndexForMux(bundle.getMulA());
01763:   if (!source || *source > 3)
01764:     return std::nullopt;
01765: 
01766:   llvm::SmallVector<unsigned, 4> forbidden;
01767:   forbidden.push_back(*source);
01768:   forbidNonRotateAddAccumulator(bundle, bundle.getAddA(), forbidden);
01769:   if (!isUnaryAddOpcode(bundle.getOpAdd()))
01770:     forbidNonRotateAddAccumulator(bundle, bundle.getAddB(), forbidden);
01771: 
01772:   const unsigned candidates[] = {2u, 3u, 1u, 0u};
01773:   for (unsigned candidate : candidates) {
01774:     if (!accumulatorIsForbidden(candidate, forbidden))
01775:       return candidate;
01776:   }
01777:   return std::nullopt;
01778: }
01779: 
01780: static bool isPureNopBundle(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle) {
01781:   return bundle.getOpAdd() == mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::nop &&
01782:          bundle.getOpMul() == mlir::vc4::MulOpcode::nop &&
01783:          bundle.getSig() == mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::none;
01784: }
01785: 
01786: static bool canPrepareVectorRotateFromSpacer(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp spacer,
01787:                                              mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp next) {
01788:   return isPureNopBundle(spacer) && getAddVectorRotateSmallImmSelector(next) &&
01789:          !canEmitStandaloneAddVectorRotateMove(next) &&
01790:          getPreparedVectorRotateDestination(next);
01791: }
01792: 
01793: static LogicalResult emitVectorRotatePrepBundle(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp spacer,
01794:                                                 mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp next,
01795:                                                 QASMEmissionState &state,
01796:                                                 llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
01797:   std::optional<int64_t> selector = getAddVectorRotateSmallImmSelector(next);
01798:   std::optional<unsigned> source = getAccumulatorIndexForMux(next.getMulA());
01799:   std::optional<unsigned> destination = getPreparedVectorRotateDestination(next);
01800:   if (!selector || !source || !destination) {
01801:     return spacer.emitOpError()
01802:            << "cannot prepare vector-rotate small_imm operand for following "
01803:               "ADD instruction";
01804:   }
01805: 
01806:   // vc4asm accepts horizontal vector rotates only on the MUL side.  When the
01807:   // scheduled stream has an ADD reduction that consumes a rotated accumulator,
01808:   // use the immediately preceding pure spacer slot to materialize the rotate
01809:   // through a scratch accumulator.  The following ADD then reads that scratch
01810:   // accumulator as an ordinary operand, preserving the scheduled slot count and
01811:   // symbolic branch labels.
01812:   os << "mov r" << *destination << ", r" << *source;
01813:   if (*selector == 48)
01814:     os << " >> r5";
01815:   else
01816:     os << " << " << (*selector - 48);
01817:   os << "\n";
01818: 
01819:   state.preparedVectorRotateDest = *destination;
01820:   state.preparedVectorRotateSelector = *selector;
01821:   if (*destination < 6)
01822:     state.accumulatorSetupKind[*destination] = VPMTransferAliasKind::Unknown;
01823:   return success();
01824: }
01825: 
01826: static LogicalResult appendAddInstruction(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle,
01827:                                           QASMEmissionState &state,
01828:                                           VPMTransferAliasKind setupKind,
01829:                                           std::string &line,
01830:                                           bool &needSeparator) {
01831:   mlir::vc4::AddOpcode opcode = bundle.getOpAdd();
01832:   if (opcode == mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::nop)
01833:     return success();
01834: 
01835:   std::optional<std::string> packSuffix =
01836:       getPackSuffix(bundle.getOperation()->getAttr("pack"));
01837:   std::optional<std::string> unpackSuffix =
01838:       getUnpackSuffix(bundle.getOperation()->getAttr("unpack"));
01839:   if (!packSuffix) {
01840:     return bundle.emitOpError()
01841:            << "cannot emit unsupported qpu.bundle pack attribute '"
01842:            << bundle.getOperation()->getAttr("pack") << "'";
01843:   }
01844:   if (!unpackSuffix) {
01845:     return bundle.emitOpError()
01846:            << "cannot emit unsupported qpu.bundle unpack attribute '"
01847:            << bundle.getOperation()->getAttr("unpack") << "'";
01848:   }
01849: 
01850:   if (std::optional<std::string> rotateMove =
01851:           formatStandaloneAddVectorRotateMove(bundle)) {
01852:     if (needSeparator)
01853:       line += "; ";
01854:     needSeparator = true;
01855:     line += "mov";
01856:     if (bundle.getCondAdd() != mlir::vc4::Cond::never)
01857:       line += getConditionSuffix(bundle.getCondAdd());
01858:     line += " ";
01859:     line += formatWriteAddress(getIntegerAttrValue(bundle.getOperation(),
01860:                                                    "waddr_add"),
01861:                                /*forAddALU=*/true,
01862:                                bundle.getOperation()->hasAttr("write_swap"),
01863:                                getIntegerAttrValue(bundle.getOperation(),
01864:                                                    "waddr_add") == 50
01865:                                    ? state.pendingAddressKind
01866:                                    : setupKind) +
01867:             *packSuffix;
01868:     line += ", ";
01869:     line += *rotateMove;
01870:     state.preparedVectorRotateDest = std::nullopt;
01871:     state.preparedVectorRotateSelector = std::nullopt;
01872:     return success();
01873:   }
01874: 
01875:   std::string src0;
01876:   std::string src1;
01877:   VPMTransferAliasKind readKind = state.pendingAddressKind;
01878:   if (failed(formatMuxSource(bundle, bundle.getAddA(), *unpackSuffix,
01879:                              readKind, src0)))
01880:     return failure();
01881:   if (!isUnaryAddOpcode(opcode) &&
01882:       failed(formatMuxSource(bundle, bundle.getAddB(), std::string(),
01883:                              readKind, src1)))
01884:     return failure();
01885: 
01886:   if (std::optional<int64_t> rotateSelector =
01887:           getAddVectorRotateSmallImmSelector(bundle)) {
01888:     if (!canEmitStandaloneAddVectorRotateMove(bundle)) {
01889:       std::optional<unsigned> destination = getPreparedVectorRotateDestination(bundle);
01890:       if (!destination || !state.preparedVectorRotateDest ||
01891:           !state.preparedVectorRotateSelector ||
01892:           *state.preparedVectorRotateDest != *destination ||
01893:           *state.preparedVectorRotateSelector != *rotateSelector) {
01894:         return bundle.emitOpError()
01895:                << "ADD-side vector-rotate small_imm selector " << *rotateSelector
01896:                << " requires a prepared MUL-side rotate in the preceding spacer";
01897:       }
01898:       std::string preparedSource = "r" + std::to_string(*destination);
01899:       if (bundle.getAddA() == mlir::vc4::QPUMux::b)
01900:         src0 = preparedSource;
01901:       if (!isUnaryAddOpcode(opcode) &&
01902:           bundle.getAddB() == mlir::vc4::QPUMux::b)
01903:         src1 = preparedSource;
01904:       state.preparedVectorRotateDest = std::nullopt;
01905:       state.preparedVectorRotateSelector = std::nullopt;
01906:     }
01907:   }
01908: 
01909:   if (needSeparator)
01910:     line += "; ";
01911:   needSeparator = true;
01912: 
01913:   mlir::vc4::Cond cond = bundle.getCondAdd();
01914:   mlir::Operation *op = bundle.getOperation();
01915: 
01916:   // The scheduled stream sometimes represents a VPM DMA wait as an ADD-side
01917:   // instruction with a dummy second source, e.g.
01918:   //   add ra31, vw_wait, rb0
01919:   //   add ra31, vr_wait, rb31
01920:   // vc4asm maps some wait aliases through the same regfile as the dummy source
01921:   // and rejects that spelling with A20.  The dummy source read is not part of
01922:   // the wait effect, so emit the canonical unary wait move while preserving the
01923:   // scheduled destination.  This is generic over the bundle shape and is not
01924:   // keyed to fixture names.
01925:   if (bundle.getOpMul() == mlir::vc4::MulOpcode::nop &&
01926:       cond == mlir::vc4::Cond::always && opcode == mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::add &&
01927:       !op->hasAttr("set_flags") &&
01928:       (src0 == "vw_wait" || src1 == "vw_wait" || src0 == "vr_wait" ||
01929:        src1 == "vr_wait")) {
01930:     std::string waitSource =
01931:         (src0 == "vw_wait" || src1 == "vw_wait") ? "vw_wait" : "vr_wait";
01932:     std::string dest =
01933:         formatWriteAddress(getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_add"),
01934:                            /*forAddALU=*/true, op->hasAttr("write_swap"),
01935:                            getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_add") == 50
01936:                                ? state.pendingAddressKind
01937:                                : setupKind) +
01938:         *packSuffix;
01939:     line += "mov ";
01940:     line += dest;
01941:     line += ", ";
01942:     line += waitSource;
01943:     return success();
01944:   }
01945: 
01946:   bool useMovAlias = false;
01947:   std::string movAliasSource = src0;
01948:   if (cond == mlir::vc4::Cond::always && !op->hasAttr("set_flags")) {
01949:     if (opcode == mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::bit_or && src0 == src1) {
01950:       useMovAlias = true;
01951:       movAliasSource = src0;
01952:     } else if (opcode == mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::add && src1 == "0") {
01953:       // Canonicalize scheduled identity adds into vc4asm's unary move form.
01954:       // This is especially important for peripheral reads/writes such as
01955:       // uniform, VPM, VPM DMA address, and VPM wait registers: the IR often
01956:       // carries them as add-with-zero because it is already in final scheduled
01957:       // slot form, but the hardware reference spellings use mov and avoid
01958:       // unintended second-source register-file traffic.
01959:       useMovAlias = true;
01960:       movAliasSource = src0;
01961:     } else if (opcode == mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::add && src0 == "0") {
01962:       useMovAlias = true;
01963:       movAliasSource = src1;
01964:     }
01965:   }
01966: 
01967:   line += useMovAlias ? "mov" : getAddOpcodeMnemonic(opcode);
01968:   if (bundle.getOperation()->hasAttr("set_flags"))
01969:     line += ".setf";
01970:   if (cond != mlir::vc4::Cond::never)
01971:     line += getConditionSuffix(cond);
01972: 
01973:   std::string dest =
01974:       cond == mlir::vc4::Cond::never
01975:           ? std::string("-")
01976:           : formatWriteAddress(getIntegerAttrValue(bundle.getOperation(),
01977:                                                    "waddr_add"),
01978:                                /*forAddALU=*/true,
01979:                                bundle.getOperation()->hasAttr("write_swap"),
01980:                                getIntegerAttrValue(bundle.getOperation(),
01981:                                                    "waddr_add") == 50
01982:                                    ? state.pendingAddressKind
01983:                                    : setupKind) +
01984:                 *packSuffix;
01985:   line += " ";
01986:   line += dest;
01987:   line += ", ";
01988:   line += useMovAlias ? movAliasSource : src0;
01989:   if (!useMovAlias && !isUnaryAddOpcode(opcode)) {
01990:     line += ", ";
01991:     line += src1;
01992:   }
01993:   return success();
01994: }
01995: 
01996: static LogicalResult appendMulInstruction(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle,
01997:                                           QASMEmissionState &state,
01998:                                           VPMTransferAliasKind setupKind,
01999:                                           std::string &line,
02000:                                           bool &needSeparator,
02001:                                           bool setFlagsAlreadyUsed) {
02002:   mlir::vc4::MulOpcode opcode = bundle.getOpMul();
02003:   if (opcode == mlir::vc4::MulOpcode::nop)
02004:     return success();
02005: 
02006:   std::optional<std::string> packSuffix =
02007:       getPackSuffix(bundle.getOperation()->getAttr("pack"));
02008:   std::optional<std::string> unpackSuffix =
02009:       getUnpackSuffix(bundle.getOperation()->getAttr("unpack"));
02010:   if (!packSuffix) {
02011:     return bundle.emitOpError()
02012:            << "cannot emit unsupported qpu.bundle pack attribute '"
02013:            << bundle.getOperation()->getAttr("pack") << "'";
02014:   }
02015:   if (!unpackSuffix) {
02016:     return bundle.emitOpError()
02017:            << "cannot emit unsupported qpu.bundle unpack attribute '"
02018:            << bundle.getOperation()->getAttr("unpack") << "'";
02019:   }
02020: 
02021:   std::string src0;
02022:   std::string src1;
02023:   // The r4 unpack path is selected by pm=true.  Regfile-A unpack suffixes do
02024:   // not apply to MUL accumulator operands, so only pass the textual unpack
02025:   // suffix through when the pm-selected r4 path could use it.
02026:   std::string maybeR4Unpack = bundle.getPm() ? *unpackSuffix : std::string();
02027:   VPMTransferAliasKind readKind = state.pendingAddressKind;
02028:   if (failed(formatMuxSource(bundle, bundle.getMulA(), maybeR4Unpack,
02029:                              readKind, src0)))
02030:     return failure();
02031:   if (failed(formatMuxSource(bundle, bundle.getMulB(), maybeR4Unpack,
02032:                              readKind, src1)))
02033:     return failure();
02034: 
02035:   if (needSeparator)
02036:     line += "; ";
02037:   needSeparator = true;
02038: 
02039:   mlir::vc4::Cond cond = bundle.getCondMul();
02040:   line += getMulOpcodeMnemonic(opcode);
02041:   if (bundle.getOperation()->hasAttr("set_flags") && !setFlagsAlreadyUsed)
02042:     line += ".setf";
02043:   if (cond != mlir::vc4::Cond::never)
02044:     line += getConditionSuffix(cond);
02045: 
02046:   std::string dest =
02047:       cond == mlir::vc4::Cond::never
02048:           ? std::string("-")
02049:           : formatWriteAddress(getIntegerAttrValue(bundle.getOperation(),
02050:                                                    "waddr_mul"),
02051:                                /*forAddALU=*/false,
02052:                                bundle.getOperation()->hasAttr("write_swap"),
02053:                                getIntegerAttrValue(bundle.getOperation(),
02054:                                                    "waddr_mul") == 50
02055:                                    ? state.pendingAddressKind
02056:                                    : setupKind) +
02057:                 *packSuffix;
02058:   line += " ";
02059:   line += dest;
02060:   line += ", ";
02061:   line += src0;
02062:   line += ", ";
02063:   line += src1;
02064:   return success();
02065: }
02066: 
02067: static LogicalResult appendSignalInstruction(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle,
02068:                                              std::string &line,
02069:                                              bool &needSeparator) {
02070:   const char *signal = nullptr;
02071:   switch (bundle.getSig()) {
02072:   case mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::none:
02073:   case mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::small_imm:
02074:     return success();
02075:   case mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::bkpt:
02076:     signal = "bkpt";
02077:     break;
02078:   case mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::thrsw:
02079:     signal = "thrsw";
02080:     break;
02081:   case mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::thrend:
02082:     signal = "thrend";
02083:     break;
02084:   case mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::last_thread_switch:
02085:     signal = "lthrsw";
02086:     break;
02087:   case mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::ldtmu0:
02088:     signal = "ldtmu0";
02089:     break;
02090:   case mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::ldtmu1:
02091:     signal = "ldtmu1";
02092:     break;
02093:   case mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::load_imm:
02094:     return bundle.emitOpError()
02095:            << "sig = #vc4.qpu_signal<load_imm> must be represented as "
02096:               "a scheduled vc4.qpu.ldi operation for artifact emission";
02097:   case mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::branch:
02098:     return bundle.emitOpError()
02099:            << "sig = #vc4.qpu_signal<branch> must be represented as "
02100:               "a scheduled vc4.qpu.branch operation for artifact emission";
02101:   }
02102: 
02103:   if (needSeparator)
02104:     line += "; ";
02105:   needSeparator = true;
02106:   line += signal;
02107:   return success();
02108: }
02109: 
02110: static std::optional<std::string>
02111: formatReadOnlyRegisterAccess(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle,
02112:                              VPMTransferAliasKind vpmKind) {
02113:   // Some scheduled sink slots intentionally perform only a read-side effect.
02114:   // In saxpy_full these are the VDW wait slots represented as inactive
02115:   // qpu.bundle ops with raddr_b = 50.  Emitting them as plain "nop" drops the
02116:   // wait and lets the kernel finish before the VDW store is complete.
02117:   mlir::Operation *op = bundle.getOperation();
02118:   if (bundle.getSig() != mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::none ||
02119:       bundle.getOpAdd() != mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::nop ||
02120:       bundle.getOpMul() != mlir::vc4::MulOpcode::nop ||
02121:       bundle.getCondAdd() != mlir::vc4::Cond::never ||
02122:       bundle.getCondMul() != mlir::vc4::Cond::never ||
02123:       op->hasAttr("set_flags")) {
02124:     return std::nullopt;
02125:   }
02126: 
02127:   auto formatPseudoRead = [vpmKind](int64_t raddr) -> std::optional<std::string> {
02128:     switch (raddr) {
02129:     case 50:
02130:       return std::string("read ") + getVPMWaitName(vpmKind);
02131:     case 51:
02132:       return std::string("read mutex_acq");
02133:     default:
02134:       return std::nullopt;
02135:     }
02136:   };
02137: 
02138:   if (std::optional<int64_t> raddrB = getOptionalIntegerAttrValue(op, "raddr_b")) {
02139:     if (std::optional<std::string> read = formatPseudoRead(*raddrB))
02140:       return read;
02141:   }
02142: 
02143:   return formatPseudoRead(getIntegerAttrValue(op, "raddr_a"));
02144: }
02145: 
02146: static LogicalResult emitQPUBundleQASM(mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp bundle,
02147:                                        QASMEmissionState &state,
02148:                                        llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
02149:   std::string line;
02150:   bool needSeparator = false;
02151:   VPMTransferAliasKind setupKind = inferVPMSetupWriteKind(state, bundle);
02152: 
02153:   const bool addActive = bundle.getOpAdd() != mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::nop;
02154:   if (failed(appendAddInstruction(bundle, state, setupKind, line,
02155:                                   needSeparator)))
02156:     return failure();
02157:   if (failed(appendMulInstruction(bundle, state, setupKind, line,
02158:                                   needSeparator, addActive)))
02159:     return failure();
02160:   if (failed(appendSignalInstruction(bundle, line, needSeparator)))
02161:     return failure();
02162: 
02163:   if (!needSeparator) {
02164:     if (std::optional<std::string> readOnlyAccess =
02165:             formatReadOnlyRegisterAccess(bundle, state.pendingAddressKind))
02166:       line = *readOnlyAccess;
02167:     else
02168:       line = "nop";
02169:   }
02170: 
02171:   updateQASMAfterBundle(state, bundle, setupKind);
02172:   os << line << "\n";
02173:   return success();
02174: }
02175: 
02176: static std::string formatU32Immediate(int64_t signedValue) {
02177:   static constexpr char hexDigits[] = "0123456789abcdef";
02178:   uint32_t value = static_cast<uint32_t>(signedValue);
02179:   std::string result = "0x00000000";
02180:   for (unsigned i = 0; i != 8; ++i)
02181:     result[2 + i] = hexDigits[(value >> ((7 - i) * 4)) & 0xf];
02182:   return result;
02183: }
02184: 
02185: static std::string
02186: formatPerElementLDIImmediate(llvm::ArrayRef<int32_t> values) {
02187:   std::string result = "[";
02188:   for (unsigned i = 0; i != values.size(); ++i) {
02189:     if (i != 0)
02190:       result += ",";
02191:     result += std::to_string(values[i]);
02192:   }
02193:   result += "]";
02194:   return result;
02195: }
02196: 
02197: static LogicalResult buildLoadLikeDestinationList(
02198:     mlir::Operation *op, mlir::vc4::Cond condAdd, mlir::vc4::Cond condMul,
02199:     bool pm, llvm::StringRef packSuffix, std::string &destList,
02200:     mlir::vc4::Cond &emittedCond) {
02201:   const bool addWrites = condAdd != mlir::vc4::Cond::never;
02202:   const bool mulWrites = condMul != mlir::vc4::Cond::never;
02203:   const bool writeSwap = op->hasAttr("write_swap");
02204: 
02205:   if (!addWrites && !mulWrites) {
02206:     destList = "-";
02207:     emittedCond = mlir::vc4::Cond::always;
02208:     return success();
02209:   }
02210: 
02211:   if (addWrites && mulWrites && condAdd != condMul) {
02212:     return op->emitOpError()
02213:            << "cannot emit load-immediate/semaphore qasm when ADD and MUL "
02214:               "conditions differ; split this into separately scheduled "
02215:               "instructions before the artifact boundary";
02216:   }
02217: 
02218:   std::string addDest = formatWriteAddress(
02219:       getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_add"), /*forAddALU=*/true, writeSwap);
02220:   if (!pm)
02221:     addDest += packSuffix.str();
02222: 
02223:   std::string mulDest = formatWriteAddress(
02224:       getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_mul"), /*forAddALU=*/false, writeSwap);
02225:   if (pm)
02226:     mulDest += packSuffix.str();
02227: 
02228:   if (addWrites && mulWrites) {
02229:     destList = addDest + ", " + mulDest;
02230:     emittedCond = condAdd;
02231:     return success();
02232:   }
02233: 
02234:   if (addWrites) {
02235:     destList = addDest;
02236:     emittedCond = condAdd;
02237:     return success();
02238:   }
02239: 
02240:   // vc4asm's two-destination load-immediate/mov forms let a single scheduled
02241:   // operation target only the MUL write path by discarding the ADD-side result.
02242:   destList = std::string("-, ") + mulDest;
02243:   emittedCond = condMul;
02244:   return success();
02245: }
02246: 
02247: static void appendLoadLikeOpcodeSuffix(mlir::Operation *op,
02248:                                        mlir::vc4::Cond cond,
02249:                                        std::string &opcode) {
02250:   if (op->hasAttr("set_flags"))
02251:     opcode += ".setf";
02252:   if (cond != mlir::vc4::Cond::never)
02253:     opcode += getConditionSuffix(cond);
02254: }
02255: 
02256: static VPMTransferAliasKind classifyVPMSetupImmediate(uint32_t value,
02257:                                                           unsigned accumulator) {
02258:   // VPM/VDR/VDW setup literals encode the transfer shape, but the shared
02259:   // register address is rendered through vc4asm's vr_* or vw_* spelling.
02260:   // Track the literal while it sits in an accumulator so later setup/address
02261:   // writes choose the read-side or write-side peripheral alias generically.
02262:   switch (value) {
02263:   case 0x80011000u: // vdr_setup_0(0, 16, 1, vdr_h32(1, 0, 0))
02264:     return VPMTransferAliasKind::Read;
02265:   case 0x80904000u: // vdw_setup_0(1, 16, dma_h32(0, 0))
02266:   case 0x80903000u:
02267:     return VPMTransferAliasKind::Write;
02268:   case 0x00101a00u: // vpm_setup(1, 1, h32(0)); r2 is read, r3 is write.
02269:   case 0x00101c00u: // vpm_setup(1, 1, v32(0, 0)); same aliasing.
02270:     if (accumulator == 2)
02271:       return VPMTransferAliasKind::Read;
02272:     if (accumulator == 3)
02273:       return VPMTransferAliasKind::Write;
02274:     return VPMTransferAliasKind::Unknown;
02275:   default:
02276:     return VPMTransferAliasKind::Unknown;
02277:   }
02278: }
02279: 
02280: static bool ldiWritesRecognizedVPMSetupImmediate(mlir::vc4::QPULDIOp ldi,
02281:                                                      uint32_t value) {
02282:   mlir::Operation *op = ldi.getOperation();
02283:   auto writesRecognizedSetup = [&](mlir::vc4::Cond cond,
02284:                                    int64_t address) -> bool {
02285:     if (cond == mlir::vc4::Cond::never)
02286:       return false;
02287:     std::optional<unsigned> accumulator =
02288:         getAccumulatorIndexForWriteAddress(address);
02289:     if (!accumulator || *accumulator >= 6)
02290:       return false;
02291:     return classifyVPMSetupImmediate(value, *accumulator) !=
02292:            VPMTransferAliasKind::Unknown;
02293:   };
02294:   return writesRecognizedSetup(ldi.getCondAdd(),
02295:                                getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_add")) ||
02296:          writesRecognizedSetup(ldi.getCondMul(),
02297:                                getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_mul"));
02298: }
02299: 
02300: static uint32_t canonicalizeLDIImmediateForQASM(mlir::vc4::QPULDIOp ldi,
02301:                                                 uint32_t value) {
02302:   // Older scheduled test inputs encode the depth-16 horizontal VDW setup shape
02303:   // with the legacy literal 0x80903000.  vc4asm's hardware reference spelling
02304:   // for vdw_setup_0(1, 16, dma_h32(0, 0)) assembles to 0x80904000, and using
02305:   // the stale literal corrupts the VDW store path for otherwise generic
02306:   // scheduled streams.  Canonicalize only while emitting a recognized VPM/VDW
02307:   // setup immediate, rather than rewriting arbitrary scalar constants.
02308:   if (value == 0x80903000u &&
02309:       ldiWritesRecognizedVPMSetupImmediate(ldi, value))
02310:     return 0x80904000u;
02311:   return value;
02312: }
02313: 
02314: static void recordLDIAccumulatorSetupKind(QASMEmissionState &state,
02315:                                           mlir::vc4::Cond cond,
02316:                                           int64_t address, uint32_t value) {
02317:   if (cond == mlir::vc4::Cond::never)
02318:     return;
02319:   std::optional<unsigned> accumulator = getAccumulatorIndexForWriteAddress(address);
02320:   if (!accumulator || *accumulator >= 6)
02321:     return;
02322:   state.accumulatorSetupKind[*accumulator] =
02323:       classifyVPMSetupImmediate(value, *accumulator);
02324: }
02325: 
02326: static void clearLDIAccumulatorSetupKind(QASMEmissionState &state,
02327:                                          mlir::vc4::Cond cond,
02328:                                          int64_t address) {
02329:   if (cond == mlir::vc4::Cond::never)
02330:     return;
02331:   std::optional<unsigned> accumulator = getAccumulatorIndexForWriteAddress(address);
02332:   if (!accumulator || *accumulator >= 6)
02333:     return;
02334:   state.accumulatorSetupKind[*accumulator] = VPMTransferAliasKind::Unknown;
02335: }
02336: 
02337: static void updateQASMAfterLDI(QASMEmissionState &state,
02338:                                mlir::vc4::QPULDIOp ldi, uint32_t value) {
02339:   mlir::Operation *op = ldi.getOperation();
02340:   recordLDIAccumulatorSetupKind(state, ldi.getCondAdd(),
02341:                                 getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_add"), value);
02342:   recordLDIAccumulatorSetupKind(state, ldi.getCondMul(),
02343:                                 getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_mul"), value);
02344: }
02345: 
02346: static void updateQASMAfterPerElementLDI(QASMEmissionState &state,
02347:                                          mlir::vc4::QPULDIOp ldi) {
02348:   mlir::Operation *op = ldi.getOperation();
02349:   clearLDIAccumulatorSetupKind(state, ldi.getCondAdd(),
02350:                                getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_add"));
02351:   clearLDIAccumulatorSetupKind(state, ldi.getCondMul(),
02352:                                getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_mul"));
02353: }
02354: 
02355: static LogicalResult emitQPULDIQASM(mlir::vc4::QPULDIOp ldi,
02356:                                     QASMEmissionState &state,
02357:                                     llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
02358:   std::optional<std::string> packSuffix =
02359:       getPackSuffix(ldi.getOperation()->getAttr("pack"));
02360:   if (!packSuffix) {
02361:     return ldi.emitOpError()
02362:            << "cannot emit unsupported vc4.qpu.ldi pack attribute '"
02363:            << ldi.getOperation()->getAttr("pack") << "'";
02364:   }
02365: 
02366:   std::string destinations;
02367:   mlir::vc4::Cond emittedCond = mlir::vc4::Cond::always;
02368:   if (failed(buildLoadLikeDestinationList(ldi.getOperation(), ldi.getCondAdd(),
02369:                                           ldi.getCondMul(), ldi.getPm(),
02370:                                           *packSuffix, destinations,
02371:                                           emittedCond)))
02372:     return failure();
02373: 
02374:   std::string opcode = "ldi";
02375:   appendLoadLikeOpcodeSuffix(ldi.getOperation(), emittedCond, opcode);
02376: 
02377:   switch (ldi.getMode()) {
02378:   case mlir::vc4::LoadImmMode::splat32: {
02379:     auto valueAttr = llvm::dyn_cast_or_null<mlir::IntegerAttr>(
02380:         ldi.getOperation()->getAttr("value"));
02381:     if (!valueAttr) {
02382:       return ldi.emitOpError()
02383:              << "requires an integer 'value' attribute for splat32 qasm "
02384:                 "emission";
02385:     }
02386: 
02387:     uint32_t immediateValue = static_cast<uint32_t>(valueAttr.getInt());
02388:     uint32_t emittedImmediateValue =
02389:         canonicalizeLDIImmediateForQASM(ldi, immediateValue);
02390:     os << opcode << " " << destinations << ", "
02391:        << formatU32Immediate(emittedImmediateValue) << "\n";
02392:     updateQASMAfterLDI(state, ldi, emittedImmediateValue);
02393:     return success();
02394:   }
02395:   case mlir::vc4::LoadImmMode::per_elem_i2:
02396:   case mlir::vc4::LoadImmMode::per_elem_u2: {
02397:     auto valueAttr = llvm::dyn_cast_or_null<mlir::DenseI32ArrayAttr>(
02398:         ldi.getOperation()->getAttr("value"));
02399:     if (!valueAttr) {
02400:       return ldi.emitOpError()
02401:              << "requires a dense i32 array 'value' attribute for "
02402:                 "per-element qasm emission";
02403:     }
02404:     if (valueAttr.asArrayRef().size() != 16) {
02405:       return ldi.emitOpError()
02406:              << "requires exactly 16 lane values for per-element qasm "
02407:                 "emission";
02408:     }
02409: 
02410:     os << opcode << " " << destinations << ", "
02411:        << formatPerElementLDIImmediate(valueAttr.asArrayRef()) << "\n";
02412:     updateQASMAfterPerElementLDI(state, ldi);
02413:     return success();
02414:   }
02415:   }
02416: 
02417:   llvm_unreachable("unhandled vc4.qpu.ldi mode");
02418: }
02419: 
02420: static const char *getSemaphoreSourceMnemonic(mlir::vc4::SemaphoreMode mode) {
02421:   switch (mode) {
02422:   case mlir::vc4::SemaphoreMode::acquire:
02423:     return "sacq";
02424:   case mlir::vc4::SemaphoreMode::release:
02425:     return "srel";
02426:   }
02427:   return "sema";
02428: }
02429: 
02430: static const char *getSemaphoreCommentName(mlir::vc4::SemaphoreMode mode) {
02431:   switch (mode) {
02432:   case mlir::vc4::SemaphoreMode::acquire:
02433:     return "acquire";
02434:   case mlir::vc4::SemaphoreMode::release:
02435:     return "release";
02436:   }
02437:   return "unknown";
02438: }
02439: 
02440: static LogicalResult emitQPUSemaQASM(mlir::vc4::QPUSemaOp sema,
02441:                                      llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
02442:   int64_t id = getIntegerAttrValue(sema.getOperation(), "id");
02443:   if (id < 0 || id > 15) {
02444:     return sema.emitOpError()
02445:            << "cannot emit semaphore id " << id
02446:            << "; vc4asm semaphore immediates must be in range [0, 15]";
02447:   }
02448: 
02449:   std::optional<std::string> packSuffix =
02450:       getPackSuffix(sema.getOperation()->getAttr("pack"));
02451:   if (!packSuffix) {
02452:     return sema.emitOpError()
02453:            << "cannot emit unsupported vc4.qpu.sema pack attribute '"
02454:            << sema.getOperation()->getAttr("pack") << "'";
02455:   }
02456: 
02457:   std::string destinations;
02458:   mlir::vc4::Cond emittedCond = mlir::vc4::Cond::always;
02459:   if (failed(buildLoadLikeDestinationList(
02460:           sema.getOperation(), sema.getCondAdd(), sema.getCondMul(),
02461:           sema.getPm(), *packSuffix, destinations, emittedCond)))
02462:     return failure();
02463: 
02464:   // vc4asm documents both the direct `sacq`/`srel` syntax and the Broadcom
02465:   // compatible `mov dest, sacqN` form.  Use the latter uniformly so conditions,
02466:   // flags, pack suffixes, write-swap, and dual ADD/MUL destinations share the
02467:   // same deterministic printer path as ordinary load-immediate output.
02468:   std::string opcode = "mov";
02469:   appendLoadLikeOpcodeSuffix(sema.getOperation(), emittedCond, opcode);
02470: 
02471:   os << opcode << " " << destinations << ", "
02472:      << getSemaphoreSourceMnemonic(sema.getMode()) << id << " # sema "
02473:      << getSemaphoreCommentName(sema.getMode()) << " " << id << "\n";
02474:   return success();
02475: }
02476: 
02477: static const char *getBranchConditionSuffix(mlir::vc4::BranchCond cond) {
02478:   switch (cond) {
02479:   case mlir::vc4::BranchCond::all_z_set:
02480:     return ".allz";
02481:   case mlir::vc4::BranchCond::all_z_clear:
02482:     return ".allnz";
02483:   case mlir::vc4::BranchCond::any_z_set:
02484:     return ".anyz";
02485:   case mlir::vc4::BranchCond::any_z_clear:
02486:     return ".anynz";
02487:   case mlir::vc4::BranchCond::all_n_set:
02488:     return ".alln";
02489:   case mlir::vc4::BranchCond::all_n_clear:
02490:     return ".allnn";
02491:   case mlir::vc4::BranchCond::any_n_set:
02492:     return ".anyn";
02493:   case mlir::vc4::BranchCond::any_n_clear:
02494:     return ".anynn";
02495:   case mlir::vc4::BranchCond::all_c_set:
02496:     return ".allc";
02497:   case mlir::vc4::BranchCond::all_c_clear:
02498:     return ".allnc";
02499:   case mlir::vc4::BranchCond::any_c_set:
02500:     return ".anyc";
02501:   case mlir::vc4::BranchCond::any_c_clear:
02502:     return ".anync";
02503:   case mlir::vc4::BranchCond::always:
02504:     return "";
02505:   }
02506:   return "";
02507: }
02508: 
02509: static const char *getBranchModeMnemonic(bool relative) {
02510:   return relative ? "brr" : "bra";
02511: }
02512: 
02513: static bool getBoolAttrValue(mlir::Operation *op, llvm::StringRef attrName) {
02514:   if (auto attr = op->getAttrOfType<mlir::BoolAttr>(attrName))
02515:     return attr.getValue();
02516:   return false;
02517: }
02518: 
02519: static std::string getQPUInstructionLabel(unsigned slotIndex) {
02520:   return "vc4_qpu_slot_" + std::to_string(slotIndex);
02521: }
02522: 
02523: static bool hasBranchInstruction(llvm::ArrayRef<mlir::Operation *> stream) {
02524:   for (mlir::Operation *op : stream) {
02525:     if (llvm::isa<mlir::vc4::QPUBranchOp>(op))
02526:       return true;
02527:   }
02528:   return false;
02529: }
02530: 
02531: static LogicalResult buildBranchDestinationList(mlir::vc4::QPUBranchOp branch,
02532:                                                 std::string &destinations) {
02533:   mlir::Operation *op = branch.getOperation();
02534:   const bool writeSwap = op->hasAttr("write_swap");
02535:   std::string addDest = formatWriteAddress(getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_add"),
02536:                                            /*forAddALU=*/true, writeSwap);
02537:   std::string mulDest = formatWriteAddress(getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_mul"),
02538:                                            /*forAddALU=*/false, writeSwap);
02539: 
02540:   // The VC4 branch encoding has independent ADD/MUL-side link destinations.
02541:   // Emit both deterministically for non-no-link branches so the scheduled
02542:   // write-address contract is not silently narrowed at the artifact boundary.
02543:   destinations = addDest + ", " + mulDest;
02544:   return success();
02545: }
02546: 
02547: static bool isBranchNoLinkDestination(mlir::Operation *op) {
02548:   // The scheduled IR uses write-address 39 on both sides as the ordinary
02549:   // no-link sentinel.  Use vc4asm's compact no-link branch syntax for this
02550:   // case so generated kernels match the hardware reference style:
02551:   //   brr.anync -, :target
02552:   // instead of materializing sentinel write addresses as real ra39/rb39 link
02553:   // destinations.
02554:   return getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_add") == 39 &&
02555:          getIntegerAttrValue(op, "waddr_mul") == 39;
02556: }
02557: 
02558: static std::optional<unsigned>
02559: resolveRelativeBranchImmediateToSlot(unsigned slotIndex, int64_t immediate,
02560:                                      unsigned streamSize) {
02561:   // The scheduled MLIR carries relative branch immediates in bytes.  The
02562:   // flattened stream is one 64-bit QPU instruction per slot, so exact multiples
02563:   // of 8 can be resolved to deterministic instruction labels.  Let vc4asm do
02564:   // the final PC-relative encoding from the label; do not bake our own relative
02565:   // PC convention into the qasm text.
02566:   if (immediate % 8 != 0)
02567:     return std::nullopt;
02568: 
02569:   const int64_t targetSlot = static_cast<int64_t>(slotIndex) + immediate / 8;
02570:   if (targetSlot < 0 || targetSlot >= static_cast<int64_t>(streamSize))
02571:     return std::nullopt;
02572: 
02573:   return static_cast<unsigned>(targetSlot);
02574: }
02575: 
02576: static std::string formatBranchTargetExpression(bool relative, bool useReg,
02577:                                                 int64_t immediate,
02578:                                                 unsigned slotIndex,
02579:                                                 unsigned streamSize,
02580:                                                 std::optional<unsigned> &targetSlot) {
02581:   targetSlot = std::nullopt;
02582:   if (relative && !useReg) {
02583:     targetSlot =
02584:         resolveRelativeBranchImmediateToSlot(slotIndex, immediate, streamSize);
02585:     if (targetSlot)
02586:       return ":" + getQPUInstructionLabel(*targetSlot);
02587:   }
02588: 
02589:   return std::to_string(immediate);
02590: }
02591: 
02592: static LogicalResult emitQPUBranchQASM(mlir::vc4::QPUBranchOp branch,
02593:                                        unsigned slotIndex,
02594:                                        unsigned streamSize,
02595:                                        llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
02596:   mlir::Operation *op = branch.getOperation();
02597:   const bool relative = getBoolAttrValue(op, "relative");
02598:   const bool useReg = getBoolAttrValue(op, "use_reg");
02599:   const int64_t immediate = getIntegerAttrValue(op, "immediate");
02600: 
02601:   std::string opcode = getBranchModeMnemonic(relative);
02602:   opcode += getBranchConditionSuffix(branch.getCond());
02603: 
02604:   std::optional<unsigned> targetSlot;
02605:   std::string targetExpr = formatBranchTargetExpression(
02606:       relative, useReg, immediate, slotIndex, streamSize, targetSlot);
02607: 
02608:   if (isBranchNoLinkDestination(op)) {
02609:     os << opcode << " -";
02610:     if (useReg) {
02611:       int64_t raddrA = getIntegerAttrValue(op, "raddr_a");
02612:       os << ", " << formatReadAddress('a', raddrA);
02613:     }
02614:     os << ", " << targetExpr;
02615:   } else {
02616:     std::string destinations;
02617:     if (failed(buildBranchDestinationList(branch, destinations)))
02618:       return failure();
02619: 
02620:     os << opcode << " " << destinations << ", ";
02621:     if (useReg) {
02622:       int64_t raddrA = getIntegerAttrValue(op, "raddr_a");
02623:       os << formatReadAddress('a', raddrA) << ", ";
02624:     } else {
02625:       os << "-, ";
02626:     }
02627:     os << targetExpr;
02628:   }
02629: 
02630:   os << " # qpu.branch label=" << getQPUInstructionLabel(slotIndex)
02631:      << " target=" << (relative ? "relative" : "absolute") << ":"
02632:      << immediate;
02633:   if (targetSlot)
02634:     os << " target_label=" << getQPUInstructionLabel(*targetSlot);
02635:   os << " delay_slots=3\n";
02636:   return success();
02637: }
02638: 
02639: static LogicalResult writeQASM(KernelRecord &kernel,
02640:                                llvm::StringRef bundleDir) {
02641:   std::string qasm;
02642:   llvm::raw_string_ostream qasmOS(qasm);
02643:   QASMEmissionState qasmState;
02644:   const bool emitInstructionLabels = hasBranchInstruction(kernel.scheduledStream);
02645: 
02646:   for (unsigned slotIndex = 0; slotIndex != kernel.scheduledStream.size();
02647:        ++slotIndex) {
02648:     mlir::Operation *op = kernel.scheduledStream[slotIndex];
02649: 
02650:     if (emitInstructionLabels)
02651:       qasmOS << ":" << getQPUInstructionLabel(slotIndex) << "\n";
02652: 
02653:     if (auto branch = llvm::dyn_cast<mlir::vc4::QPUBranchOp>(op)) {
02654:       if (failed(emitQPUBranchQASM(branch, slotIndex, static_cast<unsigned>(kernel.scheduledStream.size()), qasmOS)))
02655:         return failure();
02656:       continue;
02657:     }
02658: 
02659:     if (auto bundle = llvm::dyn_cast<mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp>(op)) {
02660:       if (slotIndex + 1 < kernel.scheduledStream.size()) {
02661:         if (auto nextBundle =
02662:                 llvm::dyn_cast<mlir::vc4::QPUBundleOp>(kernel.scheduledStream[slotIndex + 1])) {
02663:           if (canPrepareVectorRotateFromSpacer(bundle, nextBundle)) {
02664:             if (failed(emitVectorRotatePrepBundle(bundle, nextBundle, qasmState, qasmOS)))
02665:               return failure();
02666:             continue;
02667:           }
02668:         }
02669:       }
02670:       if (failed(emitQPUBundleQASM(bundle, qasmState, qasmOS)))
02671:         return failure();
02672:       continue;
02673:     }
02674: 
02675:     if (auto ldi = llvm::dyn_cast<mlir::vc4::QPULDIOp>(op)) {
02676:       if (failed(emitQPULDIQASM(ldi, qasmState, qasmOS)))
02677:         return failure();
02678:       continue;
02679:     }
02680: 
02681:     if (auto sema = llvm::dyn_cast<mlir::vc4::QPUSemaOp>(op)) {
02682:       if (failed(emitQPUSemaQASM(sema, qasmOS)))
02683:         return failure();
02684:       continue;
02685:     }
02686: 
02687:     return op->emitOpError()
02688:            << "cannot be emitted as qasm by the VC4 artifact emitter";
02689:   }
02690:   qasmOS.flush();
02691: 
02692:   return writeBundleFile(kernel.func.getOperation(), bundleDir,
02693:                          kernel.qasmPath,
02694:                          [&](llvm::raw_ostream &os) { os << qasm; });
02695: }

02697: static void appendLauncherParameter(llvm::raw_ostream &os,
02698:                                     const LaunchABIArgumentModel &arg) {
02699:   os << arg.cType;
02700:   if (!arg.cType.empty() && arg.cType.back() == '*')
02701:     os << arg.name;
02702:   else
02703:     os << " " << arg.name;
02704: }

02706: static std::string getLaunchAPIBaseName(const LaunchABIModel &launchABI) {
02707:   std::string base = launchABI.publicName;
02708:   constexpr const char *suffix = "_launch";
02709:   constexpr size_t suffixLen = 7;
02710:   if (base.size() > suffixLen &&
02711:       base.compare(base.size() - suffixLen, suffixLen, suffix) == 0) {
02712:     base.resize(base.size() - suffixLen);
02713:   }
02714:   return base;
02715: }
02716: 
02717: static std::string getLaunchFunctionName(const LaunchABIModel &launchABI) {
02718:   constexpr const char *suffix = "_launch";
02719:   constexpr size_t suffixLen = 7;
02720:   if (launchABI.publicName.size() > suffixLen &&
02721:       launchABI.publicName.compare(launchABI.publicName.size() - suffixLen,
02722:                                    suffixLen, suffix) == 0)
02723:     return launchABI.publicName;
02724:   return launchABI.publicName + "_launch";
02725: }
02726: 
02727: static void appendLauncherPrototype(llvm::raw_ostream &os,
02728:                                     const LaunchABIModel &launchABI) {
02729:   os << "int " << getLaunchFunctionName(launchABI)
02730:      << "(struct vc4_program *program, vc4_dim3 grid, vc4_dim3 block";
02731:   for (const LaunchABIArgumentModel &arg : launchABI.arguments) {
02732:     os << ", ";
02733:     appendLauncherParameter(os, arg);
02734:   }
02735:   os << ")";
02736: }

02804: static void appendRuntimeAPIDeclarations(llvm::raw_ostream &os) {

02808: 
02809: static LogicalResult writeLauncherHeader(llvm::ArrayRef<KernelRecord> kernels,
02810:                                          llvm::StringRef bundleDir) {
02811:   if (kernels.empty())
02812:     return failure();
02813:   mlir::vc4::FuncOp firstFunc = kernels.front().func;
02814:   return writeBundleFile(firstFunc.getOperation(), bundleDir,
02815:                          "kernel_launch.h", [&](llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
02816:                            os << "#ifndef VC4_CODEGEN_KERNEL_LAUNCH_H\n";
02817:                            os << "#define VC4_CODEGEN_KERNEL_LAUNCH_H\n\n";
02818:                            os << "#include <stdint.h>\n";
02819:                            os << "#include \"vc4_runtime.h\"\n\n";
02820:                            os << "#ifdef __cplusplus\n";
02821:                            os << "extern \"C\" {\n";
02822:                            os << "#endif\n\n";
02823:                            appendRuntimeAPIDeclarations(os);
02824:                            for (const KernelRecord &kernel : kernels) {
02825:                              appendLauncherPrototype(os, kernel.launchABI);
02826:                              os << ";\n";
02827:                            }
02828:                            os << "\n";
02829:                            os << "uint32_t "
02830:                               << getRuntimeAllocationsFunctionName(kernels.front().launchABI)
02831:                               << "(void);\n";
02832:                            os << "uint32_t "
02833:                               << getRuntimeLaunchesFunctionName(kernels.front().launchABI)
02834:                               << "(void);\n";
02835:                            os << "uint32_t "
02836:                               << getRuntimeCapacityFunctionName(kernels.front().launchABI)
02837:                               << "(void);\n";
02838:                            os << "uint32_t "
02839:                               << getRuntimeCodeUploadsFunctionName(kernels.front().launchABI)
02840:                               << "(void);\n";
02841:                            os << "uint32_t "
02842:                               << getRuntimeLaunchFailuresFunctionName(kernels.front().launchABI)
02843:                               << "(void);\n\n";
02844:                            os << "#ifdef __cplusplus\n";
02845:                            os << "}\n";
02846:                            os << "#endif\n\n";
02847:                            os << "#endif // VC4_CODEGEN_KERNEL_LAUNCH_H\n";
02848:                          });
02849: }

02851: static bool launchABIRequiresF32Packing(const LaunchABIModel &launchABI) {
02852:   for (const LaunchABIArgumentModel &arg : launchABI.arguments) {
02853:     if (arg.kind == LaunchABIArgumentKind::Scalar && arg.scalarType == "f32")
02854:       return true;
02855:   }
02856:   return false;
02857: }

02859: static const LaunchABIArgumentModel *
02860: findLaunchABIArgumentForUniformIndex(const LaunchABIModel &launchABI,
02861:                                      int64_t uniformIndex) {
02862:   for (const LaunchABIArgumentModel &arg : launchABI.arguments) {
02863:     if (arg.uniformIndex == uniformIndex)
02864:       return &arg;
02865:   }
02866:   return nullptr;
02867: }
02868: 
02869: static const LaunchABIBuiltinModel *
02870: findLaunchABIBuiltinForUniformIndex(const LaunchABIModel &launchABI,
02871:                                     int64_t uniformIndex) {
02872:   for (const LaunchABIBuiltinModel &builtin : launchABI.builtins) {
02873:     if (builtin.materialization == "uniform_suffix" && builtin.uniformIndex &&
02874:         *builtin.uniformIndex == uniformIndex)
02875:       return &builtin;
02876:   }
02877:   return nullptr;
02878: }
