02880: static void appendLauncherUniformLayoutComment(
02881:     llvm::raw_ostream &os, const LaunchABIModel &launchABI) {
02882:   os << "  /*\n";
02883:   os << "   * Dense physical uniform layout per logical request, ordered by ";
02884:   os << "vc4.launch_abi uniform_index:\n";
02885:   for (int64_t index = 0; index != launchABI.uniformWordsPerQPU; ++index) {
02886:     os << "   *   [" << index << "] ";
02887:     if (const LaunchABIArgumentModel *arg =
02888:             findLaunchABIArgumentForUniformIndex(launchABI, index)) {
02889:       os << "arg " << arg->name;
02890:     } else if (const LaunchABIBuiltinModel *builtin =
02891:                    findLaunchABIBuiltinForUniformIndex(launchABI, index)) {
02892:       os << "builtin " << builtin->name << " (" << builtin->kind << ")";
02893:     } else {
02894:       os << "<missing>";
02895:     }
02896:     os << "\n";
02897:   }
02898:   os << "   */\n";
02899: }
02900: 
02901: static LogicalResult writeLauncherSource(llvm::ArrayRef<KernelRecord> kernels,
02902:                                          llvm::StringRef bundleDir) {
02903:   KernelRecord &firstKernel = const_cast<KernelRecord &>(kernels.front());
02904:   ProgramLayoutModel programLayout = buildProgramLayoutModel(kernels);
02905:   std::string source;
02906:   llvm::raw_string_ostream os(source);
02907: 
02908:   const LaunchABIModel &firstABI = firstKernel.launchABI;
02909:   const std::string apiBase = getLaunchAPIBaseName(firstABI);
02910:   const std::string stateName = apiBase + "_program_state";
02911:   const std::string allocationsName = getRuntimeAllocationsFunctionName(firstABI);
02912:   const std::string launchesName = getRuntimeLaunchesFunctionName(firstABI);
02913:   const std::string capacityName = getRuntimeCapacityFunctionName(firstABI);
02914:   const std::string codeUploadsName = getRuntimeCodeUploadsFunctionName(firstABI);
02915:   const std::string launchFailuresName =
02916:       getRuntimeLaunchFailuresFunctionName(firstABI);
02917: 
02918:   bool requiresF32Packing = false;
02919:   bool requiresLaunchElements = false;
02920:   bool requiresCooperativeScheduling = false;
02921:   for (const KernelRecord &kernel : kernels) {
02922:     requiresF32Packing |= launchABIRequiresF32Packing(kernel.launchABI);
02923:     requiresCooperativeScheduling |=
02924:         kernel.resources.scheduleMode == "cooperative_block";
02925:     const LaunchABIArgumentModel *rowCountArgForLaunchShape =
02926:         findLaunchABIScalarArgumentNamed(kernel.launchABI, "m");
02927:     // Kernels with both m and n, such as GEMV, use m/n as semantic dimensions;
02928:     // neither scalar is necessarily the one-dimensional launch element count.
02929:     // Those kernels must use CUDA-like grid/block launch geometry to choose
02930:     // logical QPU requests.  Elementwise kernels with only an n scalar keep the
02931:     // convenient n-as-logical-count behavior.  Cooperative-block kernels also
02932:     // use launch geometry because block dimensions define resident warps.
02933:     requiresLaunchElements |=
02934:         requiresCooperativeScheduling || rowCountArgForLaunchShape ||
02935:         !findLaunchABILogicalCountArgument(kernel.launchABI);
02936:   }
02937: 
02938:   os << "#define VC4_CODEGEN_KERNEL_LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTATION 1\n";
02939:   os << "#include \"kernel_launch.h\"\n";
02940:   os << "#undef VC4_CODEGEN_KERNEL_LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTATION\n\n";
02941:   for (const KernelRecord &includeKernel : kernels)
02942:     os << "#include \"" << includeKernel.launchABI.codeSymbol << ".h\"\n";
02943:   os << "\n";
02944:   os << "#include <stddef.h>\n";
02945:   os << "#include <stdint.h>\n";
02946:   os << "#include <string.h>\n\n";
02947:   os << "#define VC4_CODEGEN_PROGRAM_HEAP_BYTES "
02948:      << programLayout.heapBytes << "u\n";
02949:   os << "#define VC4_CODEGEN_TARGET_VPM_BYTES 4096u\n";
02950:   os << "#define VC4_CODEGEN_TARGET_SEMAPHORES 16u\n";
02951:   for (const KernelRecord &macroKernel : kernels) {
02952:     os << "#define KERNEL_" << macroKernel.kernelId << "_NUM_UNIFS "
02953:        << macroKernel.info.uniformWordsPerQPU << "u\n";
02954:     os << "#define KERNEL_" << macroKernel.kernelId << "_WARPS_PER_BLOCK_MAX "
02955:        << macroKernel.resources.warpsPerBlockMax << "u\n";
02956:     os << "#define KERNEL_" << macroKernel.kernelId << "_SEMAPHORES_PER_BLOCK "
02957:        << macroKernel.resources.semaphoresPerBlock << "u\n";
02958:     os << "#define KERNEL_" << macroKernel.kernelId << "_VPM_BYTES_PER_BLOCK "
02959:        << macroKernel.resources.vpmBytesPerBlock << "u\n";
02960:     os << "#define KERNEL_" << macroKernel.kernelId << "_VPM_ROWS_PER_BLOCK "
02961:        << macroKernel.resources.vpmRowsPerBlock << "u\n";
02962:     os << "#define KERNEL_" << macroKernel.kernelId << "_MAX_RESIDENT_BLOCKS "
02963:        << macroKernel.resources.maxResidentBlocks << "u\n";
02964:   }
02965:   os << "\n";
02966:   os << "/* VC4_RUNTIME_LAYOUT program_bytes=" << programLayout.programBytes
02967:      << " static_bytes=" << programLayout.staticBytes
02968:      << " heap_offset=" << programLayout.heapOffset
02969:      << " heap_bytes=" << programLayout.heapBytes
02970:      << " kernels=" << kernels.size() << " */\n";
02971:   os << "/* Generated launches pack kernel-specific uniforms; libpi owns "
02972:         "allocation, code residency, queueing, and heap/copy APIs. */\n\n";
02973: 
02974:   if (requiresF32Packing) {
02975:     os << "static uint32_t vc4_codegen_pack_f32(float value) {\n";
02976:     os << "  uint32_t bits;\n";
02977:     os << "  memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));\n";
02978:     os << "  return bits;\n";
02979:     os << "}\n\n";
02980:   }
02981: 
02982:   os << "static uint32_t vc4_codegen_ceil_div_u32(uint32_t value, uint32_t divisor) {\n";
02983:   os << "  if (value == 0u)\n";
02984:   os << "    return 0u;\n";
02985:   os << "  if (divisor == 0u)\n";
02986:   os << "    return 0xffffffffu;\n";
02987:   os << "  return 1u + (value - 1u) / divisor;\n";
02988:   os << "}\n\n";
02989: 
02990:   if (requiresLaunchElements) {
02991:     os << "static uint32_t vc4_codegen_saturating_mul_u32(uint32_t lhs, uint32_t rhs) {\n";
02992:     os << "  if (lhs != 0u && rhs > 0xffffffffu / lhs)\n";
02993:     os << "    return 0xffffffffu;\n";
02994:     os << "  return lhs * rhs;\n";
02995:     os << "}\n\n";
02996: 
02997:     os << "static uint32_t vc4_codegen_launch_elements(vc4_dim3 grid, vc4_dim3 block) {\n";
02998:     os << "  uint32_t total = 1u;\n";
02999:     os << "  total = vc4_codegen_saturating_mul_u32(total, grid.x);\n";
03000:     os << "  total = vc4_codegen_saturating_mul_u32(total, grid.y);\n";
03001:     os << "  total = vc4_codegen_saturating_mul_u32(total, grid.z);\n";
03002:     os << "  total = vc4_codegen_saturating_mul_u32(total, block.x);\n";
03003:     os << "  total = vc4_codegen_saturating_mul_u32(total, block.y);\n";
03004:     os << "  total = vc4_codegen_saturating_mul_u32(total, block.z);\n";
03005:     os << "  return total;\n";
03006:     os << "}\n\n";
03007:   }
03008: 
03009:   if (requiresCooperativeScheduling) {
03010:     os << "static uint32_t vc4_codegen_min_u32(uint32_t lhs, uint32_t rhs) {\n";
03011:     os << "  return lhs < rhs ? lhs : rhs;\n";
03012:     os << "}\n\n";
03013:     os << "static uint32_t vc4_codegen_grid_blocks(vc4_dim3 grid) {\n";
03014:     os << "  uint32_t total = 1u;\n";
03015:     os << "  total = vc4_codegen_saturating_mul_u32(total, grid.x);\n";
03016:     os << "  total = vc4_codegen_saturating_mul_u32(total, grid.y);\n";
03017:     os << "  total = vc4_codegen_saturating_mul_u32(total, grid.z);\n";
03018:     os << "  return total;\n";
03019:     os << "}\n\n";
03020:     os << "static uint32_t vc4_codegen_block_warps(vc4_dim3 block) {\n";
03021:     os << "  uint32_t total = 1u;\n";
03022:     os << "  total = vc4_codegen_saturating_mul_u32(total, block.x);\n";
03023:     os << "  total = vc4_codegen_saturating_mul_u32(total, block.y);\n";
03024:     os << "  total = vc4_codegen_saturating_mul_u32(total, block.z);\n";
03025:     os << "  return vc4_codegen_ceil_div_u32(total, VC4_RUNTIME_LANE_WIDTH);\n";
03026:     os << "}\n\n";
03027:   }
03028: 
03029:   os << "static const struct vc4_kernel_image vc4_codegen_kernels[] = {\n";
03030:   for (const KernelRecord &kernel : kernels) {
03031:     os << "  { \"" << kernel.launchABI.publicName << "\", "
03032:        << kernel.launchABI.codeSymbol << ", (uint32_t)(sizeof("
03033:        << kernel.launchABI.codeSymbol << ") / sizeof(uint32_t)), KERNEL_"
03034:        << kernel.kernelId
03035:        << "_NUM_UNIFS, VC4_RUNTIME_MAX_QPUS, "
03036:        << getScheduleModeMacro(kernel.resources) << ", "
03037:        << getKernelResourceFlagsExpression(kernel.resources) << ", KERNEL_"
03038:        << kernel.kernelId << "_WARPS_PER_BLOCK_MAX, KERNEL_"
03039:        << kernel.kernelId << "_SEMAPHORES_PER_BLOCK, KERNEL_"
03040:        << kernel.kernelId << "_VPM_BYTES_PER_BLOCK, KERNEL_"
03041:        << kernel.kernelId << "_VPM_ROWS_PER_BLOCK, KERNEL_"
03042:        << kernel.kernelId << "_MAX_RESIDENT_BLOCKS },\n";
03043:   }
03044:   os << "};\n\n";
03045:   for (const KernelRecord &resourceKernel : kernels) {
03046:     os << "/* VC4_KERNEL_RESOURCE kernel_id=" << resourceKernel.kernelId
03047:        << " public_name=" << resourceKernel.launchABI.publicName
03048:        << " schedule_mode=" << resourceKernel.resources.scheduleMode
03049:        << " resident_blocks=" << resourceKernel.resources.maxResidentBlocks
03050:        << " warps_per_block_max=" << resourceKernel.resources.warpsPerBlockMax
03051:        << " semaphore_base=resident_slot*" << resourceKernel.resources.semaphoresPerBlock
03052:        << " vpm_base_row=resident_slot*" << resourceKernel.resources.vpmRowsPerBlock
03053:        << " full_residency resident_wave_wait_before_resource_reuse="
03054:        << (resourceKernel.resources.requireFullBlockResidency ? 1 : 0)
03055:        << " */\n";
03056:   }
03057:   os << "\n";
03058:   os << "static const struct vc4_module_image vc4_codegen_module = {\n";
03059:   os << "  VC4_RUNTIME_MODULE_VERSION,\n";
03060:   os << "  (uint32_t)(sizeof(vc4_codegen_kernels) / sizeof(vc4_codegen_kernels[0])),\n";
03061:   os << "  VC4_CODEGEN_PROGRAM_HEAP_BYTES,\n";
03062:   os << "  vc4_codegen_kernels,\n";
03063:   os << "};\n\n";
03064:   os << "int vc4_program_create(struct vc4_program **out, uint32_t requested_bytes) {\n";
03065:   os << "  return vc4ProgramCreateFromImage(out, &vc4_codegen_module, requested_bytes);\n";
03066:   os << "}\n\n";
03067: 
03068:   for (const KernelRecord &launchKernel : kernels) {
03069:     const LaunchABIModel &kernelABI = launchKernel.launchABI;
03070:     const std::string kernelBase = getLaunchAPIBaseName(kernelABI);
03071:     os << "struct " << kernelBase << "_pack_ctx {\n";
03072:     os << "  uint32_t __vc4_unused;\n";
03073:     for (const LaunchABIArgumentModel &arg : kernelABI.arguments) {
03074:       if (arg.kind == LaunchABIArgumentKind::Buffer) {
03075:         os << "  vc4_deviceptr_t " << arg.name << ";\n";
03076:       } else {
03077:         std::optional<std::string> cType = getScalarCType(arg.scalarType);
03078:         if (!cType)
03079:           return emitLaunchABIModelError(
03080:               launchKernel.func,
03081:               llvm::Twine("unsupported scalar type for launcher context: ") +
03082:                   arg.scalarType);
03083:         os << "  " << *cType << " " << arg.name << ";\n";
03084:       }
03085:     }
03086:     os << "};\n\n";
03087: 
03088:     os << "static int " << kernelBase
03089:        << "_pack_uniforms(void *opaque, const struct vc4_launch_request_info *requestInfo, "
03090:           "uint32_t *uniformWords, uint32_t uniformWordsPerRequest) {\n";
03091:     os << "  struct " << kernelBase
03092:        << "_pack_ctx *ctx = (struct " << kernelBase << "_pack_ctx *)opaque;\n";
03093:     os << "  if (!ctx || !requestInfo || !uniformWords || uniformWordsPerRequest < KERNEL_"
03094:        << launchKernel.kernelId << "_NUM_UNIFS)\n";
03095:     os << "    return -1;\n";
03096:     appendLauncherUniformLayoutComment(os, kernelABI);
03097:     for (int64_t index = 0; index != kernelABI.uniformWordsPerQPU; ++index) {
03098:       if (const LaunchABIArgumentModel *arg =
03099:               findLaunchABIArgumentForUniformIndex(kernelABI, index)) {
03100:         if (launchKernel.resources.scheduleMode == "cooperative_block" &&
03101:             arg->kind == LaunchABIArgumentKind::Scalar) {
03102:           if (arg->name == "logical_warp_id") {
03103:             os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = requestInfo->logical_warp_id; /* arg "
03104:                << arg->name << " supplied by cooperative scheduler */\n";
03105:             continue;
03106:           }
03107:           if (arg->name == "warps_per_block") {
03108:             os << "  uniformWords[" << index
03109:                << "] = requestInfo->warps_per_block; /* arg " << arg->name
03110:                << " supplied by cooperative scheduler */\n";
03111:             continue;
03112:           }
03113:           if (arg->name == "logical_block_id") {
03114:             os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = requestInfo->logical_block_id; /* arg "
03115:                << arg->name << " supplied by cooperative scheduler */\n";
03116:             continue;
03117:           }
03118:           if (arg->name == "vpm_base_row") {
03119:             os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = requestInfo->vpm_base_row; /* arg "
03120:                << arg->name << " supplied by cooperative scheduler */\n";
03121:             continue;
03122:           }
03123:           if (arg->name == "vpm_rows") {
03124:             os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = requestInfo->vpm_rows; /* arg "
03125:                << arg->name << " supplied by cooperative scheduler */\n";
03126:             continue;
03127:           }
03128:           if (arg->name == "semaphore_base") {
03129:             os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = requestInfo->semaphore_base; /* arg "
03130:                << arg->name << " supplied by cooperative scheduler */\n";
03131:             continue;
03132:           }
03133:           if (arg->name == "barrier_arrive_sem") {
03134:             os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = requestInfo->barrier_arrive_sem; /* arg "
03135:                << arg->name << " supplied by cooperative scheduler */\n";
03136:             continue;
03137:           }
03138:           if (arg->name == "barrier_go_sem") {
03139:             os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = requestInfo->barrier_go_sem; /* arg "
03140:                << arg->name << " supplied by cooperative scheduler */\n";
03141:             continue;
03142:           }
03143:           if (arg->name == "barrier_depart_sem") {
03144:             os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = requestInfo->barrier_depart_sem; /* arg "
03145:                << arg->name << " supplied by cooperative scheduler */\n";
03146:             continue;
03147:           }
03148:           if (arg->name == "barrier_reset_sem") {
03149:             os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = requestInfo->barrier_reset_sem; /* arg "
03150:                << arg->name << " supplied by cooperative scheduler */\n";
03151:             continue;
03152:           }
03153:         }
03154:         if (arg->kind == LaunchABIArgumentKind::Buffer) {
03155:           os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = (uint32_t)ctx->"
03156:              << arg->name << "; /* arg " << arg->name << " */\n";
03157:         } else if (arg->scalarType == "f32") {
03158:           os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = vc4_codegen_pack_f32(ctx->"
03159:              << arg->name << "); /* arg " << arg->name << " */\n";
03160:         } else {
03161:           os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = (uint32_t)ctx->"
03162:              << arg->name << "; /* arg " << arg->name << " */\n";
03163:         }
03164:         continue;
03165:       }
03166: 
03167:       if (const LaunchABIBuiltinModel *builtin =
03168:               findLaunchABIBuiltinForUniformIndex(kernelABI, index)) {
03169:         if (builtin->kind == "qpu_num") {
03170:           if (launchKernel.resources.scheduleMode == "cooperative_block") {
03171:             os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = requestInfo->logical_warp_id; /* builtin "
03172:                << builtin->name << " logical_warp_id for cooperative_block */\n";
03173:           } else {
03174:             os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = requestInfo->logical_request; /* builtin "
03175:                << builtin->name << " */\n";
03176:           }
03177:         } else if (builtin->kind == "num_qpus") {
03178:           if (launchKernel.resources.scheduleMode == "cooperative_block") {
03179:             os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = requestInfo->warps_per_block; /* builtin "
03180:                << builtin->name << " warps_per_block for cooperative_block */\n";
03181:           } else {
03182:             os << "  uniformWords[" << index << "] = requestInfo->total_requests; /* builtin "
03183:                << builtin->name << " */\n";
03184:           }
03185:         } else {
03186:           return emitLaunchABIModelError(
03187:               launchKernel.func, llvm::Twine("builtin '") + builtin->name +
03188:                                     "' has unsupported kind for launcher uniform packing");
03189:         }
03190:         continue;
03191:       }
03192: 
03193:       return emitLaunchABIModelError(
03194:           launchKernel.func,
03195:           llvm::Twine("missing launcher uniform assignment for index ") +
03196:               std::to_string(index));
03197:     }
03198:     os << "  return 0;\n";
03199:     os << "}\n\n";
03200:   }
03201: 
03202:   for (const KernelRecord &launchKernel : kernels) {
03203:     const LaunchABIModel &kernelABI = launchKernel.launchABI;
03204:     const std::string kernelBase = getLaunchAPIBaseName(kernelABI);
03205:     llvm::SmallVector<const LaunchABIArgumentModel *, 4> bufferArgs =
03206:         collectLaunchABIBufferArguments(kernelABI);
03207:     const LaunchABIArgumentModel *rowCountArg =
03208:         findLaunchABIScalarArgumentNamed(kernelABI, "m");
03209:     const LaunchABIArgumentModel *logicalCountArg =
03210:         rowCountArg ? nullptr : findLaunchABILogicalCountArgument(kernelABI);
03211:     const LaunchABIArgumentModel *validationCountArg = logicalCountArg;
03212: 
03213:     appendLauncherPrototype(os, kernelABI);
03214:     os << " {\n";
03215:     if (launchKernel.resources.scheduleMode == "cooperative_block") {
03216:       os << "  uint32_t gridBlocks = vc4_codegen_grid_blocks(grid);\n";
03217:       os << "  uint32_t warpsPerBlock = vc4_codegen_block_warps(block);\n";
03218:       os << "  uint32_t logicalN = gridBlocks;\n";
03219:       os << "  if (warpsPerBlock == 0u || warpsPerBlock > KERNEL_" << launchKernel.kernelId << "_WARPS_PER_BLOCK_MAX || warpsPerBlock > VC4_RUNTIME_MAX_QPUS) {\n";
03220:       os << "    vc4ProgramRecordLaunchFailure(program);\n";
03221:       os << "    return -1;\n";
03222:       os << "  }\n";
03223:       os << "  /* schedule_mode=cooperative_block; runtime computes resident_blocks and waits before VPM/semaphore resource reuse. */\n";
03224:       os << "  uint32_t totalRequests = vc4_codegen_saturating_mul_u32(gridBlocks, warpsPerBlock);\n";
03225:     } else {
03226:       if (validationCountArg) {
03227:         os << "  uint32_t logicalN = (uint32_t)" << validationCountArg->name << ";\n";
03228:       } else {
03229:         os << "  uint32_t logicalN = vc4_codegen_launch_elements(grid, block);\n";
03230:       }
03231:       if (kernelABI.tailPolicy == "exact_multiple")
03232:         os << "  uint32_t totalRequests = logicalN == 0u ? 0u : VC4_RUNTIME_MAX_QPUS;\n";
03233:       else
03234:       os << "  uint32_t totalRequests = vc4_codegen_ceil_div_u32(logicalN, VC4_RUNTIME_LANE_WIDTH);\n";
03235:       os << "  uint32_t warpsPerBlock = 1u;\n";
03236:       os << "  (void)grid;\n";
03237:       os << "  (void)block;\n";
03238:     }
03239:     os << "  (void)logicalN;\n";
03240:     for (const LaunchABIArgumentModel *arg : bufferArgs) {
03241:       std::string elemType = getBufferElementCTypeForCodegen(*arg);
03242:       os << "  if (totalRequests != 0u) {\n";
03243:       os << "    size_t arg_bytes = sizeof(" << elemType << ");\n";
03244:       os << "    if (arg_bytes > 0xffffffffu || !vc4DeviceRangeIsAllocated(program, "
03245:          << arg->name << ", (uint32_t)arg_bytes)) {\n";
03246:       os << "      vc4ProgramRecordLaunchFailure(program);\n";
03247:       os << "      return -1;\n";
03248:       os << "    }\n";
03249:       os << "  }\n";
03250:     }
03251:     os << "  struct " << kernelBase << "_pack_ctx ctx;\n";
03252:     os << "  memset(&ctx, 0, sizeof(ctx));\n";
03253:     for (const LaunchABIArgumentModel &arg : kernelABI.arguments)
03254:       os << "  ctx." << arg.name << " = " << arg.name << ";\n";
03255:     os << "  return vc4LaunchKernel(program, " << launchKernel.kernelId
03256:        << "u, totalRequests, warpsPerBlock, " << kernelBase
03257:        << "_pack_uniforms, &ctx);\n";
03258:     os << "}\n\n";
03259:   }
03260: 
03261:   os << "uint32_t " << allocationsName << "(void) {\n";
03262:   os << "  return vc4RuntimeProgramAllocations();\n";
03263:   os << "}\n\n";
03264: 
03265:   os << "uint32_t " << launchesName << "(void) {\n";
03266:   os << "  return vc4ProgramLaunches(vc4RuntimeCurrentProgram());\n";
03267:   os << "}\n\n";
03268: 
03269:   os << "uint32_t " << capacityName << "(void) {\n";
03270:   os << "  return vc4ProgramCapacity(vc4RuntimeCurrentProgram());\n";
03271:   os << "}\n\n";
03272: 
03273:   os << "uint32_t " << codeUploadsName << "(void) {\n";
03274:   os << "  return vc4ProgramCodeUploads(vc4RuntimeCurrentProgram());\n";
03275:   os << "}\n\n";
03276: 
03277:   os << "uint32_t " << launchFailuresName << "(void) {\n";
03278:   os << "  return vc4ProgramLaunchFailures(vc4RuntimeCurrentProgram());\n";
03279:   os << "}\n";
03280:   os.flush();
03281: 
03282:   return writeBundleFile(firstKernel.func.getOperation(), bundleDir,
03283:                          "kernel_launch.c",
03284:                          [&](llvm::raw_ostream &fileOS) { fileOS << source; });
03285: }

03287: static void appendManifestLaunchABIArgument(llvm::raw_ostream &os,
03288:                                             const LaunchABIArgumentModel &arg,
03289:                                             bool trailingComma) {
03290:   os << "      {\"name\": ";
03291:   appendJSONEscapedString(os, arg.name);
03292:   os << ", \"kind\": ";
03293:   appendJSONEscapedString(os, arg.kind == LaunchABIArgumentKind::Scalar
03294:                                   ? "scalar"
03295:                                   : "buffer");
03296:   os << ", \"direction\": ";
03297:   appendJSONEscapedString(os, arg.direction);
03298:   if (arg.kind == LaunchABIArgumentKind::Scalar) {
03299:     os << ", \"type\": ";
03300:     appendJSONEscapedString(os, arg.scalarType);
03301:   } else {
03302:     os << ", \"elem_type\": ";
03303:     appendJSONEscapedString(os, arg.elementType);
03304:   }
03305:   os << ", \"c_type\": ";
03306:   appendJSONEscapedString(os, arg.cType);
03307:   os << ", \"uniform_index\": " << arg.uniformIndex << "}";
03308:   if (trailingComma)
03309:     os << ",";
03310:   os << "\n";
03311: }

03313: static void appendManifestLaunchABIBuiltin(llvm::raw_ostream &os,
03314:                                            const LaunchABIBuiltinModel &builtin,
03315:                                            bool trailingComma) {
03316:   os << "      {\"name\": ";
03317:   appendJSONEscapedString(os, builtin.name);
03318:   os << ", \"kind\": ";
03319:   appendJSONEscapedString(os, builtin.kind);
03320:   os << ", \"materialization\": ";
03321:   appendJSONEscapedString(os, builtin.materialization);
03322:   if (builtin.uniformIndex)
03323:     os << ", \"uniform_index\": " << *builtin.uniformIndex;
03324:   os << "}";
03325:   if (trailingComma)
03326:     os << ",";
03327:   os << "\n";
03328: }

03334:                                     i + 1 != launchABI.arguments.size());

03343:   }

03346: static void appendManifestKernelEntry(llvm::raw_ostream &os,
03347:                                       const KernelRecord &kernel,
03348:                                       bool trailingComma) {
03349:   os << "    {\n";
03350:   os << "      \"kernel_id\": " << kernel.kernelId << ",\n";

03353:   os << ",\n";
03354:   os << "      \"public_name\": ";
03355:   appendJSONEscapedString(os, kernel.info.publicName);
03356:   os << ",\n";
03357:   os << "      \"qasm_path\": ";
03358:   appendJSONEscapedString(os, kernel.qasmPath);
03359:   os << ",\n";
03360:   os << "      \"code_symbol\": ";
03361:   appendJSONEscapedString(os, kernel.launchABI.codeSymbol);
03362:   os << ",\n";
03363:   os << "      \"scheduled_sink_ops\": "
03364:      << kernel.info.scheduledOpCount << ",\n";
03365:   os << "      \"uniform_words_per_request\": "
03366:      << kernel.info.uniformWordsPerQPU << ",\n";
03367:   os << "      \"uniform_words_per_qpu\": "
03368:      << kernel.info.uniformWordsPerQPU << ",\n";
03369:   os << "      \"max_requests_per_wave\": 12,\n";
03370:   os << "      \"tail_policy\": ";
03371:   appendJSONEscapedString(os, kernel.launchABI.tailPolicy);
03372:   os << ",\n";
03373:   os << "      \"schedule_mode\": ";
03374:   appendJSONEscapedString(os, kernel.resources.scheduleMode);
03375:   os << ",\n";
03376:   os << "      \"args\": [\n";
03377:   appendManifestKernelArguments(os, kernel.launchABI);
03378:   os << "      ],\n";
03379:   os << "      \"builtins\": [\n";
03380:   appendManifestKernelBuiltins(os, kernel.launchABI);
03381:   os << "      ],\n";
03382:   os << "      \"resources\": {\n";
03383:   os << "        \"uses_barrier\": " << (kernel.resources.usesBarrier ? "true" : "false") << ",\n";
03384:   os << "        \"uses_shared_vpm\": " << (kernel.resources.usesSharedVPM ? "true" : "false") << ",\n";
03385:   os << "        \"require_full_block_residency\": " << (kernel.resources.requireFullBlockResidency ? "true" : "false") << ",\n";
03386:   os << "        \"vpm_bytes_per_block\": " << kernel.resources.vpmBytesPerBlock << ",\n";
03387:   os << "        \"shared_vpm_bytes\": " << kernel.resources.vpmBytesPerBlock << ",\n";
03388:   os << "        \"vpm_rows_per_block\": " << kernel.resources.vpmRowsPerBlock << ",\n";
03389:   os << "        \"semaphores_per_block\": " << kernel.resources.semaphoresPerBlock << ",\n";
03390:   os << "        \"warps_per_block_max\": " << kernel.resources.warpsPerBlockMax << ",\n";
03391:   os << "        \"max_resident_blocks\": " << kernel.resources.maxResidentBlocks << "\n";
03392:   os << "      }\n";
03393:   os << "    }";
03394:   if (trailingComma)
03395:     os << ",";
03396:   os << "\n";
03397: }

03423: 
03424: static void appendKernelLayoutJSON(llvm::raw_ostream &os,

03514: static LogicalResult writeManifest(mlir::vc4::ModuleOp vc4Module,
03515:                                    llvm::ArrayRef<KernelRecord> kernels,

03524:                            os << ",\n";
03525:                            os << "  \"target\": {\n";
03526:                            os << "    \"name\": \"vc4-bcm2835-user-qpu\",\n";
03527:                            os << "    \"warp_size\": 16,\n";
03528:                            os << "    \"max_active_qpus\": 12,\n";
03529:                            os << "    \"shared_vpm_bytes\": 4096,\n";
03530:                            os << "    \"semaphores\": 16\n";
03531:                            os << "  },\n";
03532:                            os << "  \"kernels\": [\n";
03533:                            for (size_t i = 0; i != kernels.size(); ++i) {
03534:                              appendManifestKernelEntry(
03535:                                  os, kernels[i], i + 1 != kernels.size());
03536:                            }
03537:                            os << "  ],\n";
03538:                            os << "  \"artifacts\": [\n";
03539:                            os << "    \"kernel_launch.c\",\n";
03540:                            os << "    \"kernel_launch.h\",\n";
03541:                            os << "    \"layout.json\"";
03542:                            for (const KernelRecord &kernel : kernels) {
03543:                              os << ",\n    ";
03544:                              appendJSONEscapedString(os, kernel.qasmPath);
03545:                            }
03546:                            os << "\n  ]\n";
03547:                            os << "}\n";
03548:                          });
03549: }

03552: 
03553: LogicalResult mlir::vc4::emitVC4ArtifactBundle(mlir::ModuleOp module,
03554:                                                llvm::StringRef bundleDir) {
03555:   llvm::SmallVector<mlir::vc4::ModuleOp, 1> vc4Modules;
03556:   module.walk([&](mlir::vc4::ModuleOp vc4Module) {
03557:     vc4Modules.push_back(vc4Module);
03558:   });
03559:   if (vc4Modules.size() != 1) {
03560:     return module.emitError()
03561:            << "expected exactly one vc4.module for artifact emission";
03562:   }
03563: 
03564:   mlir::vc4::ModuleOp vc4Module = vc4Modules.front();
03565:   llvm::SmallVector<KernelRecord, 1> kernels;
03566:   if (failed(collectProgramKernels(vc4Module, kernels)))
03567:     return failure();
03568: 
03569:   std::error_code ec = llvm::sys::fs::create_directories(bundleDir);
03570:   if (ec) {
03571:     return module.emitError() << "failed to create artifact bundle directory '"
03572:                               << bundleDir << "': " << ec.message();
03573:   }
03574: 
03575:   if (failed(ensureAdjacentVC4ASMTemplates(module.getOperation(), bundleDir)))
03576:     return failure();
03577: 
03578:   for (KernelRecord &kernel : kernels) {
03579:     if (failed(writeQASM(kernel, bundleDir)))
03580:       return failure();
03581:   }
03582:   if (failed(writeLauncherSource(kernels, bundleDir)))
03583:     return failure();
03584:   if (failed(writeLauncherHeader(kernels, bundleDir)))
03585:     return failure();
03586:   if (failed(writeProgramLayout(vc4Module, kernels, bundleDir)))
03587:     return failure();
03588:   if (failed(writeManifest(vc4Module, kernels, bundleDir)))
03589:     return failure();
03590: 
03591:   return success();
03592: }

00049: // Structured arithmetic/value-shape SSA uses only 32-bit VC4 carrier words:
00050: // scalar i32/f32 values or 16-lane vectors of those element types.
00051: // pack/unpack stay in this carrier-word domain instead of materializing true
00052: // i8/i16 storage types in the IR.
00053: static bool isVector16Of32BitVC4ValueType(Type type) {
00054:   auto vectorType = dyn_cast<VectorType>(type);
00055:   if (!vectorType || vectorType.getRank() != 1 || vectorType.isScalable())
00056:     return false;
00057:   if (vectorType.getDimSize(0) != 16)
00058:     return false;
00059:   return isScalar32BitVC4ValueType(vectorType.getElementType());
00060: }

00064:          isVector16Of32BitVC4ValueType(type);

00067: static bool hasSameVC4Shape(Type lhs, Type rhs) {
00068:   if (lhs.isSignlessInteger(32) || lhs.isF32())
00069:     return rhs.isSignlessInteger(32) || rhs.isF32();
00070: 
00071:   auto lhsVector = dyn_cast<VectorType>(lhs);
00072:   auto rhsVector = dyn_cast<VectorType>(rhs);
00073:   if (!lhsVector || !rhsVector)
00074:     return false;
00075:   return lhsVector.getRank() == 1 && rhsVector.getRank() == 1 &&
00076:          !lhsVector.isScalable() && !rhsVector.isScalable() &&
00077:          lhsVector.getDimSize(0) == 16 && rhsVector.getDimSize(0) == 16;
00078: }

00127: static LogicalResult verifyLaunchAbiArg(mlir::vc4::FuncOp op,
00128:                                         DictionaryAttr arg,
00129:                                         SmallVectorImpl<int64_t> &indices) {
00130:   if (!isNonEmptyStringAttr(arg.get("name")))
00131:     return emitLaunchAbiError(op,
00132:                               "argument entry requires a non-empty string 'name'");
00133: 
00134:   auto kindAttr = dyn_cast_or_null<StringAttr>(arg.get("kind"));
00135:   if (!kindAttr ||
00136:       !isStringOneOf(kindAttr.getValue(), {"scalar", "buffer"})) {
00137:     return emitLaunchAbiError(
00138:         op, "argument entry requires kind = \"scalar\" or \"buffer\"");
00139:   }
00140: 
00141:   auto directionAttr = dyn_cast_or_null<StringAttr>(arg.get("direction"));
00142:   if (!directionAttr)
00143:     return emitLaunchAbiError(op, "argument entry requires string 'direction'");
00144: 
00145:   if (kindAttr.getValue() == "scalar") {
00146:     if (directionAttr.getValue() != "by_value") {
00147:       return emitLaunchAbiError(
00148:           op, "scalar argument entry requires direction = \"by_value\"");
00149:     }
00150:     auto typeAttr = dyn_cast_or_null<StringAttr>(arg.get("type"));
00151:     if (!typeAttr ||
00152:         !isStringOneOf(typeAttr.getValue(), {"i32", "u32", "f32", "index"})) {
00153:       return emitLaunchAbiError(
00154:           op, "scalar argument entry requires type = \"i32\", \"u32\", "
00155:               "\"f32\", or \"index\"");
00156:     }
00157:     if (arg.get("elem_type")) {
00158:       return emitLaunchAbiError(
00159:           op, "scalar argument entry must not specify 'elem_type'");
00160:     }
00161:   } else {
00162:     if (!isStringOneOf(directionAttr.getValue(), {"in", "out", "inout"})) {
00163:       return emitLaunchAbiError(
00164:           op, "buffer argument entry requires direction = \"in\", \"out\", "
00165:               "or \"inout\"");
00166:     }
00167:     auto elemTypeAttr = dyn_cast_or_null<StringAttr>(arg.get("elem_type"));
00168:     if (!elemTypeAttr ||
00169:         !isStringOneOf(elemTypeAttr.getValue(),
00170:                        {"i8", "u8", "i16", "u16", "i32", "u32", "f32"})) {
00171:       return emitLaunchAbiError(
00172:           op, "buffer argument entry requires elem_type = \"i8\", \"u8\", "
00173:               "\"i16\", \"u16\", \"i32\", \"u32\", or \"f32\"");
00174:     }
00175:     if (arg.get("type"))
00176:       return emitLaunchAbiError(op,
00177:                                 "buffer argument entry must not specify 'type'");
00178:   }
00179: 
00180:   return verifyLaunchAbiUniformIndex(op, arg, "argument", indices);
00181: }

00183: static LogicalResult verifyLaunchAbiBuiltin(mlir::vc4::FuncOp op,
00184:                                             DictionaryAttr builtin,
00185:                                             SmallVectorImpl<int64_t> &indices) {
00186:   if (!isNonEmptyStringAttr(builtin.get("name")))
00187:     return emitLaunchAbiError(op,
00188:                               "builtin entry requires a non-empty string 'name'");
00189: 
00190:   auto kindAttr =
00191:       dyn_cast_or_null<mlir::vc4::BuiltinKindAttr>(builtin.get("kind"));
00192:   if (!kindAttr)
00193:     return emitLaunchAbiError(op, "builtin entry requires VC4 BuiltinKindAttr "
00194:                                   "'kind'");
00195: 
00196:   auto materializationAttr =
00197:       dyn_cast_or_null<StringAttr>(builtin.get("materialization"));
00198:   if (!materializationAttr ||
00199:       !isStringOneOf(materializationAttr.getValue(),
00200:                      {"uniform_suffix", "register"})) {
00201:     return emitLaunchAbiError(
00202:         op, "builtin entry requires materialization = \"uniform_suffix\" or "
00203:             "\"register\"");
00204:   }
00205: 
00206:   mlir::vc4::BuiltinKind kind = kindAttr.getValue();
00207:   StringRef materialization = materializationAttr.getValue();
00208:   if (kind == mlir::vc4::BuiltinKind::elem_num) {
00209:     return emitLaunchAbiError(
00210:         op, "builtin kind #vc4.builtin_kind<elem_num> must not appear");
00211:   }
00212:   if (kind == mlir::vc4::BuiltinKind::num_qpus &&
00213:       materialization != "uniform_suffix") {
00214:     return emitLaunchAbiError(
00215:         op, "builtin kind #vc4.builtin_kind<num_qpus> must use "
00216:             "materialization = \"uniform_suffix\"");
00217:   }
00218: 
00219:   if (materialization == "uniform_suffix")
00220:     return verifyLaunchAbiUniformIndex(op, builtin, "builtin", indices);
00221: 
00222:   if (builtin.get("uniform_index")) {
00223:     return emitLaunchAbiError(
00224:         op, "register-materialized builtin entry must not specify "
00225:             "'uniform_index'");
00226:   }
00227:   return success();
00228: }

00230: static LogicalResult verifyLaunchAbiUniformLayout(
00231:     mlir::vc4::FuncOp op, int64_t uniformWordsPerQPU,
00232:     ArrayRef<int64_t> indices) {
00233:   if (static_cast<int64_t>(indices.size()) != uniformWordsPerQPU) {
00234:     return emitLaunchAbiError(
00235:         op, "uniform indices must be unique and dense in [0, "
00236:             "uniform_words_per_qpu)");
00237:   }
00238: 
00239:   llvm::SmallSet<int64_t, 8> seen;
00240:   for (int64_t index : indices) {
00241:     if (index < 0 || index >= uniformWordsPerQPU ||
00242:         !seen.insert(index).second) {
00243:       return emitLaunchAbiError(
00244:           op, "uniform indices must be unique and dense in [0, "
00245:               "uniform_words_per_qpu)");
00246:     }
00247:   }
00248: 
00249:   for (int64_t index = 0; index < uniformWordsPerQPU; ++index) {
00250:     if (!seen.count(index)) {
00251:       return emitLaunchAbiError(
00252:           op, "uniform indices must be unique and dense in [0, "
00253:               "uniform_words_per_qpu)");
00254:     }
00255:   }
00256:   return success();
00257: }

00259: static LogicalResult verifyLaunchAbi(mlir::vc4::FuncOp op) {
00260:   Attribute rawAttr = op->getAttr("vc4.launch_abi");
00261:   if (!rawAttr)
00262:     return success();
00263: 
00264:   auto launchAbi = dyn_cast<DictionaryAttr>(rawAttr);
00265:   if (!launchAbi)
00266:     return emitLaunchAbiError(op, "requires a dictionary attribute");
00267: 
00268:   if (!op.getKernelAttr()) {
00269:     return emitLaunchAbiError(op,
00270:                               "may appear only on vc4.func with 'kernel'");
00271:   }
00272:   if (!op.getDomain() || *op.getDomain() != mlir::vc4::ExecutionDomain::qpu) {
00273:     return emitLaunchAbiError(
00274:         op, "requires domain = #vc4.execution_domain<qpu>");
00275:   }
00276: 
00277:   if (!isNonEmptyStringAttr(launchAbi.get("public_name"))) {
00278:     return emitLaunchAbiError(
00279:         op, "requires a non-empty string 'public_name'");
00280:   }
00281: 
00282:   auto tailPolicyAttr =
00283:       dyn_cast_or_null<StringAttr>(launchAbi.get("tail_policy"));
00284:   if (!tailPolicyAttr ||
00285:       !isStringOneOf(tailPolicyAttr.getValue(),
00286:                      {"exact_multiple", "tail_safe"})) {
00287:     return emitLaunchAbiError(
00288:         op, "requires tail_policy = \"exact_multiple\" or \"tail_safe\"");
00289:   }
00290: 
00291:   std::optional<int64_t> uniformWordsPerQPU =
00292:       getSignlessI32AttrValue(launchAbi, "uniform_words_per_qpu");
00293:   if (!uniformWordsPerQPU || *uniformWordsPerQPU <= 0) {
00294:     return emitLaunchAbiError(
00295:         op, "requires a positive signless i32 'uniform_words_per_qpu'");
00296:   }
00297: 
00298:   auto argsAttr = dyn_cast_or_null<ArrayAttr>(launchAbi.get("args"));
00299:   if (!argsAttr)
00300:     return emitLaunchAbiError(op, "requires array 'args'");
00301: 
00302:   auto builtinsAttr = dyn_cast_or_null<ArrayAttr>(launchAbi.get("builtins"));
00303:   if (!builtinsAttr)
00304:     return emitLaunchAbiError(op, "requires array 'builtins'");
00305: 
00306:   SmallVector<int64_t> uniformIndices;
00307:   for (Attribute argAttr : argsAttr) {
00308:     auto arg = dyn_cast<DictionaryAttr>(argAttr);
00309:     if (!arg)
00310:       return emitLaunchAbiError(op, "argument entry must be a dictionary");
00311:     if (failed(verifyLaunchAbiArg(op, arg, uniformIndices)))
00312:       return failure();
00313:   }
00314: 
00315:   for (Attribute builtinAttr : builtinsAttr) {
00316:     auto builtin = dyn_cast<DictionaryAttr>(builtinAttr);
00317:     if (!builtin)
00318:       return emitLaunchAbiError(op, "builtin entry must be a dictionary");
00319:     if (failed(verifyLaunchAbiBuiltin(op, builtin, uniformIndices)))
00320:       return failure();
00321:   }
00322: 
00323:   return verifyLaunchAbiUniformLayout(op, *uniformWordsPerQPU, uniformIndices);
00324: }

00337: static LogicalResult verifyResourceMetadata(mlir::vc4::FuncOp op) {
00338:   Attribute rawAttr = op->getAttr("vc4.resource");
00339:   if (!rawAttr) return success();
00340:   auto resource = dyn_cast<DictionaryAttr>(rawAttr);
00341:   if (!resource) return emitResourceError(op, "requires a dictionary attribute");
00342:   if (!op.getKernelAttr()) return emitResourceError(op, "may appear only on vc4.func with 'kernel'");
00343:   if (!op.getDomain() || *op.getDomain() != mlir::vc4::ExecutionDomain::qpu)
00344:     return emitResourceError(op, "requires domain = #vc4.execution_domain<qpu>");
00345:   auto scheduleModeAttr = dyn_cast_or_null<StringAttr>(resource.get("schedule_mode"));
00346:   StringRef scheduleMode = scheduleModeAttr ? scheduleModeAttr.getValue() : StringRef("independent_vector");
00347:   if (!isStringOneOf(scheduleMode, {"independent_vector", "cooperative_block"}))
00348:     return emitResourceError(op, "requires schedule_mode = \"independent_vector\" or \"cooperative_block\"");
00349:   bool usesBarrier = getBoolAttrValue(resource, "uses_barrier").value_or(false);
00350:   bool usesSharedVPM = getBoolAttrValue(resource, "uses_shared_vpm").value_or(false);
00351:   bool requireFullResidency = getBoolAttrValue(resource, "require_full_block_residency").value_or(usesBarrier || usesSharedVPM || scheduleMode == "cooperative_block");
00352:   auto getI32 = [&](StringRef name) -> std::optional<int64_t> { return getSignlessI32AttrValue(resource, name); };
00353:   int64_t warpsPerBlockMax = getI32("warps_per_block_max").value_or(scheduleMode == "cooperative_block" ? 12 : 1);
00354:   int64_t semaphoresPerBlock = getI32("semaphores_per_block").value_or(usesBarrier ? 4 : 0);
00355:   int64_t vpmBytesPerBlock = 0;
00356:   if (auto bytes = getI32("vpm_bytes_per_block")) vpmBytesPerBlock = *bytes;
00357:   if (auto bytes = getI32("shared_vpm_bytes")) vpmBytesPerBlock = *bytes;
00358:   if (warpsPerBlockMax <= 0) return emitResourceError(op, "warps_per_block_max must be greater than zero");
00359:   if (semaphoresPerBlock < 0) return emitResourceError(op, "semaphores_per_block must be non-negative");
00360:   if (vpmBytesPerBlock < 0) return emitResourceError(op, "vpm_bytes_per_block/shared_vpm_bytes must be non-negative");
00361:   if (scheduleMode == "independent_vector") {
00362:     if (usesBarrier || usesSharedVPM || requireFullResidency || semaphoresPerBlock != 0 || vpmBytesPerBlock != 0)
00363:       return emitResourceError(op, "independent_vector kernels must not request barrier/shared cooperative resources");
00364:     return success();
00365:   }
00366:   if ((usesBarrier || usesSharedVPM) && !requireFullResidency)
00367:     return emitResourceError(op, "cooperative barrier/shared kernels require require_full_block_residency = true");
00368:   if (warpsPerBlockMax > 12)
00369:     return emitResourceError(op, Twine("warps_per_block_max must fit the target active QPU limit 12; got ") + Twine(warpsPerBlockMax));
00370:   if (semaphoresPerBlock > 16)
00371:     return emitResourceError(op, Twine("semaphores_per_block must fit the target hardware semaphore limit 16; got ") + Twine(semaphoresPerBlock));
00372:   if (usesBarrier && semaphoresPerBlock <= 0)
00373:     return emitResourceError(op, "barrier cooperative kernels require semaphores_per_block > 0");
00374:   if (vpmBytesPerBlock > 4096)
00375:     return emitResourceError(op, Twine("vpm_bytes_per_block/shared_vpm_bytes must fit the 4096 byte user-visible VPM window; got ") + Twine(vpmBytesPerBlock));
00376:   int64_t byQPU = 12 / warpsPerBlockMax;
00377:   int64_t bySem = semaphoresPerBlock <= 0 ? 12 : 16 / semaphoresPerBlock;
00378:   int64_t byVPM = vpmBytesPerBlock <= 0 ? 12 : 4096 / vpmBytesPerBlock;
00379:   if (std::min(byQPU, std::min(bySem, byVPM)) <= 0)
00380:     return emitResourceError(op, "cooperative_block resource request leaves zero resident_blocks; check warps_per_block_max, vpm_bytes_per_block, and semaphores_per_block");
00381:   return success();
00382: }

00466: }

00487: static LogicalResult verifyAllOperandsAndResultAreVC4Values(Operation *op) {
00488:   for (Type operandType : op->getOperandTypes()) {
00489:     if (!isVC4StructuredValueType(operandType)) {
00490:       return op->emitOpError(
00491:           "operands must be i32, f32, vector<16xi32>, or vector<16xf32>");
00492:     }
00493:   }
00494:   for (Type resultType : op->getResultTypes()) {
00495:     if (!isVC4StructuredValueType(resultType)) {
00496:       return op->emitOpError(
00497:           "result type must be i32, f32, vector<16xi32>, or vector<16xf32>");
00498:     }
00499:   }
00500:   return success();
00501: }
00502: 
00503: static LogicalResult verifySameTypeOperandsAndResult(Operation *op) {
00504:   Type resultType = op->getResult(0).getType();
00505:   for (Type operandType : op->getOperandTypes()) {
00506:     if (operandType != resultType) {
00507:       return op->emitOpError(
00508:                  "requires operand and result types to match exactly")
00509:              << " (got operand type " << operandType << " and result type "
00510:              << resultType << ")";
00511:     }
00512:   }
00513:   return success();
00514: }
00515: 
00516: static LogicalResult verifyBinaryALUTypes(Operation *op, bool requireFloat) {
00517:   if (op->getNumOperands() != 2)
00518:     return op->emitOpError("expects exactly 2 operands for this opcode");
00519:   if (failed(verifyAllOperandsAndResultAreVC4Values(op)))
00520:     return failure();
00521: 
00522:   Type lhsType = op->getOperand(0).getType();
00523:   Type rhsType = op->getOperand(1).getType();
00524:   Type resultType = op->getResult(0).getType();
00525:   if (lhsType != rhsType || lhsType != resultType) {
00526:     return op->emitOpError("requires both operands and the result to have the "
00527:                            "same type");
00528:   }
00529: 
00530:   if (requireFloat) {
00531:     if (!isVC4FloatValueType(resultType))
00532:       return op->emitOpError("requires f32 or vector<16xf32> types");
00533:   } else {
00534:     if (!isVC4IntValueType(resultType))
00535:       return op->emitOpError("requires i32 or vector<16xi32> types");
00536:   }
00537:   return success();
00538: }

00540: static bool haveCompatibleVC4Shapes(TypeRange types) {
00541:   if (types.empty())
00542:     return true;
00543:   Type firstType = types.front();
00544:   for (Type type : types.drop_front()) {
00545:     if (!hasSameVC4Shape(firstType, type))
00546:       return false;
00547:   }
00548:   return true;
00549: }

00600: static void addTMURequestEffects(mlir::vc4::TMUUnit unit,
00601:                                  MemoryEffectList &effects) {
00602:   switch (unit) {
00603:   case mlir::vc4::TMUUnit::tmu0:
00604:     addWriteEffect<mlir::vc4::effects::TMUReq0>(effects);
00605:     break;
00606:   case mlir::vc4::TMUUnit::tmu1:
00607:     addWriteEffect<mlir::vc4::effects::TMUReq1>(effects);
00608:     break;

00617:     break;
00618:   case mlir::vc4::TMUUnit::tmu1:
00619:     addReadEffect<mlir::vc4::effects::TMURcv1>(effects);
00620:     break;

00624: static void addDMAQueueEffects(std::optional<mlir::vc4::DMADescKind> kind,
00625:                                MemoryEffectList &effects, bool isWrite) {
00626:   if (!kind || *kind == mlir::vc4::DMADescKind::load) {
00627:     if (isWrite)
00628:       addWriteEffect<mlir::vc4::effects::VDR>(effects);
00629:     else
00630:       addReadEffect<mlir::vc4::effects::VDR>(effects);
00631:   }
00632:   if (!kind || *kind == mlir::vc4::DMADescKind::store) {
00633:     if (isWrite)
00634:       addWriteEffect<mlir::vc4::effects::VDW>(effects);
00635:     else
00636:       addReadEffect<mlir::vc4::effects::VDW>(effects);
00637:   }

00692: static bool isQPUUpperWriteAddress(int64_t value) { return value >= 32; }
00693: 
00694: // Small-immediate selectors use the encoded hardware space directly:
00695: // 0..47 are immediate integer/float literal selectors,
00696: // 48 is the rotate-by-r5 selector,
00697: // 49..63 are immediate rotate selectors.
00698: static bool isQPUSmallImmLiteralSelector(int64_t value) {
00699:   return value >= 0 && value <= 47;
00700: }
00701: 
00702: static bool isQPUSmallImmRotateByR5Selector(int64_t value) {
00703:   return value == 48;
00704: }
00705: 
00706: static bool isQPUSmallImmImmediateRotateSelector(int64_t value) {
00707:   return value >= 49 && value <= 63;
00708: }
00709: 
00710: static bool isQPUSmallImmVectorRotateSelector(int64_t value) {
00711:   return isQPUSmallImmRotateByR5Selector(value) ||
00712:          isQPUSmallImmImmediateRotateSelector(value);
00713: }
00714: 
00715: static bool isQPUValidSmallImmSelector(int64_t value) {
00716:   return isQPUSmallImmLiteralSelector(value) ||
00717:          isQPUSmallImmRotateByR5Selector(value) ||
00718:          isQPUSmallImmImmediateRotateSelector(value);
00719: }

00721: static bool isQPUAccumulatorMuxR0ToR3(mlir::vc4::QPUMux mux) {
00722:   return mux == mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r0 || mux == mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r1 ||
00723:          mux == mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r2 || mux == mlir::vc4::QPUMux::r3;
00724: }

00726: // Semaphore instructions must not target closely-coupled peripheral write
00727: // addresses that can stall the instruction stream.
00728: static bool isQPUStallCapablePeripheralWriteAddress(int64_t value) {
00729:   return (value >= 43 && value <= 47) || (value >= 52 && value <= 55) ||
00730:          (value >= 56 && value <= 63);
00731: }

00733: static LogicalResult verifyQPUSemaWriteAddressAttr(Operation *op,
00734:                                                    StringRef attrName,
00735:                                                    IntegerAttr attr) {
00736:   if (failed(verifyQPUWriteAddressAttr(op, attrName, attr)))
00737:     return failure();
00738: 
00739:   int64_t value = attr.getInt();
00740:   if (isQPUStallCapablePeripheralWriteAddress(value)) {
00741:     return op->emitOpError()
00742:            << "'" << attrName
00743:            << "' must not target stall-capable peripheral write addresses "
00744:               "(TLB 43..47, SFU 52..55, TMU 56..63) for vc4.qpu.sema";
00745:   }
00746:   return success();
00747: }

00749: static bool isQPUAddPipeActive(mlir::vc4::AddOpcode opcode) {
00750:   return opcode != mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::nop;
00751: }

00754:   return opcode != mlir::vc4::MulOpcode::nop;

00757: static LogicalResult verifyQPUBundleWriteConflict(
00758:     Operation *op, mlir::vc4::AddOpcode addOpcode,
00759:     mlir::vc4::MulOpcode mulOpcode, IntegerAttr waddrAddAttr,
00760:     IntegerAttr waddrMulAttr) {
00761:   if (!isQPUAddPipeActive(addOpcode) || !isQPUMulPipeActive(mulOpcode))
00762:     return success();
00763: 
00764:   int64_t waddrAdd = waddrAddAttr.getInt();
00765:   int64_t waddrMul = waddrMulAttr.getInt();
00766:   if (waddrAdd != waddrMul || !isQPUUpperWriteAddress(waddrAdd))
00767:     return success();
00768: 
00769:   return op->emitOpError(
00770:       "active ADD and MUL pipelines must not target the same accumulator/I/O "
00771:       "write address");
00772: }

00802:     }

00812: 
00813: static LogicalResult verifyQPULoadImmPayload(Operation *op,
00814:                                              mlir::vc4::LoadImmMode mode,
00815:                                              Attribute valueAttr) {
00816:   switch (mode) {
00817:   case mlir::vc4::LoadImmMode::splat32: {
00818:     auto intAttr = dyn_cast<IntegerAttr>(valueAttr);
00819:     if (!intAttr || !intAttr.getType().isSignlessInteger(32)) {
00820:       return op->emitOpError(
00821:           "splat32 mode requires a signless i32 'value' attribute");
00822:     }
00823:     return success();
00824:   }
00825:   case mlir::vc4::LoadImmMode::per_elem_i2:
00826:   case mlir::vc4::LoadImmMode::per_elem_u2: {
00827:     auto valuesAttr = dyn_cast<DenseI32ArrayAttr>(valueAttr);
00828:     if (!valuesAttr) {
00829:       return op->emitOpError(
00830:           "per-element mode requires a dense i32 array 'value' attribute");
00831:     }
00832:     if (valuesAttr.asArrayRef().size() != 16)
00833:       return op->emitOpError("per-element mode requires exactly 16 lane values");
00834:     int32_t minValue =
00835:         mode == mlir::vc4::LoadImmMode::per_elem_i2 ? -2 : 0;
00836:     int32_t maxValue =
00837:         mode == mlir::vc4::LoadImmMode::per_elem_i2 ? 1 : 3;
00838:     for (int32_t laneValue : valuesAttr.asArrayRef()) {
00839:       if (laneValue < minValue || laneValue > maxValue) {
00840:         return op->emitOpError() << "lane values for mode "
00841:                                  << mlir::vc4::stringifyLoadImmMode(mode)
00842:                                  << " must be in range [" << minValue << ", "
00843:                                  << maxValue << "]";
00844:       }
00845:     }
00846:     return success();
00847:   }
00848:   }
00849: 
00850:   llvm_unreachable("unhandled vc4.qpu.ldi mode");
00851: }

00855: mlir::vc4::ModuleOp mlir::vc4::ModuleOp::create(Location loc, StringRef name) {
00856:   OpBuilder builder(loc->getContext());
00857:   OperationState state(loc, getOperationName());
00858:   state.addAttribute(::mlir::SymbolTable::getSymbolAttrName(),
00859:                      builder.getStringAttr(name));
00860:   Region *bodyRegion = state.addRegion();
00861:   bodyRegion->push_back(new Block);
00862:   return cast<mlir::vc4::ModuleOp>(Operation::create(state));
00863: }

00865: mlir::vc4::FuncOp mlir::vc4::FuncOp::create(
00866:     Location location, StringRef name, FunctionType type,
00867:     mlir::vc4::ThreadingMode threading, mlir::vc4::FunctionForm form,
00868:     mlir::vc4::ExecutionDomain domain,
00869:     ArrayRef<NamedAttribute> attrs) {
00870:   OpBuilder builder(location->getContext());
00871:   OperationState state(location, getOperationName());
00872:   state.addAttribute(::mlir::SymbolTable::getSymbolAttrName(),
00873:                      builder.getStringAttr(name));
00874:   state.addAttribute(getTypeAttrName(builder.getContext()), TypeAttr::get(type));
00875:   state.addAttribute("threading",
00876:                      mlir::vc4::ThreadingModeAttr::get(builder.getContext(),
00877:                                                        threading));
00878:   state.addAttribute("form",
00879:                      mlir::vc4::FunctionFormAttr::get(builder.getContext(),
00880:                                                       form));
00881:   state.addAttribute("domain",
00882:                      mlir::vc4::ExecutionDomainAttr::get(builder.getContext(),
00883:                                                          domain));
00884:   state.attributes.append(attrs.begin(), attrs.end());
00885:   state.addRegion();
00886:   return cast<mlir::vc4::FuncOp>(Operation::create(state));
00887: }

00898:       parser, result, /*allowVariadic=*/false,
00899:       getTypeAttrName(parser.getContext()), buildFuncType,
00900:       getArgAttrsName(parser.getContext()), getResAttrsName(parser.getContext()));
00901: }

00909: ParseResult mlir::vc4::BuiltinOp::parse(OpAsmParser &parser,
00910:                                         OperationState &result) {
00911:   StringRef kindKeyword;
00912:   SMLoc kindLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
00913:   if (parser.parseKeyword(&kindKeyword))
00914:     return failure();
00915: 
00916:   std::optional<mlir::vc4::BuiltinKind> kind =
00917:       mlir::vc4::symbolizeBuiltinKind(kindKeyword);
00918:   if (!kind)
00919:     return parser.emitError(kindLoc)
00920:            << "expected one of [elem_num, qpu_num, num_qpus] for vc4 builtin kind";
00921: 
00922:   if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
00923:     return failure();
00924: 
00925:   Type resultType;
00926:   if (parser.parseColonType(resultType))
00927:     return failure();
00928: 
00929:   result.addTypes(resultType);
00930:   result.addAttribute("kind",
00931:                       mlir::vc4::BuiltinKindAttr::get(parser.getContext(), *kind));
00932:   return success();
00933: }

00936:   printer << ' ' << mlir::vc4::stringifyBuiltinKind(getKind());
00937:   printer.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getAttrs(), {"kind"});
00938:   printer << " : " << getResult().getType();
00939: }

00941: LogicalResult mlir::vc4::ModuleOp::verify() {
00942:   for (Operation &op : getBodyRegion().front()) {
00943:     if (!isa<mlir::vc4::FuncOp>(op))
00944:       return emitOpError("expects only vc4.func operations in the module body");
00945:   }
00946:   return success();
00947: }
00948: 
00949: LogicalResult mlir::vc4::FuncOp::verify() {
00950:   if (!getThreadingAttr())
00951:     return emitOpError("requires a 'threading' attribute");
00952:   if (!getFormAttr())
00953:     return emitOpError("requires a 'form' attribute");
00954:   if (!getDomainAttr())
00955:     return emitOpError("requires a 'domain' attribute");
00956: 
00957:   mlir::vc4::FunctionForm form = *getForm();
00958:   mlir::vc4::ExecutionDomain domain = *getDomain();
00959:   if (getKernelAttr() && domain != mlir::vc4::ExecutionDomain::qpu) {
00960:     return emitOpError(
00961:         "the 'kernel' attribute is only legal with domain = #vc4.execution_domain<qpu>");
00962:   }
00963:   if (failed(verifyLaunchAbi(*this)))
00964:     return failure();
00965:   if (failed(verifyResourceMetadata(*this)))
00966:     return failure();
00967:   if (isExternal())
00968:     return success();
00969: 
00970:   if (form == mlir::vc4::FunctionForm::structured) {
00971:     for (Block &block : getBody()) {
00972:       if (block.empty() || !block.back().mightHaveTrait<OpTrait::IsTerminator>()) {
00973:         return emitOpError(
00974:             "structured functions require every block to end in a terminator");
00975:       }
00976:     }
00977:   }
00978: 
00979:   bool sawError = false;
00980:   getBody().walk([&](Operation *op) {
00981:     if (sawError)
00982:       return WalkResult::interrupt();
00983: 
00984:     if (form == mlir::vc4::FunctionForm::structured) {
00985:       if (domain == mlir::vc4::ExecutionDomain::qpu &&
00986:           isVC4HostDomainOnlyOp(*op)) {
00987:         op->emitOpError("is only legal in functions with domain = host");
00988:         sawError = true;
00989:         return WalkResult::interrupt();
00990:       }
00991:       if (domain == mlir::vc4::ExecutionDomain::host &&
00992:           !isVC4HostDomainOnlyOp(*op) && !isVC4SharedStructuredDomainOp(*op) &&
00993:           (isVC4QPUDomainOnlyOp(*op) || isVC4StructuredOp(*op) ||
00994:            isVC4QPUOp(*op))) {
00995:         op->emitOpError("is only legal in functions with domain = qpu");
00996:         sawError = true;
00997:         return WalkResult::interrupt();
00998:       }
00999:       if (isVC4QPUOp(*op)) {
01000:         op->emitOpError("is only legal in functions with form = scheduled");
01001:         sawError = true;
01002:         return WalkResult::interrupt();
01003:       }
01004:       if (!isVC4StructuredOp(*op)) {
01005:         op->emitOpError("is not a legal operation in functions with form = structured");
01006:         sawError = true;
01007:         return WalkResult::interrupt();
01008:       }
01009:       return WalkResult::advance();
01010:     }
01011: 
01012:     if (domain == mlir::vc4::ExecutionDomain::host && isVC4QPUOp(*op)) {
01013:       op->emitOpError("is only legal in functions with domain = qpu");
01014:       sawError = true;
01015:       return WalkResult::interrupt();
01016:     }
01017: 
01018:     if (isVC4QPUOp(*op))
01019:       return WalkResult::advance();
01020: 
01021:     if (isVC4StructuredOp(*op)) {
01022:       op->emitOpError("is only legal in functions with form = structured");
01023:       sawError = true;
01024:       return WalkResult::interrupt();
01025:     }
01026: 
01027:     op->emitOpError("is not a legal operation in functions with form = scheduled");
01028:     sawError = true;
01029:     return WalkResult::interrupt();
01030:   });
01031: 
01032:   return failure(sawError);
01033: }

01035: LogicalResult mlir::vc4::ReturnOp::verify() {
01036:   auto func = (*this)->getParentOfType<mlir::vc4::FuncOp>();
01037:   if (!func)
01038:     return emitOpError("must be nested in a vc4.func");
01039:   if (!func.getForm() ||
01040:       *func.getForm() != mlir::vc4::FunctionForm::structured)
01041:     return emitOpError("is only legal in functions with form = structured");
01042: 
01043:   FunctionType functionType = func.getFunctionType();
01044:   if (getNumOperands() != functionType.getNumResults())
01045:     return emitOpError() << "expected " << functionType.getNumResults()
01046:                          << " operands to match the enclosing function signature";
01047: 
01048:   for (auto [index, operandType, resultType] :
01049:        llvm::zip_equal(llvm::seq<unsigned>(0, getNumOperands()),
01050:                        getOperandTypes(), functionType.getResults())) {
01051:     if (operandType != resultType) {
01052:       return emitOpError() << "type of return operand #" << index << " ("
01053:                            << operandType
01054:                            << ") must match the enclosing function result type ("
01055:                            << resultType << ")";
01056:     }
01057:   }
01058: 
01059:   return success();
01060: }

01119: LogicalResult mlir::vc4::ALUAddOp::verify() {
01120:   if (failed(verifyStructuredFormOp(getOperation())))
01121:     return failure();
01122: 
01123:   switch (getOp()) {
01124:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::nop:
01125:     return emitOpError("structured vc4.alu.add does not support the nop opcode");
01126:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::fadd:
01127:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::fsub:
01128:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::fmin:
01129:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::fmax:
01130:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::fminabs:
01131:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::fmaxabs:
01132:     return verifyBinaryALUTypes(getOperation(), /*requireFloat=*/true);
01133:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::add:
01134:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::sub:
01135:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::shr:
01136:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::asr:
01137:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::ror:
01138:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::shl:
01139:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::min:
01140:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::max:
01141:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::bit_and:
01142:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::bit_or:
01143:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::bit_xor:
01144:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::v8adds:
01145:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::v8subs:
01146:     return verifyBinaryALUTypes(getOperation(), /*requireFloat=*/false);
01147:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::bit_not:
01148:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::clz:
01149:     if (getNumOperands() != 1)
01150:       return emitOpError("expects exactly 1 operand for this opcode");
01151:     if (failed(verifyAllOperandsAndResultAreVC4Values(getOperation())))
01152:       return failure();
01153:     if (failed(verifySameTypeOperandsAndResult(getOperation())))
01154:       return failure();
01155:     if (!isVC4IntValueType(getResult().getType()))
01156:       return emitOpError("requires i32 or vector<16xi32> types");
01157:     return success();
01158:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::ftoi:
01159:     if (getNumOperands() != 1)
01160:       return emitOpError("expects exactly 1 operand for this opcode");
01161:     if (failed(verifyAllOperandsAndResultAreVC4Values(getOperation())))
01162:       return failure();
01163:     if (!isVC4FloatValueType(getOperand(0).getType()))
01164:       return emitOpError("requires an f32 or vector<16xf32> operand");
01165:     if (!isVC4IntValueType(getResult().getType()))
01166:       return emitOpError("requires an i32 or vector<16xi32> result");
01167:     if (!hasSameVC4Shape(getOperand(0).getType(), getResult().getType()))
01168:       return emitOpError("operand and result must have compatible scalar or "
01169:                          "16-lane vector shapes");
01170:     return success();
01171:   case mlir::vc4::AddOpcode::itof:
01172:     if (getNumOperands() != 1)
01173:       return emitOpError("expects exactly 1 operand for this opcode");
01174:     if (failed(verifyAllOperandsAndResultAreVC4Values(getOperation())))
01175:       return failure();
01176:     if (!isVC4IntValueType(getOperand(0).getType()))
01177:       return emitOpError("requires an i32 or vector<16xi32> operand");
01178:     if (!isVC4FloatValueType(getResult().getType()))
01179:       return emitOpError("requires an f32 or vector<16xf32> result");
01180:     if (!hasSameVC4Shape(getOperand(0).getType(), getResult().getType()))
01181:       return emitOpError("operand and result must have compatible scalar or "
01182:                          "16-lane vector shapes");
01183:     return success();
01184:   }
01185: 
01186:   llvm_unreachable("unhandled vc4.alu.add opcode");

01210: LogicalResult mlir::vc4::LoadImmOp::verify() {
01211:   if (failed(verifyStructuredFormOp(getOperation())))
01212:     return failure();
01213: 
01214:   // Structured vc4.load_imm remains on the SSA side of the dialect even when
01215:   // it corresponds closely to a later vc4.qpu.ldi sink form.
01216:   Attribute valueAttr = getValueAttr();
01217:   if (!valueAttr)
01218:     return emitOpError("requires a 'value' attribute");
01219: 
01220:   Type resultType = getResult().getType();
01221:   switch (getMode()) {
01222:   case mlir::vc4::LoadImmMode::splat32: {
01223:     auto intAttr = dyn_cast<IntegerAttr>(valueAttr);
01224:     if (!intAttr || !intAttr.getType().isSignlessInteger(32))
01225:       return emitOpError("splat32 mode requires a signless i32 'value' attribute");
01226:     if (!isVC4StructuredValueType(resultType)) {
01227:       return emitOpError("splat32 mode result type must be i32, f32, "
01228:                          "vector<16xi32>, or vector<16xf32>");
01229:     }
01230:     return success();
01231:   }
01232:   case mlir::vc4::LoadImmMode::per_elem_i2:
01233:   case mlir::vc4::LoadImmMode::per_elem_u2: {
01234:     auto valuesAttr = dyn_cast<DenseI32ArrayAttr>(valueAttr);
01235:     if (!valuesAttr)
01236:       return emitOpError("per-element mode requires a dense i32 array 'value' attribute");
01237:     if (valuesAttr.asArrayRef().size() != 16)
01238:       return emitOpError("per-element mode requires exactly 16 lane values");
01239:     int32_t minValue =
01240:         getMode() == mlir::vc4::LoadImmMode::per_elem_i2 ? -2 : 0;
01241:     int32_t maxValue =
01242:         getMode() == mlir::vc4::LoadImmMode::per_elem_i2 ? 1 : 3;
01243:     for (int32_t laneValue : valuesAttr.asArrayRef()) {
01244:       if (laneValue < minValue || laneValue > maxValue) {
01245:         return emitOpError() << "lane values for mode "
01246:                              << mlir::vc4::stringifyLoadImmMode(getMode())
01247:                              << " must be in range [" << minValue << ", "
01248:                              << maxValue << "]";
01249:       }
01250:     }
01251:     auto vectorType = dyn_cast<VectorType>(resultType);
01252:     if (!vectorType || vectorType.getRank() != 1 || vectorType.isScalable() ||
01253:         vectorType.getDimSize(0) != 16 ||
01254:         !vectorType.getElementType().isSignlessInteger(32)) {
01255:       return emitOpError(
01256:           "per-element mode result type must be vector<16xi32>");
01257:     }
01258:     return success();
01259:   }
01260:   }
01261: 
01262:   llvm_unreachable("unhandled vc4.load_imm mode");
01263: }

01265: LogicalResult mlir::vc4::PackOp::verify() {
01266:   if (failed(verifyStructuredFormOp(getOperation())))
01267:     return failure();
01268: 
01269:   bool hasRegfileAMode = static_cast<bool>(getRegfileAModeAttr());
01270:   bool hasMulMode = static_cast<bool>(getMulModeAttr());
01271:   if (hasRegfileAMode == hasMulMode) {
01272:     return emitOpError(
01273:         "requires exactly one of 'regfile_a_mode' or 'mul_mode'");
01274:   }

01276:   Type inputType = getInput().getType();

01278:   if (!hasSameVC4Shape(inputType, resultType)) {

01291:     case mlir::vc4::RegfileAPackMode::to_16b:
01292:       if (!isVC4StructuredValueType(inputType)) {
01293:         return emitOpError(
01294:             "input type must be i32, f32, vector<16xi32>, or vector<16xf32>");
01295:       }
01296:       return success();
01297:     case mlir::vc4::RegfileAPackMode::sat32:
01298:     case mlir::vc4::RegfileAPackMode::to_8888:
01299:     case mlir::vc4::RegfileAPackMode::to_8a:
01300:     case mlir::vc4::RegfileAPackMode::to_8b:
01301:     case mlir::vc4::RegfileAPackMode::to_8c:
01302:     case mlir::vc4::RegfileAPackMode::to_8d:
01303:     case mlir::vc4::RegfileAPackMode::sat16a:
01304:     case mlir::vc4::RegfileAPackMode::sat16b:
01305:     case mlir::vc4::RegfileAPackMode::sat8888:
01306:     case mlir::vc4::RegfileAPackMode::sat8a:
01307:     case mlir::vc4::RegfileAPackMode::sat8b:
01308:     case mlir::vc4::RegfileAPackMode::sat8c:
01309:     case mlir::vc4::RegfileAPackMode::sat8d:
01310:       if (!isVC4IntValueType(inputType))
01311:         return emitOpError("regfile_a_mode requires i32 or vector<16xi32> input");
01312:       return success();
01313:     }
01314:     llvm_unreachable("unhandled vc4.pack regfile_a_mode");
01315:   }
01316: 
01317:   switch (*getMulMode()) {
01318:   case mlir::vc4::MulPackMode::none:
01319:     return emitOpError("mul_mode must not be <none>");
01320:   case mlir::vc4::MulPackMode::to_8888:
01321:   case mlir::vc4::MulPackMode::to_8a:
01322:   case mlir::vc4::MulPackMode::to_8b:
01323:   case mlir::vc4::MulPackMode::to_8c:
01324:   case mlir::vc4::MulPackMode::to_8d:
01325:     if (!isVC4FloatValueType(inputType))
01326:       return emitOpError("mul_mode requires f32 or vector<16xf32> input");

01398: LogicalResult mlir::vc4::RotateOp::verify() {
01399:   if (failed(verifyStructuredFormOp(getOperation())))
01400:     return failure();
01401: 
01402:   Type inputType = getInput().getType();
01403:   Type resultType = getResult().getType();
01404:   if (inputType != resultType)
01405:     return emitOpError("input and result types must match exactly");
01406:   if (!isVector16Of32BitVC4ValueType(inputType))
01407:     return emitOpError(
01408:         "structured vc4.rotate requires vector<16xi32> or vector<16xf32> "
01409:         "input and result types");
01410: 
01411:   bool hasAmount = static_cast<bool>(getAmount());
01412:   bool hasImmediate = static_cast<bool>(getImmediateAttr());
01413:   if (hasAmount == hasImmediate) {
01414:     return emitOpError(
01415:         "requires exactly one of an amount operand or an immediate attribute");
01416:   }
01417: 
01418:   if (hasAmount) {
01419:     if (!isScalarSignlessIntegerOrIndex(getAmount().getType()))
01420:       return emitOpError("amount operand must be a scalar signless integer or index");
01421:     return success();
01422:   }
01423: 
01424:   auto immediateAttr = getImmediateAttr();
01425:   if (!immediateAttr.getType().isSignlessInteger(32))
01426:     return emitOpError("immediate attribute must be signless i32");
01427:   int64_t value = immediateAttr.getInt();
01428:   if (value < 0 || value > 15)
01429:     return emitOpError("immediate rotate amount must be in range [0, 15]");
01430:   return success();
01431: }

01433: LogicalResult mlir::vc4::TMUDescriptorOp::verify() {
01434:   if (failed(verifyStructuredFormOp(getOperation())))
01435:     return failure();
01436: 
01437:   if (failed(verifyPositiveI32Attr(getOperation(), "mip_levels",
01438:                                    getMipLevelsAttr())))
01439:     return failure();
01440:   if (failed(
01441:           verifyPositiveI32Attr(getOperation(), "width", getWidthAttr())))
01442:     return failure();
01443:   if (failed(
01444:           verifyPositiveI32Attr(getOperation(), "height", getHeightAttr())))
01445:     return failure();
01446:   if (failed(verifyPositiveI32Attr(getOperation(), "cube_map_stride",
01447:                                    getCubeMapStrideAttr())))
01448:     return failure();
01449: 
01450:   if (static_cast<bool>(getWidthAttr()) != static_cast<bool>(getHeightAttr())) {
01451:     return emitOpError(
01452:         "requires 'width' and 'height' to be provided together");
01453:   }
01454: 
01455:   if (getChildImageFieldsAttr() && getChildImageFieldsAttr().empty()) {
01456:     return emitOpError("'child_image_fields' attribute must not be empty");
01457:   }
01458:   if (getBiasFlagsAttr() && getBiasFlagsAttr().empty()) {
01459:     return emitOpError("'bias_flags' attribute must not be empty");
01460:   }
01461: 
01462:   bool hasTextureOnlyFields = getBaseAttr() || getTextureTypeAttr() ||
01463:                               getMipLevelsAttr() || getWidthAttr() ||
01464:                               getHeightAttr() || getMagFilterAttr() ||
01465:                               getMinFilterAttr() || getWrapSAttr() ||
01466:                               getWrapTAttr() || getFlipYAttr() ||
01467:                               getCubeMapStrideAttr() ||
01468:                               getChildImageFieldsAttr() || getBiasFlagsAttr();
01469: 
01470:   switch (getMode()) {
01471:   case mlir::vc4::TMUMode::direct:
01472:     if (hasTextureOnlyFields) {
01473:       return emitOpError(
01474:           "direct mode must not carry texture setup attributes");
01475:     }
01476:     return success();
01477:   case mlir::vc4::TMUMode::texture2d:
01478:     if (getCubeMapStrideAttr()) {
01479:       return emitOpError(
01480:           "'cube_map_stride' is only legal for mode = cubemap");
01481:     }
01482:     return success();
01483:   case mlir::vc4::TMUMode::cubemap:
01484:     return success();
01485:   }
01486: 
01487:   llvm_unreachable("unhandled vc4.tmu.descriptor mode");
01488: }

01494: LogicalResult mlir::vc4::TMURequestOp::verify() {
01495:   if (failed(verifyStructuredFormOp(getOperation())))
01496:     return failure();
01497: 
01498:   ValueRange operands = getOperands();
01499:   if (operands.empty())
01500:     return emitOpError("requires at least one operand");
01501: 
01502:   unsigned descriptorCount = llvm::count_if(operands, [](Value operand) {
01503:     return isa<mlir::vc4::TMUDescType>(operand.getType());
01504:   });
01505:   if (descriptorCount > 1)
01506:     return emitOpError("accepts at most one !vc4.tmu.desc operand");
01507: 
01508:   bool hasDescriptor =
01509:       isa<mlir::vc4::TMUDescType>(operands.back().getType());
01510:   if (descriptorCount == 1 && !hasDescriptor) {
01511:     return emitOpError("descriptor operand must be the last operand");
01512:   }
01513: 
01514:   ValueRange valueOperands =
01515:       hasDescriptor ? operands.drop_back() : operands;
01516:   if (valueOperands.empty()) {
01517:     return emitOpError(
01518:         "requires at least one address or coordinate operand");
01519:   }
01520: 
01521:   auto verifyTextureOperands = [&](unsigned minCount,
01522:                                    unsigned maxCount) -> LogicalResult {
01523:     if (valueOperands.size() < minCount || valueOperands.size() > maxCount) {
01524:       return emitOpError() << "expects between " << minCount << " and "
01525:                            << maxCount
01526:                            << " coordinate operands for the selected TMU mode";
01527:     }
01528:     TypeRange valueOperandTypes = valueOperands.getTypes();
01529:     for (Type type : valueOperandTypes) {
01530:       if (!isVC4StructuredValueType(type)) {
01531:         return emitOpError("coordinate operands must be i32, f32, "
01532:                            "vector<16xi32>, or vector<16xf32>");
01533:       }
01534:     }
01535:     if (!haveCompatibleVC4Shapes(valueOperandTypes)) {
01536:       return emitOpError("coordinate operands must have compatible scalar or "
01537:                          "16-lane vector shapes");
01538:     }
01539:     return success();
01540:   };
01541: 
01542:   if (!hasDescriptor) {
01543:     if (valueOperands.size() != 1) {
01544:       return emitOpError(
01545:           "requests without a descriptor are only legal in direct mode and "
01546:           "require exactly one address operand");
01547:     }
01548:     if (!isI32OrVector16I32(valueOperands.front().getType())) {
01549:       return emitOpError(
01550:           "direct-mode address operand must be i32 or vector<16xi32>");
01551:     }
01552:     return success();
01553:   }
01554: 
01555:   std::optional<mlir::vc4::TMUMode> mode =
01556:       inferTMUModeFromDescriptor(operands.back());
01557:   if (!mode)
01558:     return verifyTextureOperands(/*minCount=*/1, /*maxCount=*/4);
01559: 
01560:   switch (*mode) {
01561:   case mlir::vc4::TMUMode::direct:
01562:     if (valueOperands.size() != 1) {
01563:       return emitOpError(
01564:           "direct-mode descriptors require exactly one address operand");
01565:     }
01566:     if (!isI32OrVector16I32(valueOperands.front().getType())) {
01567:       return emitOpError(
01568:           "direct-mode address operand must be i32 or vector<16xi32>");
01569:     }
01570:     return success();
01571:   case mlir::vc4::TMUMode::texture2d:
01572:     return verifyTextureOperands(/*minCount=*/1, /*maxCount=*/3);
01573:   case mlir::vc4::TMUMode::cubemap:
01574:     return verifyTextureOperands(/*minCount=*/3, /*maxCount=*/4);
01575:   }
01576: 
01577:   llvm_unreachable("unhandled vc4.tmu.request mode");
01578: }
01579:

01584: LogicalResult mlir::vc4::TMUReadOp::verify() {
01585:   if (failed(verifyStructuredFormOp(getOperation())))
01586:     return failure();
01587: 
01588:   if (Value token = getToken()) {
01589:     if (Operation *definingOp = token.getDefiningOp()) {
01590:       auto request = dyn_cast<mlir::vc4::TMURequestOp>(definingOp);
01591:       if (!request) {
01592:         return emitOpError(
01593:             "token operand must come from vc4.tmu.request or be a block argument");
01594:       }
01595:       if (request.getUnit() != getUnit()) {
01596:         return emitOpError("token unit must match the selected read unit");
01597:       }
01598:     }
01599:   }
01600: 
01601:   switch (getPart()) {
01602:   case mlir::vc4::TMUReadPart::raw32:
01603:     if (!isVC4StructuredValueType(getResult().getType())) {
01604:       return emitOpError("part = raw32 requires i32, f32, vector<16xi32>, "
01605:                          "or vector<16xf32> result type");
01606:     }
01607:     return success();
01608:   case mlir::vc4::TMUReadPart::rgba8888:
01609:   case mlir::vc4::TMUReadPart::rg1616:
01610:   case mlir::vc4::TMUReadPart::ba1616:
01611:     if (!isI32OrVector16I32(getResult().getType())) {
01612:       return emitOpError("packed TMU read parts require i32 or vector<16xi32> "
01613:                          "result type");
01614:     }
01615:     return success();
01616:   }
01617: 
01618:   llvm_unreachable("unhandled vc4.tmu.read part");
01619: }

01745:                                       getStartOffsetAttr())))
