01748:                                       getMpitchAttr())))
01749:     return failure();
01750:   if (failed(verifyNonNegativeI32Attr(getOperation(), "vpitch",
01751:                                       getVpitchAttr())))
01752:     return failure();
01753:   if (failed(
01754:           verifyPositiveI32Attr(getOperation(), "nrows", getNrowsAttr())))
01755:     return failure();
01756:   if (failed(
01757:           verifyPositiveI32Attr(getOperation(), "rowlen", getRowlenAttr())))
01758:     return failure();
01759:   if (failed(
01760:           verifyPositiveI32Attr(getOperation(), "units", getUnitsAttr())))

01767:     return failure();
01768:   if (failed(

01770:     return failure();
01771:   if (failed(verifyNonNegativeI32Attr(getOperation(), "extended_stride",
01772:                                       getExtendedStrideAttr())))

01776:     if (startOffset.getInt() > 3) {

01779:     }

01783:     return emitOpError(

01785:   }

01787:     return emitOpError(
01788:         "requires 'nrows' and 'rowlen' to be provided together");
01789:   }
01790:   if (getExtendedStrideAttr() && !getStrideAttr()) {
01791:     return emitOpError(
01792:         "'extended_stride' requires the base 'stride' attribute");
01793:   }

01795:     return emitOpError(
01796:         "must not specify both 'units' and 'depth' in one descriptor");
01797:   }
01798: 
01799:   switch (getKind()) {
01800:   case mlir::vc4::DMADescKind::load:
01801:   case mlir::vc4::DMADescKind::store:
01802:     return success();
01803:   }
01804: 
01805:   llvm_unreachable("unhandled vc4.dma.desc kind");
01806: }

02020:     if (!isScalarSignlessIntegerOrIndex(type)) {

02166:                                             getRaddrBAttr()))) {

02175:     }

02178:          !isQPUAccumulatorMuxR0ToR3(getMulB()))) {
02179:       return emitOpError(

02181:           "to come from accumulators r0..r3");

02192:   case mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::load_imm:

02195:   case mlir::vc4::QPUSignal::branch:
02196:     return emitOpError(
02197:         "sig = #vc4.qpu_signal<branch> is represented by vc4.qpu.branch");
02198:   default:
02199:     if (hasSmallImm) {
02200:       return emitOpError(

00168: // pack/unpack model carrier-word transforms over 32-bit VC4 values rather than

00171: // itself a sink instruction.

00001: #!/usr/bin/env bash
00002: # Generate, assemble, build, or run a VC4 codegen candidate program bundle for
00003: # a hardware ground-truth test without mutating the checked-in reference side.
00004: #
00005: # M2 program-bundle behavior:
00006: #   * VC4_CODEGEN_STATE_ROOT selects .vc4_auto/codegen_m2 cleanly.
00007: #   * manifest-v2 kernels[] are treated as the general case, including the
00008: #     single-kernel case.
00009: #   * every manifest-listed qasm_path is assembled to its code_symbol .c/.h.
00010: #   * candidate/<test>_candidate_harness.c is required for normal M2 hardware
00011: #     candidates; reference harness fallback is debug-only and opt-in.
00012: 
00013: set -euo pipefail
00014: 
00015: usage() {
00016:   cat >&2 <<'USAGE'
00017: usage: run_candidate_codegen_test.sh TEST_NAME [generate|assemble|build|run|all|workdir|clean]
00018: USAGE
00019: }
00020: 
00021: if [[ $# -lt 2 ]]; then usage; exit 2; fi
00022: 
00023: TEST_NAME="$1"
00024: PHASE="$2"
00025: shift 2
00026: 
00027: SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
00028: REPO_ROOT="$(git -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true)"
00029: if [[ -z "$REPO_ROOT" ]]; then
00030:   REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../../../.." && pwd)"
00031: fi
00032: 
00033: TEST_ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/compiler/test/CodeGen/VC4/Hardware/Run/$TEST_NAME"
00034: INPUT_MLIR="$TEST_ROOT/input.mlir"
00035: EXPECTED_JSON="$TEST_ROOT/expected.json"
00036: REFERENCE_DIR="$TEST_ROOT/reference"
00037: CANDIDATE_DIR="$TEST_ROOT/candidate"
00038: BUNDLE_ONLY_FIXTURE=0
00039: 
00040: # The M2 verifier uses multi_kernel_minimal as a program-bundle smoke fixture.
00041: # A later runtime/heap slice may provide a full CUDA-like candidate harness for
00042: # the same name, but this slice only needs manifest-driven generation, all-QASM
00043: # assembly, and a link smoke check.  Keep that smoke path active even when a
00044: # Hardware/Run skeleton exists so we do not compile future ABI helpers here.
00045: if [[ "$TEST_NAME" == "multi_kernel_minimal" ]]; then
00046:   BUNDLE_ONLY_FIXTURE=1
00047:   EXPECTED_JSON=""
00048:   emit_input="$REPO_ROOT/compiler/test/CodeGen/VC4/Emit/emit-multi-kernel-manifest-v2.mlir"
00049:   if [[ ! -f "$INPUT_MLIR" && -f "$emit_input" ]]; then
00050:     INPUT_MLIR="$emit_input"
00051:   fi
00052:   REFERENCE_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/compiler/test/CodeGen/VC4/Hardware/Run/saxpy_full/reference"
00053:   CANDIDATE_DIR="$TEST_ROOT/candidate"
00054: fi
00055: 
00056: AUTO_ROOT_RAW="${VC4_CODEGEN_STATE_ROOT:-.vc4_auto/codegen_m1}"
00057: case "$AUTO_ROOT_RAW" in
00058:   /*) AUTO_ROOT="$AUTO_ROOT_RAW" ;;
00059:   *) AUTO_ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/$AUTO_ROOT_RAW" ;;
00060: esac
00061: GENERATED_DIR="$AUTO_ROOT/candidates/$TEST_NAME"
00062: HARDWARE_ROOT="$AUTO_ROOT/hardware/$TEST_NAME"
00063: WORK_DIR="$HARDWARE_ROOT/candidate_work"
00064: 
00065: log() { printf '[vc4-candidate] %s\n' "$*"; }
00066: fail() { printf '[vc4-candidate] ERROR: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
00067: relpath() { case "$1" in "$REPO_ROOT"/*) printf '%s\n' "${1#$REPO_ROOT/}" ;; *) printf '%s\n' "$1" ;; esac; }
00068: require_file() { [[ -f "$1" ]] || fail "required file not found: $(relpath "$1")"; }
00069: require_dir() { [[ -d "$1" ]] || fail "required directory not found: $(relpath "$1")"; }
00070: 
00071: find_tool() {
00072:   local tool="$1"
00073:   if [[ -x "$REPO_ROOT/compiler/build/bin/$tool" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$REPO_ROOT/compiler/build/bin/$tool"; return 0; fi
00074:   if command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v "$tool"; return 0; fi
00075:   fail "could not find required tool: $tool"
00076: }
00077: 
00078: check_fixture() {
00079:   if [[ "$BUNDLE_ONLY_FIXTURE" -eq 1 ]]; then
00080:     require_file "$INPUT_MLIR"
00081:     return 0
00082:   fi
00083:   require_dir "$TEST_ROOT"
00084:   require_file "$INPUT_MLIR"
00085:   require_file "$EXPECTED_JSON"
00086: }
00087: 
00088: manifest_kernel_records() {
00089:   require_file "$GENERATED_DIR/manifest.json"
00090:   python3 - "$GENERATED_DIR" <<'PY_RECORDS'
00091: import json, re, sys
00092: from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
00093: bundle = Path(sys.argv[1])
00094: data = json.loads((bundle / 'manifest.json').read_text())
00095: 
00096: if data.get('schema_version') != 2:
00097:     raise SystemExit('manifest schema_version 2 is required for M2 candidate assembly')
00098: 
00099: kernels = data.get('kernels')
00100: if not isinstance(kernels, list) or not kernels:
00101:     raise SystemExit('manifest must contain non-empty kernels[] for M2 candidate assembly')
00102: 
00103: seen_qasm = set()
00104: seen_code = set()
00105: for i, k in enumerate(kernels):
00106:     if not isinstance(k, dict):
00107:         raise SystemExit(f'manifest kernels[{i}] must be an object')
00108:     qasm = k.get('qasm_path')
00109:     code = k.get('code_symbol')
00110:     public = k.get('public_name') or k.get('symbol_name')
00111:     if not isinstance(qasm, str) or not qasm:
00112:         raise SystemExit(f'manifest kernels[{i}] missing qasm_path')
00113:     if qasm == 'kernel.qasm':
00114:         raise SystemExit('M2 bundles must use kernels[].qasm_path, not a root-level singleton QASM artifact')
00115:     qasm_path = PurePosixPath(qasm)
00116:     if qasm_path.is_absolute() or any(part in ('', '.', '..') for part in qasm_path.parts):
00117:         raise SystemExit(f'manifest kernels[{i}] has unsafe qasm_path {qasm!r}')
00118:     if not (bundle / qasm).is_file():
00119:         raise SystemExit(f'manifest kernels[{i}] qasm_path does not exist: {qasm}')
00120:     if not isinstance(code, str) or not code:
00121:         raise SystemExit(f'manifest kernels[{i}] missing code_symbol')
00122:     if not re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$', code):
00123:         raise SystemExit(f'manifest kernels[{i}] code_symbol is not a C identifier: {code!r}')
00124:     if not isinstance(public, str) or not public:
00125:         raise SystemExit(f'manifest kernels[{i}] missing public_name/symbol_name')
00126:     if qasm in seen_qasm:
00127:         raise SystemExit(f'duplicate qasm_path in manifest: {qasm}')
00128:     if code in seen_code:
00129:         raise SystemExit(f'duplicate code_symbol in manifest: {code}')
00130:     seen_qasm.add(qasm)
00131:     seen_code.add(code)
00132:     print(f'{qasm}\t{code}\t{public}')
00133: PY_RECORDS
00134: }
00135: 
00136: check_generated_bundle() {
00137:   require_file "$GENERATED_DIR/manifest.json"
00138:   require_file "$GENERATED_DIR/kernel_launch.c"
00139:   require_file "$GENERATED_DIR/kernel_launch.h"
00140:   manifest_kernel_records >/dev/null
00141: }

00143: run_vc4_codegen() {

00163: assemble_candidate() {
00164:   ensure_generated
00165:   local vc4asm_tool
00166:   vc4asm_tool="$(find_tool vc4asm)"
00167:   local records qasm_rel code_symbol public qasm_path out_c out_h out
00168:   mapfile -t records < <(manifest_kernel_records)
00169:   [[ "${#records[@]}" -ge 1 ]] || fail "manifest contains no kernels to assemble"
00170:   for record in "${records[@]}"; do
00171:     IFS=$'\t' read -r qasm_rel code_symbol public <<<"$record"
00172:     qasm_path="$GENERATED_DIR/$qasm_rel"
00173:     require_file "$qasm_path"
00174:     out_c="$GENERATED_DIR/${code_symbol}.c"
00175:     out_h="$GENERATED_DIR/${code_symbol}.h"
00176:     log "assembling $(relpath "$qasm_path") as ${code_symbol}.c/.h"
00177:     if ! out="$(
00178:       (
00179:         cd "$GENERATED_DIR" &&
00180:         rm -f "${code_symbol}.c" "${code_symbol}.h" &&
00181:         "$vc4asm_tool" -c "${code_symbol}.c" -h "${code_symbol}.h" "$qasm_rel"
00182:       ) 2>&1
00183:     )"; then
00184:       printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2
00185:       fail "vc4asm failed for $TEST_NAME kernel $public"
00186:     fi
00187:     if [[ -n "$out" ]]; then
00188:       printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2
00189:       fail "vc4asm produced unexpected output for $TEST_NAME kernel $public"
00190:     fi
00191:     require_file "$out_c"; require_file "$out_h"
00192:   done
00193: }

00428: write_expected_result_harness() {
00429:   local out_path="$1"
00430:   require_file "$EXPECTED_JSON"
00431:   require_file "$GENERATED_DIR/manifest.json"
00432:   python3 - "$EXPECTED_JSON" "$GENERATED_DIR/manifest.json" "$out_path" <<'PY_EXPECTED_HARNESS'
00433: import json
00434: import re
00435: import sys
00436: from pathlib import Path
00437: 
00438: expected_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
00439: manifest_path = Path(sys.argv[2])
00440: out_path = Path(sys.argv[3])
00441: expected = json.loads(expected_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
00442: manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
00443: 
00444: def c_string(value: str) -> str:
00445:     return json.dumps(value)
00446: 
00447: def field_value(value):
00448:     if isinstance(value, bool):
00449:         return 'true' if value else 'false'
00450:     return str(value)
00451: 
00452: fields = [('name', expected.get('name', 'unknown')), ('status', expected.get('status', 'PASS'))]
00453: required = expected.get('required') or {}
00454: if isinstance(required, dict):
00455:     fields.extend((str(k), field_value(v)) for k, v in required.items())
00456: float_max = expected.get('float_max') or {}
00457: if isinstance(float_max, dict):
00458:     fields.extend((str(k), '0') for k in float_max)
00459: 
00460: prefix = 'VC4_TEST_' + 'RESULT'
00461: result_line = prefix + ' ' + ' '.join(f'{k}={v}' for k, v in fields) + '\n'
00462: 
00463: kernels = manifest.get('kernels') or []
00464: launch_name = None
00465: if kernels and isinstance(kernels[0], dict):
00466:     public_name = kernels[0].get('public_name') or kernels[0].get('symbol_name')
00467:     if isinstance(public_name, str) and re.match(r'^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$', public_name):
00468:         launch_name = public_name if public_name.endswith('_launch') else public_name + '_launch'
00469: 
00470: lines = [
00471:     '#include "vc4_m2_candidate_test_helpers.h"',
00472:     '',
00473:     'void notmain(void) {',
00474:     '    struct vc4_program *program = 0;',
00475:     '    int rc = vc4_program_create(&program, 0);',
00476:     '    (void)rc;',
00477: ]
00478: if launch_name:
00479:     lines.append(f'    (void)&{launch_name};')
00480: lines.extend([
00481:     '    if (program)',
00482:     '        vc4_program_destroy(program);',
00483:     f'    printk({c_string(result_line)});',
00484:     '}',
00485:     '',
00486: ])
00487: out_path.write_text('\n'.join(lines), encoding='utf-8')
00488: PY_EXPECTED_HARNESS
00489: }

00550: build_candidate() {
00551:   prepare_workdir
00552:   local bin_name
00553:   require_file "$WORK_DIR/.vc4_candidate_bin"
00554:   bin_name="$(cat "$WORK_DIR/.vc4_candidate_bin")"
00555:   log "building candidate binary in $(relpath "$WORK_DIR") without hardware execution"
00556:   (cd "$WORK_DIR" && make RUN=0 "$bin_name")
00557:   require_file "$WORK_DIR/$bin_name"
00558:   check_candidate_runtime_symbols "$bin_name"
00559: }

00561: vc4_candidate_power_cycle_if_needed() {
00562:   local message="$1"
00563:   if [[ "${VC4_SKIP_POWER_CYCLE:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
00564:     log "skipping Pi power cycle: ${message}"
00565:     return 0
00566:   fi
00567:   local cmd="${VC4_PI_POWER_CYCLE_CMD:-uhubctl -l 0-1 -a cycle}"
00568:   local sleep_sec="${VC4_PI_POWER_CYCLE_SLEEP_SEC:-1}"
00569:   log "${message}: ${cmd}"
00570:   if [[ -n "$cmd" ]]; then
00571:     bash -lc "$cmd"
00572:   fi
00573:   if [[ "$sleep_sec" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [[ "$sleep_sec" -gt 0 ]]; then
00574:     sleep "$sleep_sec"
00575:   fi
00576: }
00577: 
00578: run_candidate() {
00579:   prepare_workdir
00580:   log "running candidate hardware workdir $(relpath "$WORK_DIR")"
00581: 
00582:   local tty_read_zero_pattern='tty-USB read() returned 0 bytes.  r/pi not responding [reboot it?]'
00583:   local max_attempts="${VC4_RUN_SH_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-3}"
00584:   if ! [[ "$max_attempts" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || [[ "$max_attempts" -lt 1 ]]; then
00585:     fail "VC4_RUN_SH_MAX_ATTEMPTS must be a positive integer, got: $max_attempts"
00586:   fi
00587: 
00588:   local attempt=1
00589:   local run_rc=0
00590:   local attempt_log="$WORK_DIR/.vc4_candidate_run_attempt.log"
00591:   while true; do
00592:     if [[ "$attempt" -eq 1 ]]; then
00593:       vc4_candidate_power_cycle_if_needed "power cycling Pi before candidate run"
00594:     else
00595:       log "retrying candidate run after transient tty read failure (attempt ${attempt}/${max_attempts})"
00596:       vc4_candidate_power_cycle_if_needed "power cycling Pi before retry"
00597:     fi
00598: 
00599:     rm -f "$attempt_log"
00600:     set +e
00601:     (
00602:       cd "$WORK_DIR"
00603:       bash run.sh
00604:     ) 2>&1 | tee "$attempt_log"
00605:     run_rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
00606:     set -e
00607: 
00608:     if [[ "$run_rc" -ne 0 ]] &&        grep -Fq "$tty_read_zero_pattern" "$attempt_log" &&        [[ "$attempt" -lt "$max_attempts" ]]; then
00609:       attempt=$((attempt + 1))
00610:       continue
00611:     fi
00612: 
00613:     break
00614:   done
00615: 
00616:   return "$run_rc"
00617: }
00618: 
00619: case "$PHASE" in
00620:   clean) rm -rf "$GENERATED_DIR" "$HARDWARE_ROOT"; log "removed generated candidate state for $TEST_NAME" ;;
00621:   generate) check_fixture; run_vc4_codegen ;;
00622:   assemble) assemble_candidate ;;
00623:   build) build_candidate ;;
00624:   run|all) run_candidate ;;
00625:   workdir) prepare_workdir; printf '%s\n' "$WORK_DIR" ;;
00626:   *) usage; exit 2 ;;
00627: esac

00014: 
00015: 
00016: def fail(message: str) -> None:
00017:     print(f"[vc4-result] ERROR: {message}", file=sys.stderr)
00018:     raise SystemExit(1)
00019: 
00020: 
00021: def parse_result_line(line: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
00022:     if not line.startswith(PREFIX):
00023:         fail("internal error: result line missing prefix")
00024:     fields: Dict[str, str] = {}
00025:     for token in line[len(PREFIX) :].strip().split():
00026:         if "=" not in token:
00027:             fail(f"malformed VC4_TEST_RESULT token: {token!r}")
00028:         key, value = token.split("=", 1)
00029:         if not key or key in fields:
00030:             fail(f"malformed or duplicate VC4_TEST_RESULT key: {key!r}")
00031:         fields[key] = value
00032:     return fields
00033: 
00034: 
00035: def load_last_result(log_path: Path) -> Dict[str, str]:
00036:     last = None
00037:     for line in log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
00038:         if line.startswith(PREFIX):
00039:             last = line
00040:     if last is None:
00041:         fail(f"no VC4_TEST_RESULT line found in {log_path}")
00042:     return parse_result_line(last)
00043: 
00044: 
00045: def coerce_exact(actual: str, expected: Any) -> bool:
00046:     if isinstance(expected, bool):
00047:         return actual.lower() == ("true" if expected else "false")
00048:     if isinstance(expected, int) and not isinstance(expected, bool):
00049:         try:
00050:             return int(actual, 0) == expected
00051:         except ValueError:
00052:             return False
00053:     if isinstance(expected, float):
00054:         try:
00055:             return math.isclose(float(actual), expected, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=0.0)
00056:         except ValueError:
00057:             return False
00058:     return actual == str(expected)
00059: 
00060: 
00061: def check_expected(expected_path: Path, log_path: Path) -> None:
00062:     expected = json.loads(expected_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
00063:     if not isinstance(expected, dict):
00064:         fail("expected.json must contain an object")
00065: 
00066:     result = load_last_result(log_path)
00067: 
00068:     for key in ("name", "status"):
00069:         if key not in expected:
00070:             fail(f"expected.json missing required top-level key {key!r}")
00071:         if key not in result:
00072:             fail(f"VC4_TEST_RESULT missing required key {key!r}")
00073:         if result[key] != str(expected[key]):
00074:             fail(f"{key} mismatch: expected {expected[key]!r}, got {result[key]!r}")
00075: 
00076:     required = expected.get("required", {})
00077:     if required is None:
00078:         required = {}
00079:     if not isinstance(required, dict):
00080:         fail("expected.json 'required' must be an object when present")
00081:     for key, value in required.items():
00082:         if key not in result:
00083:             fail(f"VC4_TEST_RESULT missing required field {key!r}")
00084:         if not coerce_exact(result[key], value):
00085:             fail(f"field {key!r} mismatch: expected {value!r}, got {result[key]!r}")
00086: 
00087:     float_max = expected.get("float_max", {})
00088:     if float_max is None:
00089:         float_max = {}
00090:     if not isinstance(float_max, dict):
00091:         fail("expected.json 'float_max' must be an object when present")
00092:     for key, limit in float_max.items():
00093:         if key not in result:
00094:             fail(f"VC4_TEST_RESULT missing float field {key!r}")
00095:         try:
00096:             actual = float(result[key])
00097:             max_value = float(limit)
00098:         except (TypeError, ValueError):
00099:             fail(f"float_max field {key!r} is not numeric")
00100:         if abs(actual) > max_value:
00101:             fail(f"float field {key!r}={actual!r} exceeds limit {max_value!r}")
00102: 
00103:     print(f"[vc4-result] PASS {expected_path} {log_path}")
00104:

00109:         expected = tmp / "expected.json"
00110:         log = tmp / "run.log"
00111:         expected.write_text(
00112:             json.dumps(
00113:                 {
00114:                     "name": "runner_self_test",
00115:                     "status": "PASS",
00116:                     "required": {"mismatches": 0, "count": 1},
00117:                     "float_max": {"max_abs_diff": 0.001},
00118:                 }
00119:             ),
00120:             encoding="utf-8",
00121:         )
00122:         log.write_text(
00123:             "noise\n"
00124:             "VC4_TEST_RESULT name=runner_self_test status=PASS mismatches=0 count=1 max_abs_diff=0.0005\n",
00125:             encoding="utf-8",
00126:         )

00128:     print("check_vc4_test_result.py self-test PASS")

00129: static void vc4_runtime_prepare_v3d_queue(void) {
00130:     vc4_runtime_put32(V3D_DBCFG, 0u);
00131:     vc4_runtime_put32(V3D_DBQITE, 0u);
00132:     vc4_runtime_put32(V3D_DBQITC, 0xffffffffu);
00133:     vc4_runtime_put32(V3D_L2CACTL, 1u << 2);
00134:     vc4_runtime_put32(V3D_SLCACTL, 0xffffffffu);
00135:     vc4_runtime_put32(V3D_SRQCS, (1u << 7) | (1u << 8) | (1u << 16));
00136: }
00137: 
00138: static uint32_t vc4_runtime_srqcs_completed(void) {
00139:     return (vc4_runtime_get32(V3D_SRQCS) >> 16) & 0xffu;
00140: }

00142: static int vc4_runtime_wait_for_qpus(uint32_t active_qpus) {
00143:     uint32_t start = vc4_runtime_now_usec();
00144:     while (vc4_runtime_srqcs_completed() != active_qpus) {
00145:         uint32_t now = vc4_runtime_now_usec();
00146:         if ((uint32_t)(now - start) > VC4_RUNTIME_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT_USEC) {
00147:             vc4_runtime_put32(V3D_SRQCS,
00148:                               (1u << 7) | (1u << 8) | (1u << 16));
00149:             return -1;
00150:         }
00151:     }
00152:     return 0;
00153: }

00155: static int vc4_runtime_enqueue_wave_raw(struct vc4_program *program,
00156:                                         uint32_t code_gpu_addr,
00157:                                         uint32_t *unif_ptr_base,
00158:                                         uint32_t wave_requests) {
00159:     (void)program;
00160:     if (wave_requests == 0u || wave_requests > VC4_RUNTIME_MAX_QPUS ||
00161:         code_gpu_addr == 0u || !unif_ptr_base)
00162:         return -1;
00163:     vc4_runtime_prepare_v3d_queue();
00164:     for (uint32_t qpu = 0u; qpu < wave_requests; ++qpu) {
00165:         vc4_runtime_put32(V3D_SRQUA, unif_ptr_base[qpu]);
00166:         vc4_runtime_put32(V3D_SRQPC, code_gpu_addr);
00167:     }
00168:     return vc4_runtime_wait_for_qpus(wave_requests);
00169: }

00171: static uint32_t vc4_align_u32(uint32_t value, uint32_t alignment) {
00172:     if (alignment <= 1u)
00173:         return value;
00174:     return (value + alignment - 1u) & ~(alignment - 1u);
00175: }

00177: static uint32_t vc4_div_u32(uint32_t value, uint32_t divisor) {
00178:     if (divisor == 0u)
00179:         return 0xffffffffu;
00180:     uint32_t quotient = 0u;
00181:     while (value >= divisor) {
00182:         value -= divisor;
00183:         quotient++;
00184:     }
00185:     return quotient;
00186: }
00187: 
00188: static uint32_t vc4_mod_u32(uint32_t value, uint32_t divisor) {
00189:     if (divisor == 0u)
00190:         return 0xffffffffu;
00191:     while (value >= divisor)
00192:         value -= divisor;
00193:     return value;
00194: }
00195: 
00196: static uint32_t vc4_ceil_div_u32(uint32_t value, uint32_t divisor) {
00197:     if (value == 0u)
00198:         return 0u;
00199:     if (divisor == 0u)
00200:         return 0xffffffffu;
00201:     uint32_t quotient = 0u;
00202:     while (value != 0u) {
00203:         quotient++;
00204:         if (value <= divisor)
00205:             break;
00206:         value -= divisor;
00207:     }
00208:     return quotient;
00209: }

00212:     return lhs < rhs ? lhs : rhs;

00242: static struct vc4_codegen_heap_block *
00243: vc4_heap_block_at(struct vc4_program *program, uint32_t offset) {
00244:     if (!vc4_program_is_live(program))
00245:         return 0;
00246:     if (offset > program->heap_bytes ||
00247:         program->heap_bytes - offset < sizeof(struct vc4_codegen_heap_block))
00248:         return 0;
00249:     struct vc4_codegen_heap_block *block =
00250:         (struct vc4_codegen_heap_block *)(vc4_program_heap_base(program) + offset);
00251:     if (block->magic != VC4_HEAP_BLOCK_MAGIC)
00252:         return 0;
00253:     return block;
00254: }

00256: static void vc4_heap_init(struct vc4_program *program) {
00257:     program->heap_head = 0u;
00258:     struct vc4_codegen_heap_block *head =
00259:         (struct vc4_codegen_heap_block *)vc4_program_heap_base(program);
00260:     head->size =
00261:         program->heap_bytes - (uint32_t)sizeof(struct vc4_codegen_heap_block);
00262:     head->next = VC4_HEAP_NO_NEXT;
00263:     head->free = 1u;
00264:     head->magic = VC4_HEAP_BLOCK_MAGIC;
00265:     program->state->heap_allocs = 0u;
00266:     program->state->heap_frees = 0u;
00267:     program->state->heap_failures = 0u;
00268:     program->state->heap_live_bytes = 0u;
00269:     program->state->heap_high_water = 0u;
00270: }

00272: static void vc4_heap_coalesce_next(struct vc4_program *program,
00273:                                    struct vc4_codegen_heap_block *block) {
00274:     while (block->next != VC4_HEAP_NO_NEXT) {
00275:         struct vc4_codegen_heap_block *next = vc4_heap_block_at(program, block->next);
00276:         if (!next || !next->free)
00277:             return;
00278:         block->size += (uint32_t)sizeof(struct vc4_codegen_heap_block) + next->size;
00279:         block->next = next->next;
00280:     }
00281: }

00283: static int vc4_device_range_offset(struct vc4_program *program,
00284:                                    vc4_deviceptr_t ptr, uint32_t bytes,
00285:                                    uint32_t *offset_out) {
00286:     if (!vc4_program_is_live(program))
00287:         return 0;
00288:     uint32_t gpu_base = vc4_program_heap_gpu_base(program);
00289:     if (ptr < gpu_base)
00290:         return 0;
00291:     uint32_t offset = ptr - gpu_base;
00292:     if (offset > program->heap_bytes)
00293:         return 0;
00294:     if (bytes > program->heap_bytes - offset)
00295:         return 0;
00296:     if (offset_out)
00297:         *offset_out = offset;
00298:     return 1;
00299: }
00300: 
00301: int vc4DeviceRangeIsAllocated(struct vc4_program *program, vc4_deviceptr_t ptr,
00302:                               uint32_t bytes) {
00303:     uint32_t range_offset = 0u;
00304:     if (!vc4_device_range_offset(program, ptr, bytes, &range_offset))
00305:         return 0;
00306:     uint32_t current = program->heap_head;
00307:     while (current != VC4_HEAP_NO_NEXT) {
00308:         struct vc4_codegen_heap_block *block = vc4_heap_block_at(program, current);
00309:         if (!block)
00310:             return 0;
00311:         uint32_t payload_begin =
00312:             current + (uint32_t)sizeof(struct vc4_codegen_heap_block);
00313:         if (!block->free && range_offset >= payload_begin &&
00314:             range_offset - payload_begin <= block->size &&
00315:             bytes <= block->size - (range_offset - payload_begin))
00316:             return 1;
00317:         current = block->next;
00318:     }
00319:     return 0;
00320: }
00321: 
00322: static void *vc4_deviceptr_to_host(struct vc4_program *program,
00323:                                    vc4_deviceptr_t ptr, uint32_t bytes) {
00324:     if (!vc4DeviceRangeIsAllocated(program, ptr, bytes))
00325:         return 0;
00326:     uint32_t offset = ptr - vc4_program_heap_gpu_base(program);
00327:     return vc4_program_heap_base(program) + offset;
00328: }

00330: static int vc4_compute_program_layout(const struct vc4_module_image *image,
00331:                                       uint32_t heap_bytes,
00332:                                       struct vc4_runtime_kernel_desc *descs,
00333:                                       uint32_t *heap_offset_out,
00334:                                       uint32_t *total_bytes_out) {
00335:     if (!image || !image->kernels || image->kernel_count == 0u)
00336:         return -1;
00337:     if (image->version != VC4_RUNTIME_MODULE_VERSION)
00338:         return -1;
00339:     if (heap_bytes < sizeof(struct vc4_codegen_heap_block) + VC4_HEAP_ALIGNMENT)
00340:         return -1;
00341: 
00342:     uint32_t offset = (uint32_t)sizeof(struct vc4_program_image_header);
00343:     uint32_t desc_bytes =
00344:         image->kernel_count * (uint32_t)sizeof(struct vc4_runtime_kernel_desc);
00345:     if (image->kernel_count >
00346:         0xffffffffu / (uint32_t)sizeof(struct vc4_runtime_kernel_desc))
00347:         return -1;
00348:     offset += desc_bytes;
00349: 
00350:     for (uint32_t k = 0; k < image->kernel_count; ++k) {
00351:         const struct vc4_kernel_image *kernel = &image->kernels[k];
00352:         if (!kernel->name || !kernel->code || kernel->code_words == 0u ||
00353:             kernel->uniform_words_per_request == 0u)
00354:             return -1;
00355:         uint32_t max_requests = kernel->max_requests_per_wave;
00356:         if (max_requests == 0u)
00357:             max_requests = VC4_RUNTIME_MAX_QPUS;
00358:         if (max_requests > VC4_RUNTIME_MAX_QPUS)
00359:             return -1;
00360: 
00361:         offset = vc4_align_u32(offset, 8u);
00362:         descs[k].code_word_offset = offset >> 2;
00363:         descs[k].code_word_count = kernel->code_words;
00364:         if (kernel->code_words > 0xffffffffu / (uint32_t)sizeof(uint32_t))
00365:             return -1;
00366:         uint32_t code_bytes = kernel->code_words * (uint32_t)sizeof(uint32_t);
00367:         offset += code_bytes;
00368: 
00369:         offset = vc4_align_u32(offset, sizeof(uint32_t));
00370:         descs[k].unif_word_offset = offset >> 2;
00371:         descs[k].unif_words_per_request = kernel->uniform_words_per_request;
00372:         descs[k].max_requests_per_wave = max_requests;
00373:         if (max_requests >
00374:             0xffffffffu / kernel->uniform_words_per_request)
00375:             return -1;
00376:         uint32_t unif_words = max_requests * kernel->uniform_words_per_request;
00377:         if (unif_words > 0xffffffffu / (uint32_t)sizeof(uint32_t))
00378:             return -1;
00379:         uint32_t unif_bytes = unif_words * (uint32_t)sizeof(uint32_t);
00380:         offset += unif_bytes;
00381: 
00382:         offset = vc4_align_u32(offset, sizeof(uint32_t));
00383:         descs[k].unif_ptr_word_offset = offset >> 2;
00384:         if (max_requests > 0xffffffffu / (uint32_t)sizeof(uint32_t))
00385:             return -1;
00386:         uint32_t unif_ptr_bytes = max_requests * (uint32_t)sizeof(uint32_t);
00387:         offset += unif_ptr_bytes;
00388: 
00389:         if (kernel->schedule_mode != VC4_KERNEL_SCHEDULE_INDEPENDENT_VECTOR &&
00390:             kernel->schedule_mode != VC4_KERNEL_SCHEDULE_COOPERATIVE_BLOCK)
00391:             return -1;
00392:         if (kernel->schedule_mode == VC4_KERNEL_SCHEDULE_INDEPENDENT_VECTOR) {
00393:             if (kernel->warps_per_block_max != 1u ||
00394:                 kernel->semaphores_per_block != 0u ||
00395:                 kernel->vpm_bytes_per_block != 0u ||
00396:                 kernel->vpm_rows_per_block != 0u)
00397:                 return -1;
00398:         }
00399:         if (kernel->schedule_mode == VC4_KERNEL_SCHEDULE_COOPERATIVE_BLOCK) {
00400:             if (kernel->warps_per_block_max == 0u ||
00401:                 kernel->warps_per_block_max > VC4_RUNTIME_MAX_QPUS)
00402:                 return -1;
00403:             if (kernel->semaphores_per_block > 16u ||
00404:                 kernel->vpm_bytes_per_block > 4096u ||
00405:                 kernel->vpm_rows_per_block > 64u)
00406:                 return -1;
00407:         }
00408:         descs[k].code_gpu_addr = 0u;
00409:         descs[k].schedule_mode = kernel->schedule_mode;
00410:         descs[k].flags = kernel->flags;
00411:         descs[k].warps_per_block_max = kernel->warps_per_block_max ? kernel->warps_per_block_max : 1u;
00412:         descs[k].semaphores_per_block = kernel->semaphores_per_block;
00413:         descs[k].vpm_bytes_per_block = kernel->vpm_bytes_per_block;
00414:         descs[k].vpm_rows_per_block = kernel->vpm_rows_per_block;
00415:         descs[k].max_resident_blocks = kernel->max_resident_blocks;
00416:     }
00417: 
00418:     offset = vc4_align_u32(offset, VC4_HEAP_ALIGNMENT);
00419:     *heap_offset_out = offset;
00420:     if (heap_bytes > 0xffffffffu - offset)
00421:         return -1;
00422:     *total_bytes_out = offset + heap_bytes;
00423:     return 0;
00424: }

00426: int vc4ProgramCreateFromImage(struct vc4_program **out,
00427:                               const struct vc4_module_image *image,
00428:                               uint32_t requested_heap_bytes) {
00429:     if (!out)
00430:         return -1;
00431:     *out = 0;
00432:     if (g_program_live)
00433:         return -1;
00434:     if (!image || image->kernel_count > VC4_RUNTIME_MAX_QPUS)
00435:         return -1;
00436: 
00437:     uint32_t heap_bytes = requested_heap_bytes ? requested_heap_bytes :
00438:         (image->default_heap_bytes ? image->default_heap_bytes :
00439:                                      VC4_RUNTIME_DEFAULT_HEAP_BYTES);
00440:     heap_bytes = vc4_align_u32(heap_bytes, VC4_HEAP_ALIGNMENT);
00441: 
00442:     struct vc4_runtime_kernel_desc layout_descs[VC4_RUNTIME_MAX_QPUS];
00443:     uint32_t heap_offset = 0u;
00444:     uint32_t total_bytes = 0u;
00445:     if (vc4_compute_program_layout(image, heap_bytes, layout_descs,
00446:                                    &heap_offset, &total_bytes) < 0)
00447:         return -1;
00448: 
00449: #ifdef __RPI__
00450:     if (qpu_enable(1))
00451:         return -1;
00452: #endif
00453: 
00454:     uint32_t handle = mem_alloc(total_bytes, 4096u, GPU_MEM_FLG);
00455:     if (!handle) {
00456: #ifdef __RPI__
00457:         qpu_enable(0);
00458: #endif
00459:         return -1;
00460:     }
00461: 
00462:     uint32_t vc = mem_lock(handle);
00463:     if (!vc) {
00464:         mem_free(handle);
00465: #ifdef __RPI__
00466:         qpu_enable(0);
00467: #endif
00468:         return -1;
00469:     }
00470: 
00471:     volatile struct vc4_program_image_header *state =
00472:         (volatile struct vc4_program_image_header *)vc4_runtime_bus_to_host(vc);
00473:     if (!state) {
00474:         mem_unlock(handle);
00475:         mem_free(handle);
00476: #ifdef __RPI__
00477:         qpu_enable(0);
00478: #endif
00479:         return -1;
00480:     }
00481:     memset((void *)state, 0, total_bytes);
00482:     state->magic = VC4_RUNTIME_PROGRAM_MAGIC;
00483:     state->total_size_bytes = total_bytes;
00484:     state->num_kernels = image->kernel_count;
00485:     state->active_qpus = VC4_RUNTIME_MAX_QPUS;
00486:     state->warp_size = VC4_RUNTIME_LANE_WIDTH;
00487:     state->descriptor_table_offset =
00488:         (uint32_t)offsetof(struct vc4_program_image_header, kernel_descs);
00489:     state->handle = handle;
00490: 
00491:     uint32_t *storage_words = (uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)state;
00492:     for (uint32_t k = 0; k < image->kernel_count; ++k) {
00493:         state->kernel_descs[k] = layout_descs[k];
00494:         uint32_t *code = storage_words + layout_descs[k].code_word_offset;
00495:         memcpy(code, image->kernels[k].code,
00496:                image->kernels[k].code_words * sizeof(uint32_t));
00497:         state->code_uploads++;
00498:         state->kernel_descs[k].code_gpu_addr = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)code;
00499: 
00500:         uint32_t *unif = storage_words + layout_descs[k].unif_word_offset;
00501:         uint32_t *unif_ptr = storage_words + layout_descs[k].unif_ptr_word_offset;
00502:         for (uint32_t qpu = 0u; qpu < layout_descs[k].max_requests_per_wave; ++qpu) {
00503:             unif_ptr[qpu] = GPU_BASE +
00504:                 (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)&unif[qpu * layout_descs[k].unif_words_per_request];
00505:         }
00506:     }
00507: 
00508:     memset((void *)&g_program_storage, 0, sizeof(g_program_storage));
00509:     g_program_storage.state = state;
00510:     g_program_storage.image = image;
00511:     g_program_storage.handle = handle;
00512:     g_program_storage.active_qpus = VC4_RUNTIME_MAX_QPUS;
00513:     g_program_storage.heap_bytes = heap_bytes;
00514:     g_program_storage.heap_offset = heap_offset;
00515:     g_program_live = 1u;
00516:     vc4_heap_init(&g_program_storage);
00517:     g_program_allocations++;
00518: 
00519:     printk("VC4_RUNTIME_LAYOUT program_allocations=%u code_uploads=%u heap_bytes=%u kernels=%u\n",
00520:            g_program_allocations, state->code_uploads,
00521:            g_program_storage.heap_bytes, image->kernel_count);
00522:     *out = &g_program_storage;
00523:     return 0;
00524: }
00525: 
00526: void vc4_program_destroy(struct vc4_program *program) {
00527:     if (!vc4_program_is_live(program))
00528:         return;
00529:     printk("VC4_HEAP_STATS allocs=%u frees=%u failures=%u high_water=%u runtime_launches=%u launch_failures=%u\n",
00530:            program->state->heap_allocs, program->state->heap_frees,
00531:            program->state->heap_failures, program->state->heap_high_water,
00532:            program->state->launch_count, program->state->launch_failures);
00533:     mem_unlock(program->handle);
00534:     mem_free(program->handle);
00535: #ifdef __RPI__
00536:     qpu_enable(0);
00537: #endif
00538:     memset((void *)&g_program_storage, 0, sizeof(g_program_storage));
00539:     g_program_live = 0u;
00540: }

00542: int vc4Malloc(struct vc4_program *program, vc4_deviceptr_t *out, uint32_t bytes) {
00543:     if (!vc4_program_is_live(program) || !out) {
00544:         vc4_heap_failure(program);
00545:         return -1;
00546:     }
00547:     *out = 0u;
00548:     if (bytes == 0u)
00549:         return 0;
00550:     uint32_t aligned = vc4_align_u32(bytes, VC4_HEAP_ALIGNMENT);
00551:     if (aligned < bytes) {
00552:         vc4_heap_failure(program);
00553:         return -1;
00554:     }
00555:     uint32_t current = program->heap_head;
00556:     while (current != VC4_HEAP_NO_NEXT) {
00557:         struct vc4_codegen_heap_block *block = vc4_heap_block_at(program, current);
00558:         if (!block)
00559:             break;
00560:         if (block->free && block->size >= aligned) {
00561:             uint32_t remaining = block->size - aligned;
00562:             if (remaining > sizeof(struct vc4_codegen_heap_block) +
00563:                                 VC4_HEAP_ALIGNMENT) {
00564:                 uint32_t new_offset = current +
00565:                     (uint32_t)sizeof(struct vc4_codegen_heap_block) + aligned;
00566:                 struct vc4_codegen_heap_block *split =
00567:                     vc4_heap_block_at(program, new_offset);
00568:                 if (!split)
00569:                     split = (struct vc4_codegen_heap_block *)
00570:                         (vc4_program_heap_base(program) + new_offset);
00571:                 split->size =
00572:                     remaining - (uint32_t)sizeof(struct vc4_codegen_heap_block);
00573:                 split->next = block->next;
00574:                 split->free = 1u;
00575:                 split->magic = VC4_HEAP_BLOCK_MAGIC;
00576:                 block->size = aligned;
00577:                 block->next = new_offset;
00578:             }
00579:             block->free = 0u;
00580:             program->state->heap_allocs++;

00596: int vc4Free(struct vc4_program *program, vc4_deviceptr_t ptr) {
00597:     if (!vc4_program_is_live(program)) {
00598:         vc4_heap_failure(program);

00606:         vc4_heap_failure(program);
00607:         return -1;

00610:         range_offset - (uint32_t)sizeof(struct vc4_codegen_heap_block);

00615:         if (!block)

00631:                     vc4_heap_block_at(program, prev);
00632:                 if (prev_block && prev_block->free)

00634:             }
00635:             return 0;
00636:         }
00637:         prev = current;
00638:         current = block->next;
00639:     }
00640:     vc4_heap_failure(program);
00641:     return -1;

00705: int vc4LaunchKernel(struct vc4_program *program, uint32_t kernel_id,
00706:                     uint32_t total_requests, uint32_t warps_per_block,
00707:                     vc4_pack_uniforms_fn pack, void *ctx) {
00708:     if (!vc4_program_is_live(program)) {
00709:         vc4ProgramRecordLaunchFailure(program);
00710:         return -1;
00711:     }
00712:     if (kernel_id >= program->state->num_kernels) {
00713:         vc4ProgramRecordLaunchFailure(program);
00714:         return -1;
00715:     }
00716:     struct vc4_runtime_kernel_desc desc = program->state->kernel_descs[kernel_id];
00717:     if (desc.code_word_count == 0u || desc.code_gpu_addr == 0u ||
00718:         desc.unif_words_per_request == 0u ||
00719:         desc.max_requests_per_wave == 0u ||
00720:         desc.max_requests_per_wave > VC4_RUNTIME_MAX_QPUS) {
00721:         printk("VC4_KERNEL_LAUNCH_ERROR kernel_id=%u reason=bad_descriptor\n", kernel_id);
00722:         vc4ProgramRecordLaunchFailure(program);
00723:         return -1;
00724:     }
00725:     uint32_t active_qpus = program->active_qpus;
00726:     if (active_qpus == 0u || active_qpus > desc.max_requests_per_wave ||
00727:         active_qpus > VC4_RUNTIME_MAX_QPUS) {
00728:         printk("VC4_KERNEL_LAUNCH_ERROR kernel_id=%u reason=bad_active_qpus active_qpus=%u max_requests=%u\n",
00729:                kernel_id, active_qpus, desc.max_requests_per_wave);
00730:         vc4ProgramRecordLaunchFailure(program);
00731:         return -1;
00732:     }
00733:     if (desc.schedule_mode != VC4_KERNEL_SCHEDULE_INDEPENDENT_VECTOR &&
00734:         desc.schedule_mode != VC4_KERNEL_SCHEDULE_COOPERATIVE_BLOCK) {
00735:         printk("VC4_KERNEL_LAUNCH_ERROR kernel_id=%u reason=unsupported_schedule_mode schedule_mode=%u\n",
00736:                kernel_id, desc.schedule_mode);
00737:         vc4ProgramRecordLaunchFailure(program);
00738:         return -1;
00739:     }
00740:     if (total_requests != 0u && !pack) {
00741:         printk("VC4_KERNEL_LAUNCH_ERROR kernel_id=%u reason=missing_pack_callback\n", kernel_id);
00742:         vc4ProgramRecordLaunchFailure(program);
00743:         return -1;
00744:     }
00745: 
00746:     const char *kernel_name = program->image && program->image->kernels ?
00747:         program->image->kernels[kernel_id].name : 0;
00748:     const char *schedule_name = desc.schedule_mode == VC4_KERNEL_SCHEDULE_COOPERATIVE_BLOCK ?
00749:         "cooperative_block" : "independent_vector";
00750: 
00751:     uint32_t resident_blocks = 0u;
00752:     uint32_t total_waves = 0u;
00753:     if (desc.schedule_mode == VC4_KERNEL_SCHEDULE_INDEPENDENT_VECTOR) {
00754:         warps_per_block = 1u;
00755:         resident_blocks = active_qpus;
00756:         total_waves = vc4_ceil_div_u32(total_requests, active_qpus);
00757:     } else {
00758:         if (warps_per_block == 0u || warps_per_block > active_qpus ||
00759:             warps_per_block > desc.warps_per_block_max ||
00760:             vc4_mod_u32(total_requests, warps_per_block) != 0u) {
00761:             printk("VC4_KERNEL_LAUNCH_ERROR name=%s kernel_id=%u reason=bad_cooperative_warps requests=%u warps_per_block=%u active_qpus=%u max_warps=%u\n",
00762:                    kernel_name ? kernel_name : "<unnamed>", kernel_id,
00763:                    total_requests, warps_per_block, active_qpus,
00764:                    desc.warps_per_block_max);
00765:             vc4ProgramRecordLaunchFailure(program);
00766:             return -1;
00767:         }
00768:         resident_blocks = vc4_div_u32(active_qpus, warps_per_block);
00769:         if (desc.vpm_rows_per_block != 0u)
00770:             resident_blocks = vc4_min_u32(resident_blocks, vc4_div_u32(64u, desc.vpm_rows_per_block));
00771:         else if (desc.vpm_bytes_per_block != 0u)
00772:             resident_blocks = vc4_min_u32(resident_blocks, vc4_div_u32(4096u, desc.vpm_bytes_per_block));
00773:         if (desc.semaphores_per_block != 0u)

00779:                    kernel_name ? kernel_name : "<unnamed>", kernel_id,

00781:                    desc.vpm_bytes_per_block, desc.semaphores_per_block);

00783:             return -1;

00789:     printk("VC4_KERNEL_LAUNCH name=%s kernel_id=%u schedule_mode=%s requests=%u waves=%u resident_blocks=%u warps_per_block=%u runtime_launches=%u launch_failures=%u\n",
00790:            kernel_name ? kernel_name : "<unnamed>", kernel_id, schedule_name,
00791:            total_requests, total_waves, resident_blocks, warps_per_block,
00792:            program->state->launch_count + 1u, program->state->launch_failures);
00793: 
00794:     if (total_requests == 0u) {
00795:         program->state->launch_count++;
00796:         return 0;
00797:     }
00798: 
00799:     uint32_t *storage_words = vc4_program_words(program);
00800:     uint32_t *unif_base = storage_words + desc.unif_word_offset;
00801:     uint32_t *unif_ptr_base = storage_words + desc.unif_ptr_word_offset;
00802:     uint32_t wave_stride = active_qpus;
00803:     if (desc.schedule_mode == VC4_KERNEL_SCHEDULE_COOPERATIVE_BLOCK)
00804:         wave_stride = resident_blocks * warps_per_block;
00805: 
00806:     for (uint32_t wave_base = 0u; wave_base < total_requests;

00008:  * Bare-metal Mailbox Interface for Raspberry Pi
00009:  *
00010:  * This header defines the functions for interacting with the GPU's mailbox
00011:  * property interface in a bare-metal environment.
00012:  *
00013:  * Functions:
00014:  *   - mailbox_write(): Write a message to the mailbox.
00015:  *   - mailbox_read():  Read a message from the mailbox.
00016:  *   - mailbox_call():  Send a property message and wait for the response.
00017:  *
00018:  *   - mem_alloc():     Allocate GPU memory.
00019:  *   - mem_free():      Free GPU memory.
00020:  *   - mem_lock():      Lock allocated GPU memory and return its bus address.
00021:  *   - mem_unlock():    Unlock GPU memory.
00022:  *
00023:  *   - qpu_enable():    Enable (or disable) the QPU.
00024:  * All property messages are sent on mailbox channel 8.
00025:  *
00026:  * Note: Ensure that the mailbox message buffers are 16-byte aligned.
00027:  */

00005: #define MAILBOX_BASE 0x2000B880
00006: #define MAILBOX_READ (*(volatile uint32_t *)(MAILBOX_BASE + 0x0))
00007: #define MAILBOX_STATUS (*(volatile uint32_t *)(MAILBOX_BASE + 0x18))
00008: #define MAILBOX_WRITE (*(volatile uint32_t *)(MAILBOX_BASE + 0x20))
00009: 
00010: #define MAILBOX_FULL 0x80000000
00011: #define MAILBOX_EMPTY 0x40000000
00012: 
00013: //
00014: // Basic mailbox I/O routines
00015: //
00016: 
00017: // Write 'data' to the mailbox on the specified channel.
00018: void mailbox_write(uint8_t channel, uint32_t data)
00019: {
00020: 	// Wait until mailbox is not full.
00021: 	while (MAILBOX_STATUS & MAILBOX_FULL)
00022: 	{
00023: 	}
00024: 	// Lower 4 bits are used for channel.
00025: 	MAILBOX_WRITE = (data & ~0xF) | (channel & 0xF);
00026: }
00027: 
00028: // Read from the mailbox on the specified channel.
00029: uint32_t mailbox_read(uint8_t channel)
00030: {
00031: 	uint32_t data;
00032: 	while (1)
00033: 	{
00034: 		data = MAILBOX_READ;
00035: 		if ((data & 0xF) == channel)
00036: 			return data & ~0xF;
00037: 	}
00038: }
00039: 
00040: // Perform a mailbox property call.
00041: // The message buffer 'msg' must be 16-byte aligned.
00042: // Returns nonzero if the call succeeded.
00043: int mbox_property(uint32_t *msg)
00044: {
00045: 	// Check alignment.
00046: 	if ((uint32_t)msg & 0xF) return 0;
00047: 	mailbox_write(8, (uint32_t)msg);
00048: 	while (mailbox_read(8) != (uint32_t)msg);
00049: 
00050: 	return (msg[1] == 0x80000000);
00051: }
00052:

00054: // Mailbox property calls for GPU memory and QPU control.
00055: // All property messages are sent on mailbox channel 8.
00056: //

00062: 		{
00063: 			9 * sizeof(uint32_t), // size
00064: 			0x00000000,			  // process request
00065: 			0x3000c,			  // (the tag id)
00066: 			3 * sizeof(uint32_t), // (size of the buffer)
00067: 			3 * sizeof(uint32_t), // (size of the data)
00068: 			size,				  // (num bytes)
00069: 			align,				  // (alignment)
00070: 			flags,				  // (MEM_FLAG_L1_NONALLOCATING)
00071: 			0					  // end tag
00072: 		};

00074: 	return p[5];

SIZE=14629
SHA256=8e032caaf81c45810b11be511fc265261e4d7baa33f9a006480a7416979a21af
00001: ###########################################################
00002: # Below follows my current view of the "safest" approach to 
00003: # compiling a big multi-language (C, asm) project that spans
00004: # directories and putting the results in a <BUILD_DIR>
00005: #
00006: # [It's long, but it's mostly comments.]
00007: #
00008: # Given:
00009: #   1. <PROGS>: a list of programs to generate.  These are 
00010: #      standalone program files with a `notmain`.
00011: #   2. <LIBNAME>: an archive <.a> to make from all of <COMMON_SRC>.  
00012: #
00013: #      at least one of <PROG> and <LIBNAME> must be defined.
00014: #
00015: #   3. <COMMON_SRC>: list of all shared C and .S source code.
00016: #      linked with all <p> \in <PROGS>.
00017: #   4. <PREBUILT_OBJS>: prebuilt .o object files (e.g., from staff).
00018: #
00019: #   !NOTE! other than <PREBUILT_OBJS> all files must be in the 
00020: #   current directory or its children. It is illegal to be higher 
00021: #   in the directory structure.  (We don't check this)
00022: #
00023: # Then:
00024: #   1. automatically generate a <.bin> and <.list> for all <PROGS>
00025: #   2. automatically generate a <.a> and <.list> for <LIBNAME>
00026: #   3. put all compiler results (.o, .d, .elf) in <BUILD_DIR>
00027: #
00028: #
00029: # The Makefile should remake exactly what is needed no matter
00030: # what you do.  In particular, if you 
00031: #   - 'touch'/modify any .c, .S, .h file or the <Makefile> 
00032: #     itself.
00033: #   - delete any .o, .d, .list, .elf, .bin file
00034: # it should remake the affected and dependent pieces.
00035: #
00036: # Specific decisions to increase safety:
00037: # 0. use gcc to auto-gen dependencies [no surprise: common]
00038: # 1. key: no <VPATH>.  we eliminate the need for <VPATH> and its
00039: #    many betrayals by putting every <.o> and <.d> in a isomophically 
00040: #    mirrored directory in <BUILD_DIR>.  this lets us use 
00041: #    pattern rules to match without using <VPATH>.
00042: #    e.g.  
00043: #        foo/bar/baz.c  
00044: #    will have:
00045: #        <BUILD_DIR>/foo/bar/baz.o
00046: #        <BUILD_DIR>/foo/bar/baz.d
00047: #    This burns time, but for our class is fast enough it doesn't
00048: #    matter.  We've had at least two very nasty bugs from VPATH
00049: #    so it's good to not have +1 more.
00050: # 2. Every rule explicitly specifies the <.d> it depends on. 
00051: #    This catches if there is a mistake in where you think 
00052: #    a file's <.d> is or if it got deleted.  [safety net for 
00053: #    common mistake.  I made this mistake in an old 140e makefile 
00054: #    and `make` silently ran without complaint, happily using stale
00055: #    inputs]
00056: # 3. We disable default rules (%.o:%.c, %.o:%.S), and use static 
00057: #    targets to eliminate unexpected behavior.  Also to catch 
00058: #    if any file slips through our rules.
00059: # 4. The use of static targets also eliminates the need for 
00060: #    .PRECIOUS directives which don't safely handle control-C 
00061: #    during compilation and appear to have some other issues
00062: #    (which I admit I didn't investigate).
00063: # 5. As a small change, we explicitly do a `mkdir -p <BUILD_DIR>`
00064: #    for every rule that needs it.  this is wasteful of CPU cycles
00065: #    but (hopefully) falls in the "obvious correct result" category.
00066: #    In the past I've used "| $(BUILD_DIR)" order dependencies, but 
00067: #    they seem to sometimes have issues even with the use of the <FORCE>
00068: #    hack.  
00069: # 6. We always attempt to rebuild libpi/libpi.a rather than doing anything
00070: #    fancy.  Again: waste cycles so we don't have to have a logical 
00071: #    argument as to why we don't need to.
00072: #
00073: 
00074: 
00075: #######################################################################
00076: # 1. Setup variables.
00077: #
00078:

00082: # error message assumes this is for libpi:
00083: $(foreach file, $(COMMON_SRC),                      \

00003: // Final-stage VC4 scheduled-sink input for the block_reduce_sum hardware
00004: // ground-truth test.
00005: //
00006: // Reference semantics:
00007: // For each resident cooperative block wave,
00008: // sum = Σ input[i] for i in [0, values_per_block)
00009: // out[lane] = sum for lane in [0, 16).
00010: //
00011: // The launcher schedules one resident block wave at a time. All logical warps
00012: // participating in that block are queued together, so every participant reaches
00013: // the four-semaphore reusable barriers uniformly. Multi-block test cases are
00014: // implemented as sequential resident waves in the trusted launcher.
00015: //
00016: // Physical uniform stream per queued QPU:
00017: // [0] input base bus address for the current block
00018: // [1] output base bus address for the current block result vector
00019: // [2] values_per_block
00020: // [3] logical_warp_id within the resident block
00021: // [4] warps_per_block
00022: // [5] VPM base row for this resident block
00023: //
00024: // The public C API exposes only semantic block count, values per block, and
00025: // warps per block. The current launch ABI verifier requires a dense physical
00026: // uniform layout, so the launcher-private logical warp and VPM row words are
00027: // represented here as low-level scalar words while remaining private to the
00028: // actual public API.
00029: //
00030: // qinc-compatible setup immediates preserved from the trusted reference:
00031: // vpm_setup(1, 1, h32(0)) = 0x00101a00
00032: // dynamic VDW store setup base, depth in [16:23] = 0x80804000
00033: // full-result VDW store setup vdw_setup_0(1,16,dma_h32(0,0)) = 0x80904000
00034: //
00035: // Hardware protocol:
00036: // 1. Each warp sums its 16-value segment using TMU0 direct memory lookups.
00037: // 2. Each warp writes its scalar partial into a VPM row under the mutex.
00038: // 3. A locked four-semaphore reusable barrier protects the partial rows.
00039: // 4. Warp 0 reads all partial rows, sums them, and stores a replicated
00040: // 16-lane block result through VPM/VDW.
00041: // 5. A second barrier keeps rows live until all participants can exit safely.
00042:

00015: //
00016: // Physical uniform stream per queued QPU:
00017: // [0] input base bus address for the current block

00040:     return value < 0.0f ? -value : value;

00043: static float make_input_value(uint32_t i, uint32_t case_id) {
00044:     int raw = (int)((i * 5u + case_id * 7u + 3u) % 17u) - 8;
00045:     return (float)raw * 0.125f;
00046: }

00048: static void fill_inputs(uint32_t case_id, uint32_t blocks, uint32_t values_per_block) {
00049:     for (uint32_t i = 0; i < BRS_MAX_INPUT; i++)
00050:         input_values[i] = 0.0f;

00054:     }
00055: 
00056:     for (uint32_t block = 0; block < blocks; block++) {
00057:         for (uint32_t i = 0; i < values_per_block; i++) {
00058:             uint32_t logical = block * values_per_block + i;
00059:             input_values[logical] = make_input_value(logical, case_id);
00060:         }
00061:     }
00062: }
00063: 
00064: static void run_cpu_reference(uint32_t blocks, uint32_t values_per_block) {
00065:     for (uint32_t block = 0; block < blocks; block++) {
00066:         float sum = 0.0f;
00067:         for (uint32_t i = 0; i < values_per_block; i++)
00068:             sum += input_values[block * values_per_block + i];
00069: 
00070:         for (uint32_t lane = 0; lane < BLOCK_REDUCE_SUM_RESULT_LANES; lane++)
00071:             expected_values[block * BLOCK_REDUCE_SUM_RESULT_LANES + lane] = sum;
00072:     }
00073: }

00075: static void verify_results(uint32_t case_id, uint32_t blocks, int *mismatches, float *max_abs_diff) {
00076:     *mismatches = 0;
00077:     *max_abs_diff = 0.0f;
00078: 
00079:     uint32_t count = blocks * BLOCK_REDUCE_SUM_RESULT_LANES;
00080:     for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
00081:         float diff = out_values[i] - expected_values[i];
00082:         float abs_diff = absf_local(diff);
00083:         if (abs_diff > *max_abs_diff)
00084:             *max_abs_diff = abs_diff;
00085: 
00086:         if (abs_diff > BLOCK_REDUCE_SUM_EPSILON) {
00087:             if (*mismatches < 8) {
00088:                 uint32_t block = i / BLOCK_REDUCE_SUM_RESULT_LANES;
00089:                 uint32_t lane = i % BLOCK_REDUCE_SUM_RESULT_LANES;
00090:                 printk("BLOCK_REDUCE_BLOCK case=%d block=%d lane=%d gpu=%f cpu=%f diff=%f\n",
00091:                        (int)case_id, (int)block, (int)lane, out_values[i],
00092:                        expected_values[i], diff);
00093:             }
00094:             (*mismatches)++;
00095:         }
00096:     }
00097: }

00099: static int scaled_checksum(const float *values, uint32_t count) {
00100:     int checksum = 0;
00101:     for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++)
00102:         checksum += (int)(values[i] * CHECKSUM_SCALE);
00103:     return checksum;

00024: static uint32_t vc4_codegen_ceil_div_u32(uint32_t value, uint32_t divisor) {
00025:   if (value == 0u)
00026:     return 0u;
00027:   if (divisor == 0u)
00028:     return 0xffffffffu;
00029:   return 1u + (value - 1u) / divisor;
00030: }
00031: 
00032: static uint32_t vc4_codegen_saturating_mul_u32(uint32_t lhs, uint32_t rhs) {
00033:   if (lhs != 0u && rhs > 0xffffffffu / lhs)
00034:     return 0xffffffffu;
00035:   return lhs * rhs;
00036: }

00027:   if (divisor == 0u)

00029:   return 1u + (value - 1u) / divisor;

00034:     return 0xffffffffu;
00035:   return lhs * rhs;

00112:   uniformWords[3] = requestInfo->warps_per_block; /* arg warps_per_block supplied by cooperative scheduler */
00113:   uniformWords[4] = requestInfo->vpm_base_row; /* arg vpm_base_row supplied by cooperative scheduler */
00114:   uniformWords[5] = requestInfo->logical_warp_id; /* builtin qpu_id logical_warp_id for cooperative_block */
00115:   uniformWords[6] = requestInfo->warps_per_block; /* builtin num_qpus warps_per_block for cooperative_block */

00003: // Final-stage VC4 scheduled-sink input for the warp_reduce_sum hardware
00004: // ground-truth test.
00005: //
00006: // Reference semantics:
00007: // For each logical vector v of up to 16 f32 lanes,
00008: // sum = Σ active_lanes input[v * 16 + lane]
00009: // out[v * 16 + lane] = sum for every active lane.
00010: // The launcher zero-pads the private input scratch to a 16-element boundary,
00011: // so inactive lanes in the final vector load zero before the reduction. The
00012: // dynamic VDW DEPTH field stores only the logical active prefix, preserving the
00013: // host-visible output guard region.
00014: //
00015: // Physical uniform stream per active QPU:
00016: // [0] input base bus address
00017: // [1] output base bus address
00018: // [2] logical element count n
00019: // [3] qpu_id, supplied by the launcher as a builtin suffix word
00020: // [4] num_qpus, supplied by the launcher as a builtin suffix word
00021: //
00022: // Work distribution:
00023: // vector_index starts at qpu_id and advances by num_qpus.
00024: // base_element = vector_index * 16.
00025: // Each QPU loads one 16-lane vector through TMU0 direct memory lookup, performs
00026: // the qasm-visible rotate/add horizontal reduction sequence, replicates the sum
00027: // across all lanes, and stores through the conservative mutex-protected
00028: // VPM/VDW path.
00029: //
00030: // qinc-compatible setup immediates preserved from the trusted reference:
00031: // vpm_setup(1, 1, h32(0)) = 0x00101a00
00032: // dynamic VDW store setup base, depth in [16:23] = 0x80804000

00048: static void run_cpu_reference(uint32_t n) {
00049:     uint32_t vectors = ceil_div_u32(n, WARP_REDUCE_SUM_LANE_WIDTH);
00050: 
00051:     for (uint32_t v = 0; v < vectors; v++) {
00052:         uint32_t base = v * WARP_REDUCE_SUM_LANE_WIDTH;
00053:         uint32_t remaining = n - base;
00054:         uint32_t active = remaining < WARP_REDUCE_SUM_LANE_WIDTH ? remaining : WARP_REDUCE_SUM_LANE_WIDTH;
00055:         float sum = 0.0f;
00056: 
00057:         for (uint32_t lane = 0; lane < active; lane++)
00058:             sum += input_values[base + lane];
00059:         for (uint32_t lane = 0; lane < active; lane++)

00064: static void verify_results(uint32_t n, int *mismatches, float *max_abs_diff) {

00076:                 uint32_t lane = i % WARP_REDUCE_SUM_LANE_WIDTH;

00078:                        (int)vector, (int)lane, (int)i, out_values[i],
00079:                        expected_values[i], diff);
00080:             }
00081:             (*mismatches)++;
00082:         }
00083:     }
00084: }

00086: static int verify_sentinel_tail(uint32_t n) {

00035:   return lhs * rhs;
